name: Weaponverse
description: Upon obtaining this ability, a personal dimension forms on the planes of your soul, housing any weapon that you have seen or imagined, even guns. You can configure the appearance of this separate plane and even pull it into this dimension allowing for a fortress-type armory. Upon summoning a weapon, a hole in space will form, linking local reality with your weaponverse, and any number of weapons that you have the energy to summon will appear.
summary: The ability to Pull any imagined weapon from a separate personal dimension or armory.
strengths: Can summon any weapon you have the capability to imagine or create within your mind.
Can potentially summon infinite numbers of weapons.
Summon weapons instantly.
weaknesses: Can be extremely draining to summon large numbers, leading to death.
Can be harmed by summoned soul-rending weapons.
Some weapons lead to collateral damage.

name: Imagination Manifestation
description: The ability to manifest your imagination into a physical being that only you can see. It will appear to you as a creature of your choosing. Its power levels will be based off of how wild your imagination is. Imagination manifestations can pull things into reality out of nowhere and will protect/obey its owner at all costs. Imagination cannot be destroyed by any physical means.
summary: The ability to manifest your imagination into a physical being only you can see.
strengths: An invisible, invulnerable creature that will always protect/obey you.
They can take anything you can imagine into reality.
If your imagination is wild, the manifestation is powerful!
weaknesses: If you have no imagination, the power is useless.
If you have a wild imagination, it might be hard to control.
Imagination crushers

name: Imagination Creation
description: This power causes a boundary to surround you and anyone else you want. You can make the boundaries go as far as you want when you are using this power. You can imagine ANYTHING and it will happen within the imagination field. And only your imagination becomes reality. You can use what you imagine to hurt someone or use what you imagine not to, it's your imagination.
summary: The ability to bring what ever you imagine to life within an area.
strengths: You can imagine or think of anyone you want, or make up a person
You can imagine or think of anything you want, or make something up
You can live your life's greatest and wildest desires and fantasies without harming the real world
weaknesses: This may give you headaches depending on how much or what you imagine
Anyone else whose in the boundary with you will either be jealous of you or ask you to do a lot

name: Reality Effect Manipulation
description: This ability does not controls realities/dimensions just its effects on things within it. In some cartoon and anime shows when a character(s)enters a different dimension and they get stronger or weaker. This ability manipulate that those effects. The user can make himself stronger and other as well. He can be creative when dealing with enemies. The user can make their reality feel like poison or acid to them and no one else would suffer to the effects.
summary: The ability to control or change how realities/dimensions affects people, objects, or etc. to give them effects.
strengths: Make you or other things stronger or weaker.
Give unique effects to targets or yourself.
Never be the victim of effects of alternate realities/dimensions
weaknesses: The effects are only temporary if the user away from target.
Has a limit on targets when using this ability on multiple targets.
Does not controls realities/dimensions only its effects on things within it.

name: Portal Mastery
description: Your body acts as a doorway to the inside of a worm-hole, except with total control. Portals to anywhere in the universe or simply a portal to keep people trapped in dead time (can be used to trap enemies or transport people as you can bring them out of it no matter where you are. ) When inside, time ceases to exist. There is no aging, no starving- time simply stands still.
summary: The ability to open portals to anywhere you can see in your mind, for travel or isolation in suspended time.
strengths: Easy access to place you can see in your mind.
You have an easy alternative to killing bad guys (if it's not your thing. )
Can carry an infinite number of people within yourself. Could one day save the entire planet.
weaknesses: If you are knocked unconscious as you enter your portal, you'll be that way forever and never return
Know where you're opening a portal to. If you open one and step out onto the sun, you die.
Opening multiple portals puts an overwhelming amount of stress on your mind and could knock you out.

name: Force Manipulation
description: You can control gravity, electromagnetism and all types of force. You can control friction and slow things down, gravity to make things weightless. This is only limited by your imagination. Also, you have a more advanced control over these forces.
summary: The ability to manipulate all forces
strengths: Levitate your car in traffic
Make surfaces slippery
Pretty dangerous
weaknesses: Too dangerous for supervillians

name: Personal Realm
description: With this power, the user can create a world outside of this dimension. This world will have the user's own rules, laws of physics, look, etc. A portal must be made on a "marker" in this world that has a counterpart in the user's world. The marker can be either a tree, a rock, a doorway, etc., but there is only one marker. You can make as many realms as you want, but only one at a time.
summary: The ability to create your own realm.
strengths: Cool place to hang out
In your realm, you are a god
If the real world is about to be destroyed, you can bring people to your world and save humanity
weaknesses: Takes lots of practice, meditation, and work to make the world and portal stable
If the portal is destroyed, there is no way into or out of your personal realm
The only portal into the realm cannot be moved.

name: Hysteresis
description: Also called Effect Delay, Lag Inducing, Delay Inducing, Delay or Lagging, this is the ability to psychically cause a quantum-mechanical lag in time between causality and the resulting effects. One with this ability could cause a gun to go off seconds, minutes or hours after the trigger is pulled, or could cause a bomb to go off far after the detonator is pushed (or delay an explosion after methane has been introduced to a flame). One with this ability could even delay the reflexes of foes, etc.
summary: The ability to induce a metaphysical delay between cause and effect
strengths: Delay harmful biological/chemical reactions (explosions, acid burn, poisoning, disease symptoms etc)
Delay physical reactions (reflexes, body's processing of sensory stimuli, gag reflex, etc)
Delay mechanical/technological/electronic reactions (tripping motion sensors, etc)
weaknesses: Cannot delay something unless you know the cause and its projected effect (NCN)
Cannot delay effects indefinitely (must set time period--seconds/minutes/hours/days, etc) (NCN)
Unpredictability and the like provide immunity (NCN)

name: Solar Eater
description: This ability allows you to absorb the energy generated by stars by absorbing the energy it will produce in years to come, up to a maximum of 6000 years per day.  As such the star in question will age at a faster rate.
summary: The ability to absorb potential energy generated by stars.
strengths: An immense energy supply everyday.
It will take a long time before draining a star of all its energy.
If you're not immortal, or can't reicarnate, you don't have to worry about the consequnces.
weaknesses: It will take a long time before draining a star of all its energy.
You have to be within it's light range to use this ability
If you are immortal, pray that you can still survive on a planet deviod of life.

name: Words Of Power
description: This ability could be very powerful, if developed. It allows the user to change words, no matter what form they're in, into reality. When they first start out, the user would have to right down the word and then say it. For example, they could right down "sword" and then say it, and a sword would appear where you wrote it. After more development, the user could simply say "sword" and it would appear. After this, all they would need to do is think it. This can work with any word or language.
summary: The ability to turn words into reality
strengths: Words to reality
Very powerful
Can work with any word or language
weaknesses: Almost no one progresses to the thought stage.
Some words will take a lot out of you (death, life, destroy, etc. )
Takes time to develop

name: Limited Reality Manipulation
description: The limitations are: cannot directly affect the lives of others and no dictatorship.
summary: The ability to manipulate reality with certain limitations
strengths: Manipulate reality
weaknesses: Cannot directly affect the lives of others
No dictatorship

name: Space Time Warp
description: You can warp the space-time continuum at will. You can bend reality however you want. You can create black holes and worm holes. You can time travel and appear at any location in the universe. If your falling to your death you can warp space so that you appear on the ground.
summary: The ability to warp the fabric of the space-time continuum in any way
strengths: You can destroy planets and galaxies
You can bend reality around any projectile so it misses you (bullets, lasers, light)
You can send out warp shockwaves that obliterate matter.
weaknesses: If the space-time continuum ceases to exist, so does your power.

name: Clockout
description: This ability is perhaps the most fortunate of the chronokinetic abilities. Not only can you travel through time, but both your departure destination and your arrival destination enter a state of temporal stasis when you do. Your "home time" doesn't move forward, and you can do whatever you like in your "destination time". When you return to your home time, time returns to normal
summary: The ability to travel through time, effectively freezing time upon departure and arrival
strengths: Travel to any time (past or future)
Time freezes at your departure point and your destination
If you're good, you can keep time frozen for a short time after you come back
weaknesses: Requires concentration until you develop it (which can get tiresome)
Time controllers can mess up the use of this ability
People with Time Defiance can resist the temporal stasis

name: Ability Reality Application
description: The user has the ability to turn mundane and physical powers into cosmic phenomenons that have a place in reality. An example of this would be the user having the ability to possess a power punch. With this ability, he can now summon a fist made of metaphysical energies to strike his enemies. This can strain reality if used to many times at one, but give it time, and reality will adjust.
summary: The ability to turns one's physical abilities/powers into reality warping ability.
strengths: Turn any physical power into a force of reality
Control the range of the effects
Reality will adjust to it
weaknesses: No Reality themed abilities
Reality can be damaged if used too many times at once

name: Dimension Manipulation
description: With this power you could enter, control, and create any dimension. This includes hammerspace, the nightmare dimension, the dream dimension, a dimension of your very own etc. You can change your dimension into whatever you want. In there, you are god. There are also an infinite number of dimensions to explore and control. Ones such as the bacon, mime, maze and almost anything else you can think of. This is all yours to control.
summary: The ability to enter, create, and control different dimensions.
strengths: You have your own dimension.
There's not much you can't do.
You can create and distroy anything.
weaknesses: You might get lost in some dimensions.
You might run out of ideas for new dimensions.
Different dimension,different scientific laws,and different reality.

name: Gravity Direction Manipulation
description: This power bends space, but gravitational fields are unaffected. This will result in apparently changing the direction in which gravity pulls. To illustrate: imagine a civilization in a river. The current would be gravity. Now, the ability wielder would be able to rearrange everything, with the current going the same way, eg: they turn the civilization upside down so that the current appears to pull up, making everything fall into the sky. This power could be used for telekinesis and flying.
summary: The ability to manipulate the direction of gravity's pull by bending space.
strengths: Could be used for telekinesis, flying, projection into space.
Would be really cool to make gravity pull upwards so that everything falls into the sky.
Cause chaos easily.
weaknesses: Difficult to use.
Could easily kill oneself, if say, made oneself fall three strories to the roof of a big building.
Limited use.

name: Will Materialization
description: This ability utilizes the mind of the user to materialize his will in the physical world. This enables him to create a myriad of weapons in all forms and sizes he can think of with their own unique abilities. Anything formed by this ability is impervious to change; It will remain as it is in form, composition, ability, purpose, its place in the universe, and its existence in time and space as long as the person 'wills' it to be. The user also perceives everything in the midst of his creations.
summary: The ability to give form or materialize the willpower of the user
strengths: Materialize almost anything you can think of.
Your creations will retain their characteristics no matter what as long as you will it.
Because it originated from your willful mind your creations enable you to perceive your surrounding
weaknesses: Entirely dependent on the willpower of the user making it hard to master.
The speed of materializing an object is dependent on the user's familliarity or knowledge
Imagination is your friend but it is also your limiting agent.

name: Kinesis Collection
description: With this power you are able to manipulate just about all types of 'kinesis' powers from Telekinesis to Chronokinesis. Basically, you are able to use every legitimate kinesis power that is on this site
summary: The ability to use all 'kinesis' powers
strengths: You can use a lot of powerful powers.
You can use multiple at the same time.
weaknesses: Doesn't grant you immunity to kinesis powers of others.

name: The Nexus Key
description: The nexus key is made of a cosmic material, but you may control vast mystic forces, enabling you to create a keyhole shaped portal to travel to countries and through realms, timelines, planets, parallel universes, even to go inside a computer or human bodies and fire disruptive energy beams. The appearance of the nexus key changes depending on who wields it.
summary: The ability to use it to travel to countries, through realms, timelines, planets, and alternate dimensions.
strengths: Can change your size whenever you use this key to go inside human bodies and computers
Could go exploring in what it's like in alternate timelines.
weaknesses: It can be use for extreme evil.

name: Spacetime Indemnity
description: This ability renders a person unaffected by the constraints imposed by the forces that represent time/space. Action, perception, experience, when & where he exists in the universe is free to be controlled. This enables one to: move into any space in the known universe with just a single step, perform multiple tasks in different places simultaneously in no time at all, exist in past, present, future simultaneously, act freely even if time stops & exist even in the absence of space.
summary: The ability to be liberated from the physical constraints of time and space.
strengths: Nothing or no one in the universe is far enough or fast enough to escape from you.
You are beyond any speed in the universe & everything you do is completed in the blink of an eye
Abilities that manipulate time and space does not affect you.
weaknesses: This ability does not manipulate time and space around you.
You always change history over and over again and nothing really stays the same.
May drive someone to the edge of insanity due to the overwhelming experience.

name: Imagination Creek
description: Welcome to the Imagination Creek! You start off with a simple white plane of nothingness. Decide anything you want by imagining it. This is your personal realm and literally anything is possible. Anything. Create a universe, create gravity or others physical forces or not. It doesn't matter because this infinite realm is yours to imagine. This is different than your everyday brainstorming. When you enter the imagination creek, you are actually in it and you will feel and experience everything...
summary: The ability to create a personal realm of infinite space, accessible by entering your own thoughts.
strengths: Create anything you want and interact with it, without boundaries
When in the Creek, reality's time will not pass
Accessible anytime and again, anything is allowed
weaknesses: Only you can enter the Creek (no actual people from reality, but you can make up people)
No one else can see it; no way of bringing it to reality

name: Supertime
description: With this power, your molecules vibrate so fast and you move so fast that everything around you seems to stop, even time. You can win a race or get revenge. If someone touches you while you're going into supertime, they move as fast as you. But once you turn it off, they return to reality too.
summary: The ability to move so fast that time seems to stop
strengths: Win races
Get revenge
Pull awesome pranks
weaknesses: Tempted to evil
Well that's just about it

name: Personal Quantum Calculation
description: When faced with a personal choice, you are able to instantly calculate the consequences of all possible courses of action. The power is limited only to your own choices--you cannot predict the future for another's course of action. You can see the chain of consequences from the point you commit to the action to the point of your death--you can't see how your actions will affect the world after you die.
summary: The ability to predict consequences for all possible courses of action for oneself
strengths: You have the power to choose not to make any mistakes.
You know what personal choices can positively affect others.
You no longer have any need to worry.
weaknesses: The power can easily lead to a life of no risk, which can lead to a life of deep boredom.
The power doesn't help the situation when all courses of action lead to negative consequences.
You can make decisions that benefit the world for the short term, but harm it after your death.

name: Hypertime
description: Your molecules move so fast that you move at superhuman speeds. Enough that time "stands still". In REALITY the people around you are moving slower. If anything comes in contact with you during activation they are just as fast as you and they don't need to stay in contact.
summary: The ability to move so fast time "stands still"
strengths: Perfect revenge
Cheat on tests and you can't get caught
Win races
weaknesses: If someone else has this power and turns it on at the same time as yours, they are just as fast
Liquid nitrogen can knock you out of hypertime
You'll be tempted to commit crimes

name: Reality Rift
description: This could be either one of the most blatantly powerful abilities or a very understated power, all in how you use it. A person with Reality Rift can tear holes in the fabric of reality connecting two locations; these holes do not close until something passes through them. These can either be huge gaping portals to space or tiny tears only big enough for a hand. One of the most suble ways to use this power is to create a rift just behind one door, walk though it, and come out another door.
summary: The ability to create portals in between locations
strengths: Fast, effective teleportation
No distance limit
Can be huge and epic or tiny and understated
weaknesses: Rifts don't close until something goes through
Must open first portal with hand
No physical powers

name: Temporal Rewind
description: Embarrassing moments--we all have one or two or ten in the course of our lives. Temporal Rewind can indirectly solve these. The user (through focused concentration) can reverse time and fix/avoid events. This means that you didn't break that glass, call her a man, or step in front of that taxi. The tricky thing about this power is that other people will cloudily remember the original event, not unlike deja vu. However, most people will pass it off as just that unless they know what to look for.
summary: The ability to reverse time back to a specific point
strengths: Resetting recent events
Redoing a fight
Preventing a death, fixing a conversation
weaknesses: Requires concentrated focus
30 minute maximum use at first
Headache can result from prolonged/intense use

name: Opportunity Repeat
description: This ability allows the user to be able to get the same opportunity again, if he failed to take it the first time or if you want to do it again. If you missed a dead line for a paper, this ability will open up that opportunity again. If you were a assassin who missed the perfect shot, this ability will make it so your target will be in the perfect spot to make that shot again, etc.
summary: The ability to repeat any opportunity that you or others were given.
strengths: Never miss a opportunity again
If mastered, you can make the opportunity came back instantly.
weaknesses: Without training, all the bad opportunities will keep showing up.
Without training, it will take time for an opportunity to return again.

name: All Good
description: All good is a passive, unconscious power that functions as a very specific manipulation of reality. Upon receiving this power, your entire future will be rewritten. You won't have direct control over how your life changes, but at the end of it, you are guaranteed to be able to look back on your life and say it was a good one.
summary: The ability to control reality unconsciously in accordance with your deepest desires.
strengths: Your life will be good.
The reality alteration will come from your own mind, and will be tailored specifically to what you consider a good life.
weaknesses: There's a side effect - you will forget receiving this power, and will never know you have it.
It resists all but the very strongest counters.

name: Universe Adaption
description: This ability is good for those who travel across the omniverse. The user will be able to absorb a bit the universe(that they are in)'s essence/theme. This will cause the users body to adapt in gaining abilities based on those essences/themes. For example, if the user would be in a universe were people have superpowers, the user will gain ability(s) that allows him to manipulate those abilities or increases the chance of gaining an ability(s) through different causes.
summary: The ability to gain a certain ability(s) depending on what universe, reality, or dimension you are in.
strengths: Gain ability(s)
This ability could also increase your chance in certain subject based on those worlds.
weaknesses: It is an active ability, you will have to activate it.
You have to have some form of travel to go to new worlds
Abilities last as long as you stay in that world

name: Superpower List Link
description: Want your powers in real life? Then participate in this experiment. According to the parallel universe theory, there should be a universe in existence where powers acquired on the site in this reality are acquired in reality there. If this power works, the holder will grant their powers to any alternate reality counterpart who knows of this power and wants the powers.
summary: The ability to gain the powers in your profile in real life.
strengths: Gain the powers in your profile.
If this power is negated, it's effect remains the same.
Even if this doesn't work, it is still a groundbreaking experiment.
weaknesses: No power of you own can affect this, not even Con Negation or Ability Cancellation.
Most likely won't work.
You have to acquire this power to use it -no power mimicry, reality manipulation, etc.

name: Data Manipulation Entity
description: Anyone with this power has a near god-like power to manipulate the universe. However, it can only be used for an object or in a closed space. A closed space is created by creating a large program to create a realm outside of normal reality. This power is limited because it needs large setup time and it cannot create something out of nothing. Normal use without closed spaces can range from increasing your own strength values to giving properties to items, such as homing capabilities
summary: The ability to manipulate the data of the universe
strengths: You have near god-like reality bending powers
You can change variables within objects or turn objects into other things
If you release your full power, you can also manipulate time
weaknesses: You cannot create anything new, you must use already existing objects
You can only use this power to manipulate small variables, unless you prepare a closed space
In order to activate full power, you must have the permission of the integrated thought entity

name: Cosmic Manipulation
description: Sure, their are people who can bend space and rip through time, but true power is in the stars. This ability allows you to manipulate cosmic energy and space matter. Cosmic energy is orange and can be manipulated into shapes or used as raw power. The surface of shaped cosmic energy looks like the bottom of a still pool, with lines wavering all around it. Space matter is things like meteors, black holes, comets, and stars. You can also fly through space unharmed. However, you cannot move planets.
summary: The ability to manipulate cosmic energy and space matter.
strengths: Manipulating and shaping cosmic energy
Controling space matter and space travel
Very, very powerful
weaknesses: Cannot move planets
Might accidently destroy a planet or star

name: Fortune/Misfortune Smiles Upon
description: This is a test of one's greed or thankfulness. You are able to bestow upon a person either riches or "Help Me" cardboard signs. You smile at a person who is poor and they will immediately become rich. But you can take it away from them at any time if they choose to be selfish, ungrateful and use their newfound wealth unwisely. As for the upper class, you can frown upon a person of greed and snob, making them lose their money and power. If they prove they can change ways, smile at them :D
summary: The ability to make people go from rags to riches and vice versa
strengths: Give someone a chance that they can give back to the world
weaknesses: Can't make yourself richer or poorer with the power

name: 5th Dimension Notebook
description: A person with this power has a notebook that can manipulate reality. The notebook has power over reality in anything below the 5th dimension-that means it affects both space and time. The user can either create characters or weapons in their notebook and bring them to life or change aspects of the real world to the words/pictures written. Pictures drawn in the notebook have more power. The book comes with a pen that has powers itself. The book has 100 pages and things written are permanent.
summary: The ability to have a notebook that you can use to manipulate reality
strengths: You can manipulate reality to a certain extent-creating heroes and weapons, etc.
It also comes with a pen to write with that can also function in the real world to draw doors
You can give the notebook a password so only you can use it
weaknesses: You only have 100 pages and there is a limit to what you can create-no omnipotent characters
You can't use it when it closes to recharge
Anyone can use it as long as they know the password and have the pen

name: Creation
description: The power of 'Creation' allows you to (once per day) create any object, creature, item, weapon, armor, vehicle (including spaceships), or place (like a house or city) that you can imagine. The object may be living or non-living, of nearly any size, of any complexity, and of any materials imaginable. The object will have all the abilities, attributes, traits, limitations and weaknesses that you 'assume it' to have. The object may be reality based: like a car, or fictional: a Star Ship Enterprise.
summary: The ability to create any object microscopic to global in size and in complexity
strengths: Gives you 'Godlike' power.
weaknesses: Before you can use 'Creation', you must have had the power 'object creation' for 2 years first.
You can only use this power once per day.
The created object may not be smaller than an atom, or larger than the planet earth.

name: Chronospheres
description: With this ability you gain the power to forms spheres in you hands. Inside these spheres time either moves faster, is slowed down, or completely stopped at your discretion. You may then fire the sphere, at which point it will expand to encompass whatever it hits. Spheres will remain until banished by the user.
summary: The ability to create spheres in which the flow of time is different.
strengths: Stop time in a certain radius.
Speed up time in a certain radius.
Slow time in a certain radius.
weaknesses: You are just as vulneable to the spheres as anyone else.
The spheres will encompass only what they hit.

name: Dimensions Of Fiction
description: In addition to our own home reality, an infinite number of alternate realities based upon the works of fiction exist. This power allows the user to open and close safe & stable interdimensional portals at will. These portals can be used to travel instantaneously to any point, place, & time within these alternate realities. They can take anyone & anything with them into and out of any of these alternate realities, and also back to one's home reality.
summary: The ability to open portals into alternate realities that are based upon the works of fiction
strengths: Alternate realities includes all forms of fiction portrayed in all forms of medium.
All alternate realities appear portrayed in live action, just like our home reality.
Can change events within any alternate realities and have adventures alongside your favorite heroes.
weaknesses: Might have bad experience in some dimensions.
Might change things for the worst within the dimensions, including our own.
Could bring evil villains or zombies home with you.

name: Game World Reality
description: The game must have a setting. Monopoly would just work. The game can be a board game, RPG, card, computer, online or miniatures. The nature laws of a game reality can be entirely based on the game rules or based on real world laws or somewhere in between. If you can die in the game you can die in the game world. Objects can't be taken from a game world. However you could bring 100 fire elemental miniatures to a D&D world and have a 100 elementals ready to serve you.
summary: The ability to create worlds in an alternate reality based on games.
strengths: A game where death never happens.
Actually live out your favorite game fantasies.
weaknesses: Any dangerous game realities. Warhammer 40000, Rifts, horror games.
You can't leave with objects found in the game reality.

name: Primalism (Primal Lord)
description: This infinite ancient power has existed since the very beginning of life and time itself. No one, not even Gods knows where this unimaginable force came from. It is rumored to be the power core of the cosmic balance called 'The Balance of Creation'. Becoming a Primal-Lord. One who is bestowed with this great power can create new life in the universe, revive anyone who is dead and start off any species evolution. With this power, he/she is considered to have God status.
summary: The ability to control and manipulate both the essence of life and evolution itself
strengths: Able to create any new life and give life to those that are deceased
Start off any species evolution
You'll be the deity of Life (also known as a Primal-Lord). So, you'll be very, very, very powerful.
weaknesses: Causes great cosmic calamity to creation itself if the user is too power crazy of being like a God
Reviving those who are evil (like Hitler) or a species that died out naturally (like the dinosaurs)
If you change the natural laws of life for the wrong reason, you'll be stripped off of this power

name: Omnilingual Translator
description: The user is able to translate any language in the known universe, no matter how obscure or ancient the language is. The user is able translate any language, however when the text is removed from the user, he has no recollection or any knowledge about the language he or she just translated. In a nutshell, the user cannot save the language and only can translate it.
summary: The ability to translate any language in the known universe
strengths: Good for archeologist on Earth
Good at determining alien languages
weaknesses: Not combat oriented

name: Destiny Alteration
description: The person with this power can change the future. At any given time you can activate the power, see the future and change it however you like. You start off by being able to change small events or affect a few people, but with training, you could change global or even universal events.
summary: The ability to change destiny
strengths: Can change any event.
Can stop some one from being destined to die.
weaknesses: Takes up lots of strength to change events on a grand scale.
You might make the world worse, but usually, if you are careful, it'll turn out okay

name: Reflexive Precognition
description: A person with this power can see a moment in time or action before it actually happens, giving them more time to react, making it appear as if they have amazingly quick reflexes.
summary: The ability to see moments in time before they happen
strengths: Amaze people with your reaction time.
Never make a wrong move.
Never be caught off guard.
weaknesses: You aren't surprised by anything anymore.

name: Mnemonic Reality Bending
description: If you have memories of good times gone, this power lets you go back, and relive them, or you can switch time so the event is yet to come. You can also bend reality to make your wildest and best dreams come true!
summary: The ability to manipulate time based on your memories and your dreams
strengths: Relive good times in your past
Make impossible things that you want to experience, happen
This power is only limited to your imagination!
weaknesses: If you're not creative, this power can be weakened
Sometimes it goes dormant if you can't remember good things that happened
This power is useless if you aren't the creative type

name: Cosmic String Manipulation
description: After getting this power, you can see the cosmic strings that form reality floating around everywhere. You cab change anything you want just by grabbing whatever the string is connected to and tugging it how you want it to be. However, you can only affect solid objects and liquids, and you have to be close enough to something to grab the string in order to affect it, and close enough to see it in order to pick something out in specific AND change it.
summary: The ability to bend reality by tugging on 'cosmic strings'
strengths: Can make the world be the way you want it.
Travel through time, space, and dimension. Transmute junk into anything you want.
Shapeshift into your ideal form, and mess with your own string to give yourself other powers.
weaknesses: Need to be close to the object; liquids are hard to manipulate and gasses are almost impossible.
While you will automatically get some proficiency with this, you can still mess things up.
Since you can not affect pure air, you need to make time/space/dimensional portals on a surface.

name: Fate Change
description: Gives you the ability to see into the future ten days. Once you know what will happen to you or someone else, you can choose to change it. Ex: If you see you will die in the future, you can change that event. This power cannot be stolen. You would either see the event of the power getting stolen taking place and change it. If someone goes back in time, it cannot be stolen in the past, unless they are in a time period where you exist and had not changed that time even earlier in the past.
summary: The ability to change the fate of you or others around you
strengths: Can live forever if you change your future so that you do not age, every ten days
Cannot be stolen.
Can make sure your enemy will die.
weaknesses: Must change your time in advance. If you are already dead, it is to late.
Would make an unstoppable villan.
Can be replicated

name: Information Absorption
description: Everything is written down somewhere. An Information Absorber knows this for sure. By merely staring at a CD, encyclopedia, video cassette, or even a carved stone slab, they can memorize the information on it. This memory fades 100 times slower than a regular memory. Some users have allowed themselves to become overloaded, mostly by trying to absorb the Internet.
summary: The ability to absorb information from CDs, books, etc.
strengths: Only need to stare at its surface
Fades 100 times slower than usual memories
Very large storage capacity
weaknesses: Need to look at its surface for as long as it takes
Memory will fade eventually
Not infinite; can be overloaded

name: Ultimate Version Telekinesis
description: With this power, you have telekinesis that can affect any part of the universe or all of the universe at once. The strength of the TK is equal to your own physical strength and is applied over the affected area.
summary: The ability to move anything in the universe as long as you know where it is
strengths: You have infinite range telekinesis
Your telekinesis lets you move things around the universe proportionally to your strength
If you concentrate on one point, your telekinesis strength is multiplied.
weaknesses: You can only focus on one part to do things, affecting the whole universe cancels itself
Does not come with omniscience or remote viewing and you must consciously control it
When concentrating on one object, you cannot defend yourself because you are too focused

name: Change Circles
description: With this power you can form a two dimensional circle in your hands, expanding it to any size you wish, before placing it on any large enough surface. You then state your desired change, such as "everything within the circle turns to gold" or "gravity within the circle is multiplied 100X. " This becomes true within the circle, and applies to everything encompassed by it. To destroy a circle, the user must take part of it and break it, causing the effect to cease. Only the user can do this.
summary: The ability to place circles on things that change one aspect of the world within them.
strengths: Rewrite any one aspect of the world within your circles.
weaknesses: The circles interperate things literally, so watch how you word your changes.
A circle can only be placed on a surface big enough to hold it.
Everything within the circle is effected by the change in a column extending forever.

name: Picture Extraction
description: For the ability to work, one must have a picture of any size with them. Proceed to use your free hand to touch the picture. Your free hand will "go into the picture's dimension" where you can pull the object out into our reality. Once the object is pulled out, the picture surface will turn blank and the object will appear and interact in our reality. One example is, if you wanted to pull out a hot and attractive woman from a picture, this ability will allow you to bring her out into our reality.
summary: The ability to pull any object from within a picture out into our reality.
strengths: Any object or person pulled out will retain its original features, dimensions, and attributes.
The user can use any command phrases such as "open sesame" to pull the object out.
weaknesses: If the picture surface is destroyed, the object extracted will permanently remain in our reality.
The user can use any command phrases such as "close sesame" to return the object into the picture.

name: Power Multiplex
description: This form of ability replication is rare. Unlike normal ability replication, this version of the power allows a person to hold onto multiple abilities right from the start, thus making it very useful. However, despite having many powers, you can only access them in 'sets' at any given time.
summary: The ability to replicate multiple abilities from others by physical contact
strengths: Hold onto more than one ability at a time, right from the start
You can switch between powers if you want, or even use them simultaneously!
Absorption takes no more than a few seconds
weaknesses: You have to touch a person to gain their power
You can only hold up to a maximum of nineteen abilities
You cannot take abilities such as empathic mimicry or other forms of power replication

name: Genesis Gem
description: It is the polar opposite to the Exodus Gem. It has the power to restore life and could create a universe in your image, but, whenever a timeline, a planet and/or a universe is destroyed, you can restore it to its natural state. Also, you can have a complete awareness and control over space, matter, energy, reality and time around you.
summary: The ability to use it to create your own universes and restore all life.
strengths: Could become a god.
weaknesses: None.

name: Shadow Seconds
description: This ability is for stealth or avoiding conflicts with enemies. The user makes themselves go to another plane of existence for a couple seconds. Like in Charmed, in that time, the user is in some kind of dimension where they can see and hear things but not interact with the normal world. Physics still applies (if you leave, go through a door), but while in non-existence, people (even psychics) and computers will not be able detect the user for those few seconds.
summary: The ability to be in another plane of existence so that the user won't be detected for a certain amount of seconds.
strengths: Stealth.
Avoid trouble.
Psychics won't spot you.
weaknesses: Physics still applies.
Lasts for a couple of seconds.

name: The Superpower List
description: Why have one when you can have them all? This ability allows you to gain every ability posted on superpowerlist.com . Every time a new one is added, that's yours now as well!
summary: The ability to gain abilities posted on "The Superpower List"
strengths: You get every power posted on the superpower list!
Conflicting abilities can be swapped at will between themselves.
weaknesses: A power must be added to the list before it is usable.
You don't know when you get a new power.
Powers you add don't count.

name: Omnicheat
description: Omnicheat is the ability to cheat anyone or anything in existense. This ability can cheat (but is not limited to) the following: games, rules, space/time, simensional separations, other abilities, logic, omniscience, omnipotence, mind body and spirit, magic, death, and your own limitations. This renders the totality of the universe's laws and other people's abilities virtually useless, void or unapplicable to the user.
summary: The ability to cheat on anyone or anything in existence whether physical, spiritual, psychic etc.
strengths: Cheat the rules of reality and all the forces in the universe
Cheat other abilities by simply changing how those abilities work on you or making them useless
You can even cheat death itself
weaknesses: Everybody hates cheaters.
You can cheat only ten times per day
Takes the fun out of everything you do because you can simply "cheat your way" to victory

name: Chemical Necessity Generation
description: The user can create chemicals that act as some of the necessities that living creates need to survive. They can create a chemical that a become a food like substance. They can satisfy anyone. Water and oxygen can be other things that can be made when none of it isn't around. Their is one issue with it. When the effects start to dissipate, the chemicals become a poisonous. Non-lethal, of course, but it can leave the one to use these chemicals become ill for short moments in time.
summary: The ability to create chemicals that act as necessities that any being needs to have to survive.
strengths: Create chemicals to use to survive
Eventually learn to manipulate
User will develop immunity to poison effects
weaknesses: Products will become poisonous while used

name: Super Time
description: Able to control the time vortex and gives super speed and strength
summary: The ability to control the time vortex.
strengths: can go back in time
Super speed
Can go into the vortex of space
weaknesses: Can disrupt the pfuture
Can change the past
Can kill you if used wrong

name: Chorokinesis
description: The ability to affect the dimension of space on a physical object or person. Its effect on the subject is similar to teleportation, it moves from one space to another without using time. (All other dimensions on the object stay the same--length, width, depth, and time). In other words, this ability allows you to teleport yourself and other objects instantaneously.
summary: The ability to control the dimension of space
strengths: Go anywhere you want.
Move anything you want so you don't need to move.
weaknesses: You cannot control any time aspects.
You could teleport into a solid object which would probably kill you.
Objects and people stay in the exact position they were in just a different place.

name: Accuracy
description: The ability to take any object, like a dagger, a throwing star or even a ball, and hit your target no matter where you throw it. So, you could throw something right, but if your target's on the left, it turns left. Unfortunately, you have to be able to focus on the object and where it's going to hit.
summary: The ability to hit something no matter where it is
strengths: Will never miss a target
Bend laws of physics
Able to join a lot of sports and be the best
weaknesses: Wouldn't use a gun; hard to focus on a bullet
Your emotions might distract you

name: Dimensional Room Upgrade
description: When you use this power on an enclosed space, the inside of the area becomes a new dimension that is larger on the inside than on the outside. The dimension inside will be an upgraded version of whatever was in the area previously. So, if you upgrade a kitchen, you could have a kitchen of any size with appliances and supplies, even if they were not in there originally. You can have multiple dimensions inside the created dimension, such as if you used it on a house and then on rooms in the house.
summary: The ability to make an upgraded dimension inside an enclosed space that is an upgraded version of that space.
strengths: As much space as you need.
Have a really awesome house.
Larger dimensions may have more interesting things inside them.
weaknesses: People will want you to continuously make dimensions for them.
Cannot make dimensions smaller than the enclosed space.
Have to have some stuff in enclosed space or you'll just get a big empty box.

name: Card Stack Abilities: Queen
description: Access the power of the elemental spirit of space in order to completely control the third dimension. Create wormholes out of thin air and alter the space around an object to make it explode or compress into an atom. Create barriers out of space or warp to a different area to avoid an attack. Basically anything that involves space, you have control over it.
summary: The ability to completely control space
strengths: The ability to warp anywhere you want.
Absolute control over space.
Make your enemies compress or explode with a single thought.
weaknesses: Accidentally destroying everything around you because of a space distortion
People with the Card Stack Ability: Jester are not affected by your powers
Con 2 is only valid when they are of an equal of higher power level.

name: Lawless
description: Laws are very pesky things. This power is like a law-begone. It allows you to break ANY law, without facing any consequences. Depending on what kind of law you're breaking, this power will act in different ways. Saying you are robbing a store. This might erase the memories of your face or simply blur your image while commiting the crime. But this doesn't stop there. You can also break physical laws, like gravity and friction. If you are daring, you might go as far as breaking the universal laws.
summary: The ability to break any law, free of consequences.
strengths: Never, ever get in trouble.
Can consciously choose which law you want to break.
weaknesses: You never know how exactly this power might save you from the consequences

name: Superhuman Awareness
description: Falling. Tripping. Missing the last step on the stairs. Missing the first step on the stairs. Superhuman Awareness ensures that its holder never has to worry about these things. A person with it can sense where everything around them is, and how far away it is. This grants them an amazing sense of balance, extraordinary accuracy (judging distances), and a good idea of all weapons and exits. With time, this ability can sense weaknesses. However, this ability needs at least a glance at the area.
summary: The ability to be perfectly aware of your surroundings
strengths: Enhanced accuracy (accurate distance judging)
Enhanced balance (know just how much to lean)
A good idea of where the exit is
weaknesses: Requires at least a glance at the area
No other superhuman attributes
Might not be able to dodge in time still

name: Create Cosmic Gizmo
description: With this power, you could hold together with rubber bands an egg beater and a box knife and control gravity. This power will give your gizmos control or manipulation powers. Gizmos can also have powers like time travel, force field, teleportation, quantum intangibility or any similar powers. Your gizmo must have one moving part and you must be turning this part to make the gizmo work. The Imagination Crusher power will stop this power. Technology control powers won't work on any gizmo you make.
summary: The ability to create cosmic objects that only work for you and have certain powers.
strengths: Gadgets that only work for you and are unaffected by technology control powers.
Control the forces of the universe with things found in your home.
weaknesses: The Imagination Crusher power.
If you can't think like a child, this power may not work.
Someone who could paralyze you.

name: Advanced Dimensional Control
description: By absorbing energy from large temporal rifts, the user of universal dimensional control can create a dimension which he or she can control to an extent and when finished, destroy it. Also they have the Ability to move from any dimension at will. Unforutunaly; this leads to self-inflicted harm which can lead to fatal wounds and death due to the required energies to create a parallel dimension. Also the user cannot create life forms using this power or send items from one dimension to another.
summary: The ability to create, control and destroy parallel Dimensions
strengths: You can create your own Parallel dimension to control like a god.
You may change any aspect of it at will and move to different dimensions.
And then destroy any you have made, thus returning to the Main dimension.
weaknesses: The user can die from creating Parallel dimensions.
Life or new elements or Compounds cannot be made using the Parallel dimensions
And Temporal energy is required for one to be created; something the user does not have.

name: Jack
description: Blatantly steal superpowers, positions of power, skills, items, significant others. Someone's got a better power than you? A better car? A better life? Jack'em. Look them in the eye and say Jack, tell them what you are taking and it can all be yours. You're not only rewriting history, you're remaking reality.
summary: The ability to jack anyone for powers, position, IQ, skills or significant others.
strengths: Jack superpowers, IQ, skills, jobs instantly. IQ and skills are yours forever.
Possessions such as weapons, property, vehicles, armor, degrees, etc.
You can even Jack significant others, girlfriends, boyfriends, friends and family
weaknesses: Powered abilities and jobs supplant each other. Must be sure you want to lose what you have.
IQ and skills are instantly learned giving you a killer headache each time you Jack someone
Each thing must belong to someone before you Jack it. Cannot jack human senses.

name: Upgrade
description: This power can only be used once for every year you have been alive each day. I. E. If you are 15 you can use it 15 times each day until you turn 16. You can upgrade things together but not apart and not everything will come out cool if you do,like a pencil-fridge would not be very useful. Broken stuff will be fixed
summary: The ability to make any item one step better than it is
strengths: Can turn the "rest" into the "best"
Can upgrade things together
Could eventually become cyborg
weaknesses: Can't split them back apart (might be a bad idea to combine people)
People will wonder how you traded your ps1 for a ps3
Limmited number of uses

name: Monthly Wish
description: This lets you get 1 wish on the first week of every month that will come true. At midnight of the day a week after the start of the month the wish is gone... No stockpiling to have 2 in the next month... Also this wish can not harm the earth intentionally (no blowing up the planet) and can only affect one person directly (your wish is for someone to die this would only directly affect that person... But you couldnt do an earthquake cause would harm/affect several people)
summary: The ability to get one wish at the beginning of every month
strengths: Every month you get one wish you want that will come true
You could do or get almost any one thing you want
Anything with lasting effects lasts until end of month
weaknesses: It only lasts until the end of the month if it has a lasting effect
Cannot directly harm more than one person or the earth
Only get to choose a wish at the first week of the month (till midnight start of 8th day of month)

name: The Light Side Of The Force
description: The Force is an energy field created by all living things, that surrounds and penetrates living beings and binds the galaxy together. Jedi can harness this energy for any purpose from telekinesis to mind control and beyond. The ability to connect to the Force is related to the concentration of Midi-chlorians in one's cells.
summary: The ability to harness the natural energy of life for nearly infinite uses.
strengths: You get an awesome lightsaber
You can lie during droid hunts
You can throw people with your mind
weaknesses: Sith, stormtoopers, droids, bounty hunters, and giant worm-people try to kill you
You can never marry
The government expects you to do all of the front-line fighting in every conflict

name: Inthinkieous Createomious
description:
You can think anything to happen and it does. You have an english paper to type up? Just think it. Dog has to go out, just think it and done. Its usefull in every situation. Have a few extra pounds? 
BOOM! 
not anymore!
summary: The ability to think things to reality
strengths: You can complete tedious tasks without moving
Create unworldly inventions
Be a hero
weaknesses: You have to have logic behind the imagination(Like the english paper has to be written by you in
order for you to think it typed)
You learn no life values or skills

name: Temporal Sense Manipulation
description: A person with this power can alter anyone's sense of time. For example, they can make it feel like an hour while it has only been a minute. In addition, you can temporarily freeze their sense of time, leaving them staring blankly still stuck at that moment. Conversely, you can also accelerate people's sense of time to give them sensory framerate acceleration - in fact, you can even make their sense of time go faster than their body can handle.
summary: The ability to alter a biological objects sense of time
strengths: Make it look like you can stop time
Can make plants blossom early - fool the biological clock
Can grant people sensory framerate acceleration
weaknesses: Cannot stop a bullet or speed/inertia
Physics still applies
Mental strain in doing this - needs practice to alter for longer periods

name: A Z Powers
description: With this power you can have a power from each letter of the alphabet. The power has to be on this site and if you decide to change one of your power for another of that letter (i. E. Switching Acid Pee for Ability Snatch) all of your powers are changed to a different one from their respective letters. You cannot have a power that starts with a number or symbol (! Or 5 Faces Of Darkness).
summary: The ability to have one power from each letter of the alphabet
strengths: You can get 26 powers one for each letter of the alphabet
weaknesses: If you change one of your powers all of your powers are changed
The power has to be on this site
You can't get a power that starts with a symbol or number

name: Reality Cube
description: Also known as Inconsequential Omnipotence or the Virtual Room, this power gives the user omnipotence, but the user is confined within a 1-mile radius when activated and any changes are always undone when the power is deactivated. Also, the power will deactivate anyway over time. The only thing that people can keep is personally gained knowledge or skills. Mainly uses for illusionary purposes or training. The cons cannot be negated by any power.
summary: The ability to create your own reality within a 1-mile radius and bring other people into it
strengths: Inside the other reality, you control everything. Also, the time is slower than outside time.
You can use it to simulate training for your other powers-nothing gets destroyed in real life.
Learn other people's powers and weaknesses by testing them and hide your real powers.
weaknesses: The reality cube will crumble because of the surrounding reality.
After the reality cube crumbles, everything returns back to normal-like nothing ever happened.
Can't really kill anyone, heal anyone, etcetera-none of the real things that omnipotence gives you.

name: Power Of The Star
description: The person who has this power is able to use the power that is generated from the stars in the sky ( your own sun in the solar system does not count). The more stars in the sky the more powerful the user becomes. For example a starry night on Earth will result in the user having the ability to fly and shoot energy bolts. In space, the user will have the ability to fly, shoot energy bolts, super strength and invulnerability. The star light can be saved to be used in the day, but sparingly
summary: The ability to use starlight to gain superpowers
strengths: Stars are present almost frequently in the night sky
At night, dont need to worry about losing powers
weaknesses: During the day you have limited star light reserve
Once reserve runs out, no powers

name: Perfect Escape Route
description: A person with this power has the ability to escape from anything. This ability activates subconciously when the user is in a state of fear or acknowledges that they have no chance of winning. When that happens, something unexpected happens that gives them an opportunity to escape or they gain knowledge that lets them figure out an escape route.
summary: The ability to escape from anything every time
strengths: You can escape death situations or homework assignments or an angry spouse
When you escape, it is near impossible to pursue
Tactical retreat
weaknesses: You can't choose the method of escape
Useless in a fight except to run away
Your friends will hate you for running away

name: Hypertime Chronopathy
description: Hypertime is a quantum-physical dimension of time that flows faster than anything normal humans can perceive. In fact, most superhumans can't perceive it. Except you. Possessing this power, you can sense anything currently moving in hypertime, as well as when they enter/exit it. Superspeeders look like normal runners, and no attempt to manipulate time will escape your radius of superhuman temporal perceptions. In addition, your reflexes will allow you to react to anything you sense in hypertime.
summary: The ability to perceive events in hypertime
strengths: Perceive things in hypertime (perceive superspeeders, immune to time manipulation)
Speed is doubled (low-level Superhuman Speed) and get Superhuman Reflexes
You can keep the power active as long as you like, and turn the power on/off at will
weaknesses: Hypertime perception only allows reflexes and speed to heighten a little
Weaker superhumans may shift into hypertime perception against their will
If hypertime perception is really sensitive, time manipulation/travel will provide MAJOR headaches

name: Universal Mix Up
description: Using this power, you can change reality by swapping the elements of other, alternate universes. Here's an example: You are walking down the street, and you slip on a banana peel, which knocks you into the street. You then get hit by a truck and are sent to the hospital. With this power, you can swap the moment in time when you slip on the banana peel in this universe with a moment from an alternate universe where you don't step on the banana peel at all, altering reality in your favor.
summary: The ability to change reality by altering the elements of parallel universes.
strengths: Dodge every attack aimed at you, even if you're clumsy and feeble.
Always win battles, even against the strongest heroes.
There are an unlimited number of parallel universes to choose from and swap with.
weaknesses: The people from other universes may despise you if they figure out your secret.

name: Multi Physics Planets Creator
description: With this power, you start by making a universe different to our own. You will always be able to access this universe with this power. Now, you make planets and star systems. However, every planet you make has a different set of laws of physics than the next. You might go to a planet that has a small star orbiting as a moon, and then travel to a cube-shaped planet. You cannot control what the laws of physics will be, you just know that they will be different to the last.
summary: The ability to make planets with different laws of physics.
strengths: Make a universe with multiple laws of physics.
Interesting holiday destinations.
You will always be able to access and travel through the universe with this power.
weaknesses: Random laws of physics, meaning you can't control what they will be.
Could get lost - Are you good at making maps of the universe?
Bad if someone deactivates this power, even momentarily.

name: Destination Tag
description: A person with this power can manipulate reality to send anything to anywhere within 24 hours. They would need to write the address or coordinates on the object and this will manipulate reality to cause a series of events that will end up with the object in the location in 24 hours. This includes sending it to other star systems if you got the coordinates right. If you write 2 addresses on an object, the object will somehow break apart into 2 objects.
summary: The ability to write an address or coordinates on any object and it will reach there in exactly 24 hours
strengths: No need to pay for shipping
Cannot trace you back since the way it gets there is random
Can even send to other star systems as long as you got the coordinates right
weaknesses: Wrong Address(no way for returns)
If you write 2 addresses on an object that object will break apart into 2 with the 24 hours
Hazards of shipping(ie your object may get destroyed along the way)

name: Quantum Procrastination
description: In quantum physics, a single particle, such as an electron, can follow all possible paths as long as it is not observed. You can apply this to a limited extend on a macro scale and avoid problems with observers. You follow two paths; if you did and did not procrastinate.
summary: The ability to procrastinate while simultaneously performing your intended task.
strengths: Get work done no matter what.
Can be turned on and off at will.
Even achieve the physical effects of doing a task, such as losing weight or developing muscle.
weaknesses: You cannot do anything with this power except avoid the effects of procrastination.
You are still limited to one non-procrastination task.
Not as useful for those who are self-motivated.

name: Bubbles Of Unreality
description: This allows you to create a "bubble" in which you can control anything you want, and bring yourself and others inside. You could spend years in the "bubble" without any time passing in the real world. There would be no permanent physical effects when someone leaves, but they would remember everything that happened like it was a dream, and retain any skills they learned. This does not include any musculature needed to perform the skill, just the knowledge of how to do it.
summary: The ability to create temporary mini-worlds outside of our time and space.
strengths: You have a place to think or relax whenever you want it.
You always have time to learn new skills.
You can live out fantasies or express frustration without permanent consequences
weaknesses: You cannot directly affect the real world.
You might live out your ideal life, and then have to return to this one.
Could be addictive.

name: Pan Dimensional Existence
description: Use this power and every dimension that can harbor an intelligent existence will suddenly have a version of you. A heavenly version, a hellish version, a nightmare dimension version, a kystian version, etc. This power doesn't make versions of you in every timeline in this dimension or other dimensions. You can communicate with these other versions of yourself, one at a time only. You can visit them with a dimensional travel power and they won't be hostile to you.
summary: The ability to exist in every dimension where intelligence can exist.
strengths: Insider knowledge of other dimensions.
weaknesses: If the heavenly version of you and the hellish version of you met...
If a kystian version of you meets any of the non-kystian versions of you.
If someone forces you to communicate with all versions of you at the same time.

name: Superhuman Pilot
description: A person with this power can drive any vehicle extremely well and give "superhuman" abilities to the vehicle they are driving. They have an aura that covers the vehicle they are piloting. They can drive any vehicle well from cars, to tanks, to mechs, to spaceships. Any vehicle they drive can be driven faster and has more power. Also, they do not need gas. The user has full control of their vehicle at all times and are able to pull off extremely hard maneuvers.
summary: The ability to drive any vehicle extremely well without former training and also give a vehicle superpowers
strengths: You can drive very well
Your vehicles will have superhuman abilities (more speed, power, bulletproof, break physics)
You never need gas
weaknesses: No powers unless in a vehicle
Vehicle can still be destroyed

name: Lunar Invincibility
description: If you have this power, you can do anything you want while the full moon or new moon is out
summary: The ability to do anything you want during a full or new moon
strengths: Do whatever you want
Be more extremely powerful than any other human
Impossible to be defeated 2 nights in a month
weaknesses: Can only use this power on a full or new moon
If not trained properly, you can't use this power when the moon is blocked (by clouds)

name: Aging Loop
description: You get to an age in your life when you feel too old. You will loop back to your age of choice and begin again. This will continue for as many loops as possible. You are semi immortal. Age and disease will not kill you but anything else that can, will.
summary: The ability to reach a certain physical age and then revert back to a younger age.
strengths: Live young, forever possibly,,,,,,
Age and Disease can never get to you.
weaknesses: Kill can mean killed in many other ways.
You cannot loop back when you want. The aging loop must be over 20 year span. 20 to 40 for example.
Your mind ages like everyone else. When you're 120, in you're mind you'll be a crabby old man.

name: Time Extension
description: This ability grants the users the ability to isolate theirselves from the effects of time. In this way, you'll have more time to do whatever you want to do: more times for deadlines, sleep more, travel further etc. Think like Guldo's power, but without holding your breath. You must know what you use it for, like travelling to a certain destination. Then it will end and time will resume, unless you let time resume before that.
summary: The ability to produce more time for actions
strengths: You now have an extended deadline since you can still finish that report in 0 seconds
1 way time travel
weaknesses: This power is limited by a person's age since you cannot freeze yourself in time
Can lose track of time

name: Save
description: You can save your life just like you would save in a game and you can then later "re-load" this save if you so choose.  This immediately sends you back in time to when and where you were when you saved.  You retain anything you may have learned before you re-loaded however you do not retain any injuries or other physical trauma you might have experienced.
summary: The ability to save your life as you would save a game.
strengths: Can't make a bad choice
Always correct
Can avoid death
weaknesses: Must save in advance

name: Spatial Storage
description: Between this dimension and the next, small pockets form. You have gained the ability to open a rip into them, but not fully into a new dimension. Your ability only lets you open a rip from your location into said dimension, however you have more than one "Pocket" and you can have more than one rip open at once. Such as, you could turn one pocket into an office, and have the rip in a janitor's closet back in the office building, but when the person walks in, the door leads to your office.
summary: The ability to temporarily open a rip in reality into a small pocket dimension.
strengths: Could be used to have a portable inventory of weapons to choose from.
If you're fast enough, could send bullets to a pocket dimension instead of hitting you.
Can be used for transportation.
weaknesses: Rips can only be opened at your current location
Transportation would require you having been to your destination and leaving a rip.
Requires energy to make a rip, but sustaining rips is very easy.

name: Dimensional Double Life
description: This ability is good for spies, warriors in battle, or some lazy bums. This ability into two duplicates. One duplicate is the one that lives in our universe, doing regular thngs and stuff. The other duplicate is in that parallel universe where no one can see or hear you. That duplicate's job is to perform the user's true intention or objectives. That duplicate is hidden in that universe so nothing could stop it. This parallel dim. Is different. The duplicate can interect in both worlds. See pro2
summary: The ability to split into two parallel selves in order for one to perform the user's true intentions while hidden.
strengths: Perform your true intention without interruption.
The other duplicate interects physically through touch by choice. If not, he phase through stuff.
When objection is complete, the two unite.
weaknesses: Dimensonal abilities or device could find the other duplicate.

name: Bi Time
description: This ability was inspired by the word "Bilocation", to be in two places at once. This ability allows its user to live in two time periods at once. The user of today can also be seen in the past or future as well. They are the same person. They think, feel, and act the same, but with possible forms of mannerisms depending on the time period they are in. This has future changing capabilities. If the one of users died, The other as well. Since, they are the same person.
summary: The ability to be in two different time periods at once.
strengths: Be in two different time periods at once
Manipulate the future
weaknesses: The time period the user is in is random unless one of them has a time machine.
When one dies, the other dies as well.

name: Ambient Temporal Field
description: This power can create a field of "ambient time" around things or people. In a place where no time exists the field can allows the user to move freely, because they have their own time to rely on. The field itself is influenced by the user and can change depending on their will. It can also isolate things, like a room, from the effects of time or isolate anything but the thing/room from the effect of time. So you can choose to let time pass inside or outside the field.
summary: The ability to generate a field of ambient time around things and people.
strengths: A personalized field of time.
Can act as protection in an area with no time AND can protect against time freezes.
Exclude things from time
weaknesses: Time manipulators can still manipulate your field.
If your stuck in a place without time AND space.

name: Light Bridge
description: The user can create a path a light between two locations. The path must be connected to an object at two opposite ends though to form a bridge. If the points the bridge is connected to is moved the bridge dissipates. The light bridge can be used as a shield or to cut through objects that are located between the two points. The user must see where to place the light bridge. Only a limited number of bridges can be created at one time.
summary: The ability to make a solid path of light between two points.
strengths: Create a path between two locations.
Can be used as a shield or to cut through objects in the bridge's way.
The light bridge will stay until it is deactivated or broken.
weaknesses: Has to be connected at two points, so no platforms in the air.
Can be destroyed by breaking the points the bridge is connected to.
Only a few light bridges can be produced at one time.

name: Fourth Dimensional Existence
description: We live in a 3-D world. But there are more D's than meet the eye. A person with this ability exists in 4 dimensions. This allows them to do many feats, like stand outside the 3rd dimension and thus become invisible and intangible, knock people into the 4th dimension, see inside people's bodies, defy natural laws, and do many other impossible acts. If you need an analogy, think of a 3-D man interacting with a 2-D universe.
summary: The ability to exist in the fourth spatial dimension
strengths: Do the impossible
Multiple applications (invisibility, intangibility, etc.)
Can find many mysteries of the universe
weaknesses: May alienate you from our dimension
May become cold and detached
Can lose some emotional capacity

name: Attunement To Time
description: This power makes the user totally attuned to time and temporal energy, as well as time being attuned to them (consciously and unconsciously). This means that the user's thoughts are rapidly acted out by time, this even applies to subconscious thoughts. This means that not only will the time be like an extra limb to the user but it will change rapidly like they themself had been going to in the first place. In addition, the user can sense some of the nuances of time (being attuned to it).
summary: The ability to be totally attuned to time and temporal energy.
strengths: You can rapidly and easily change time.
Time has a tendency to protect you (due to a subconscious need to survive).
You can sense the nuances of time and how it flows.
weaknesses: If the user's internal clock is messed up, then time will act differently for them.
Similarly, if the user has a different perception of time, then that will be what time is for them.
Time even acts to SUBCONSCIOUS thoughts.

name: Tele Grabbing
description: What if you had the ability to grab food, clothes, even money out of the TV and make it reality? If you're hungry you can just walk up to the TV, grab a pizza and eat it right then and there in your own living room! Now THAT'S room service! And since whatever you grab will be duplicated, the object will be in your hand as well as the TV. And no one will notice
summary: The ability to grab anything out of the TV
strengths: You don't have to wait to get what you want
The bigger the TV, the bigger the object you can pull out
No one in the TV notices you grabbing objects
weaknesses: You can't grab objects larger than your TV
When grabbing out of the TV, you may grab something you didn't want
You can't stick your entire body in the TV

name: Take Over
description: This power allows you to take a persons power when the person is beaten by you in any competition, allowing you to have multiple powers in your arsenal at the same time.
summary: The ability to take another persons power when you beat them
strengths: Multiple powers at once
An edge of suprise for enemies in small competitions
weaknesses: If your first competion is a fight, your power is useless
Your opponent will be pissed at you if you take his/her power
Accounts even for small competitions like rock, paper, scissors

name: Pictomancy
description: The ability to draw a picture and have it happen. Draw a scene, it happens. Draw a new creature, it now exists. Draw someone dead, then they're dead.
summary: The ability to draw a picture and have it come to life/ happen
strengths: Bend reality easily
Can redesign self to change look and give powers.
Can redesign others to change look and other things
weaknesses: Need artist skill
Must draw an entire scene
Not meant for battle

name: Time    Bubbles
description: With this power you can make a bubble of time that you can control.
summary: The ability to stop, fast foword, rewind, ect in a certain radius or bubble
strengths: Make plants grow faster
Make people run slower faster ect
You are not affected
weaknesses: Time only affected in that bubble

name: Keys Of Infinity: Space Key
description: Take the key and twist it in the air of in a keyhole. If done in the air, a door will appear. Think of a place (not a time, not a dimension, it will only get confused and spit you out somewhere), and open the door. If you go through the door, you will be at the place you thought of. *Can be used with the Time Key and Dimension Key to create the Key of Infinity
summary: The ability to go anywhere using a magical key artifact
strengths: You can go anywhere!
Can be combined with Time Key and/or Dimension key to make the Key of Infinity
Mess with your freinds by apparing next to them!
weaknesses: Can only go places, not times or dimensions
Might take a bit of time for the door to appear, so if you're in a fight, then you shouldn't use it

name: Time Multiply/Divide
description: You could manipulate the laws of time by multiplying or dividing to give youself more or less time to do whatever is possible. You can throw your glowing hourglass up to the heavens to multiply or divide time, multiplying time means to give you much more hours and dividing time means to give you less hours.
summary: The ability to manipulate time by multiplying or dividing.
strengths: You could make others early or late.
weaknesses: You might waste your own time goofing off.

name: Universal Flow
