description: With this you can redirect, bend, and sometimes create energy and other universal substances. You can cause a cataclysmic universal disruption as an attack or redirect a solar flare. You can even affect the universe's other features, like time and space to a certain amount.
summary: The ability to control the flow and partial effect of energy, matter and others.
strengths: Be one of the most powerful beings ever!
weaknesses: It might go to your head.
Have an immensely hard time with things people are controlling.

name: Thread Manipulation
description: A person with this power has the ability to manipulate any thread or string both physical and abstract. Although the user starts out only able to manipulate simple things like rope and clothes. With greater practice they can manipulate even abstract things like the red thread of fate. Also it may even be possible for the user to control all forms of matter using string theory.
summary: The ability to manipulate any type of thread or string
strengths: Can manipulate abstract strings as well
Strangle enemies, undo buttons, and manipulate string cheese!
Can't be tied up with rope
weaknesses: Can only manipulate thread----which isn't a problem if string theory is true
Needs to have full control to use the more powerful aspects of this power

name: Instant Meal
description: With this power you can have a meal to appear whenever you want. You can choose any one drink, one side, one main and a dessert at any time of the day you want wherever you are. You can use this power only once every five hours and you can only have one of the above mentioned things, no seconds, no refills on anything.
summary: The ability to cause a meal to appear whenever you want
strengths: You can have a hot meal whenever you want provided it's been at least 5 hours since you last used it
You get one drink, one main, one side and one dessert
weaknesses: You can only use this power once every five hours
No seconds or refills on anything

name: Obliteration
description: Also called Decrescence (Inducing), Olivion (Inducing) or Existence Negation, this is the psychic ability to make foes literally fade away, with a touch. One on whome this ability has been used will slowly begin to fade away, until he exists outside of space-time, and thus cannot interact with this or any other reality (so he dies; he still has physiological needs, but can't meet them). This cannot be undone by anyone except the user or someone else with the same ability.
summary: The ability to delete matter from existence with a touch
strengths: Your touch is lethal (affect living, dead and inanimate matter)
Only activates with deep feelings of anger (no accidentally obliterating friends or loved ones)
When obliterated, everybody (but you) immediately forgets they ever existed
weaknesses: Requires a touch (sometimes prolonged touch or numerous touches)
If it requires a prolonged touch contact and you lose contact, they fade back in
If your power is uncontrolled, you can cause matter to be obliterated unintentionally

name: Artistic Realization
description: You HAVE to include a name somewhere around your drawing or it wont come to life! And your creation only stays for 24 hours, then it turns into dust, unless you draw a certain time limit for it.
summary: The ability to draw things to life.
strengths: You can bring your imagination to life, any time you wanted!
You don't need paper, pencils, paint, or anything to draw, just use your finger!
You can make your fav cartoon characters or make new friends!
weaknesses: It takes time to draw.
If you can't draw that well this wouldn't really be a good power for you.
If a creation meant to live, falls in love, it automaticly desolves into dust.

name: Instant Storage
description: This power enables you to make anything disappear into your own private pocket dimension by touching them and to make them reappear out of it whenever you want - this includes living beings. That dimension therefore becomes some sort of storage compartment. Moreover, time won't flow inside it, meaning things won't evolve, degrade, grow or die while in it. This power also helps you remember everything you are currently storing in that dimension.
summary: The ability to make anything disappear and reappear whenever wanted
strengths: You can travel lightly while keeping everything you need with you.
There are no limits to what or how much you can store
weaknesses: You can steal anything you want with this ability...
You can make your enemies disappear but they'll remain in your memory.

name: Shadow Reality
description: While in the darkness, you become unstoppable. You can do anything and everything while in the shadows, destroying the laws of physics and making anything possible. You can change all that is around you, and become invincible. This becomes easier the darker the area that you're in. The lighter the area that you are inside, or are trying to manipulate, the more difficult it becomes to do this.
summary: The ability to bend reality while in the darkness
strengths: The potential is limitless for you while in the darkness
You still have a small flicker of power in the sunlight
You can draw shadows closer to you when you need them
weaknesses: Everything that you create is dark and sinister
You have almost no power in the light
Shadows may occasionally twist or bend around you

name: Tesseract
description: By being able to control a way into the fourth dimension, and be able to control the environment there and the movement of all objects in it, you have a near-infinite space. To an observer, you can make anything simply disappear at will. You store it in your fourth-dimensional space, and can bring it back at will. Since the space available is virtually unlimited, you are limited only by how much mass you can shift in one use of the power.
summary: The ability to access and control a pocket of fourth-dimensional space
strengths: A safe way to move large numbers of people. Rescue whole crowds; turn attackers into prisoners.
Transport whole trainloads of goods by any means that can accomodate one passanger.
No more problems with airline luggage or moving companies anymore.
weaknesses: It may take some effort to 'hold' items in the tesseract, putting a time limit on large holds.
The temptation to become a smuggler would be nigh-irresistible.
If you aren't the only one able to access this particular dimension, some of your goods could go mis

name: Assumption Reality
description: This ability allows the user warp the reality of people, things, and even concepts by assuming what they are to the user;literally or metaphorically. They can even use the ability on themselves to make them more powerful.
summary: The ability to change reality based on one's assumptions.
strengths: Change Reality through your assumptions of it.
Can be literally or metaphorically.
Only use the assumptions that you want.
weaknesses: The effects will wear off in time.

name: Celestial Light Pulse
description: Unlike Terrestrial Light Pulse, you can rejuvenate stars, create stars from a distance, and make vegetation become everlasting. Even when they are cut off, or are in the middle of a desert with no nutrients. Make them impervious to even atomic bombs. You can even revive anybody from death (even after severe deterioration). You can also grant mortal animals and humans different forms of mortality, even total immortality.
summary: The ability to use the Divine Light pulse of every energy in the universe
strengths: You can make rejuvenate things permanently (at will).
You can create, regenerate, and replicate forms of any energy that gives off warmth and light.
You can bring people from the dead and grant them eternal youth, durable life span, or immortality.
weaknesses: Most christian churches would cast you out.
Don't let pride go to your head
Be wise before using this.

name: Temporal Snatch
description: This ability is mostly used to get more time. You need to touch a person and freeze them in place. During that time, you can either pause, increase or rewind time, depending on how long you froze someone to the future. You can only freeze them for up to 3 days (giving you a maximum of 72 extra hours). You "steal" their time, as it were, to gain more time yourself or manipulate time..
summary: The ability to freeze someone in time for up to 3 days to the future to gain more time in the present.
strengths: Send someone to the future.
You can either pause, increase, or rewind time.
weaknesses: Can only freeze them for up to 3 days.
Can only get the same amount of time as how long they remain frozen.

name: Encompandentia Infinita
description: When you say "Adeat", you and everyone else of your choosing will be transported to a barrier dimension that has infinite space. Basically, it's a room with no exits.
summary: The ability to create a giant barrier dimension that has infinite space.
strengths: No one can escape unless you say so.
Can control the laws of physics inside of the dimension (EX: gravity).
weaknesses: Can be broken through if you're not calm.

name: Lightsaber Spawn
description: With this power you can make a lightsaber of any color you want appear out of nowhere in order to fight (or commit) crime. The lightsaber works the same way a lightsaber in the Star Wars universe would making it extremely powerful and deadly. When you're done with the lighsaber you can make it disappear again
summary: The ability to make a lightsaber appear out of nowhere
strengths: You can have a lighsaber at any time
Lighsabers are very powerful weapons
It can be any color you want
weaknesses: You can only summon one at a time

name: Quantum Intangibility
description: When using this power, one can become intangible to a number of specific things at once. The easiest being able to phase through matter, then levels of intangibility are possible: desities of matter, light, weak forces, gravity, strong forces, then even to the point of time. You remain intact by intrensic forces. There are levels of concentration to keep yourself solid at places and time, and intangeble at others.
summary: The ability to not be affected by forces in this dimension
strengths: You can unmaterialize before getting hit
You can simulate flying and invisibility
You can share this power with those around you
weaknesses: You sometimes have to concentrate to keep youself solid; shaking hands might be difficult at times
If you materialize in solid matter, you lose that part
When you become invisible, you can't see

name: Force Construct
description: The user is able to make weapons, objects, and even toys out of forces. Unlike elemental or any other construct, the force construct applies the properties of the force. A gravity- based construct by my guess would be the heaviest thing on the planet, capable of cause the same amount in damage. The user is able to wield the construct of any kind without any difficulty. Look under the definition of forces or check the fundamental forces to get the idea.
summary: The ability to create objects out of forces.
strengths: Different effects for different force construct
Create constructs out of forces
weaknesses: May deplete source of the force (No Pun Intended! )

name: Chronos's Gift: Pool Of Youth
description: This power allows you to create the Fountain of Youth anywhere or anytime in the palms of your hands. With this power you can turn back the hands of time and cure any diseases that you or others might have. The amount of time you de-age is totally up to you.
summary: The ability to create the fountain of youth in your hands
strengths: Never grow old
Immortal
Can share with other people
weaknesses: Have to have hands
You have to decide how many years the water has to take off

name: Reality's Language
description:
When ever you you say something in any foreign language(any language other than your first)it will happen insantly.You can do anything as long as you now the words.The bad part is that you have to use a foreign language which can be hard to learn. But if you learn the words "teach me this language" it will help a lot. 
You can learn a lot of languages this way.
summary: The ability to change reality useing foreign languages.
strengths: Very powerful and useful.
You can learn a lot of languages.
Easy to control.
weaknesses: The dictionary will be your favorite book.
Some people will be scared of you.
Not much else.

name: Time Floating Field
description: This ability allows you to trap someone inside a sphere made of cosmic energy. The time is unable to move inside this sphere, making anyone inside it get unable to move, attack or even realize that got trapped. This effect lasts for at least 30 minutes. The problem is that enemies inside this sphere don't get hurt too. The energy sphere can trap an entire building, but you can create only one sphere per time. If the user has full control over this power he can bend the cosmic energy into a spear
summary: The ability to create a cosmic energy sphere that completely freezes the time in its field of range.
strengths: Enemies frozen in the sphere will have no idea of what happened.
The Cosmic Spear is the only thing that can kill someone inside the energy sphere.
You can use this power to protect someone while taking out baddies.
weaknesses: Enemies inside the sphere can't get hurt too, unless if you can control the Cosmic Spear.
The Cosmic Spear requires a lot of energy and it can take years until the user is able to use it.
You can create only one sphere per time.

name: Instant Secret Compartments
description: The vertical surface can be as thin as a 1/8th of a inch. The surface can be any material but must be opaque. You must press against the surface to open the secret compartment. The compartment itself exist in another dimension. The compartment is 36''high,24" wide and 6'' deep. It contains extras of any gear you have on you at the time or any signature gear that you might use.
summary: The ability to create secret compartments on any vertical surface.
strengths: A good secondary power to The Door power or a power like The Door power.
Works on doors,one-way mirrors,a piece of cardboard held vertically. Use your imagination.
Have extras of any equipment(small enough to fit in a space 36"x24"x6"
weaknesses: Equipment you need might not fit in a space 36"x24"x6".
A secret compartment requires a surface area at least 36" x24".

name: Paxinator
description: With this power you can cause a 200 year period of peace to occur in any country that you stay in for at least twenty four hours. You can cause world peace if you go to every country for a period of twenty four hours within two hundred years. However as soon as the two hundred years are up the country/ies that you cause peace for will immediately be attacked by another country. If all the other countries are currently in their own state of peace at the time the country will be attacked by aliens
summary: The ability to cause a period of peace in any place you stay in for at least 24 hours
strengths: You can cause world peace
weaknesses: You have to stay in the place for twenty four hours
As soon as the two hundred years are up the country will automatically be attacked

name: Dimensional Exchange
description: Say that your most prized possession was broken and there is no way to fix it and it can't be replaced. If you have the Dimensional Exchange power, then you can swap your broken item with the same item from another dimension; only the item you get is not broken
summary: The ability to swap things in one dimension with any other similar dimensions
strengths: If your stuff breaks, you don't have to worry
weaknesses: The other versions of yourself won't be happy

name: Perfect Diplomacy
description: You can act as an intermediary for two people. If you tell someone the name of a person, they will completely understand the life, philosophy, motives, etc of that person. You do not have to speak to both at the same time, and they do not have to be present at the same time, but they do have to know each other personally and face-to-face. You must speak to both parties within 24 hours of each other, or the first party will forget the other's perspective. You cannot use this power on yourself.
summary: The ability to get two individuals to completely understand each other's perspective
strengths: You have the opportunity to work towards world peace.
People won't be able to stress your life by triangulating you anymore.
You have the opportunity to become popular with more and more groups of people
weaknesses: Mutual understanding doesn't guarantee people will get along
People may overwhelm you with solving all their disputes

name: The Sword Of Space
description: With the sword, you can cut holes through dimensions and live in your own private dimension. You can make a cut and travel anywhere, though some dimensions may not be breathable.
summary: The ability to cut holes through dimensions, and travel through them.
strengths: No need for a car.
Can use it as a regular sword.
No need to take the garbage out, you can send it to another dimension.
weaknesses: The holes you can create are permanent.
It takes a little while to control where you are.
You can't see the place you are traveling to.

name: Reality Highlighting
description: With this ability, by highlighting text or any form of language, you can make it come true. There's limitless possibility to this skill, since you can write simple sentences and Highlight them to make them real. However, if what the writings mean are unclear or have hidden meanings, there's no telling what could happen if you highlight them.
summary: The ability to highlight anything and make it come true.
strengths: Use a highlighter to make anything a reality.
weaknesses: Shouldn't take notes in highlighter.
Messages must be clear or there's no telling what could happen from highlighting them.
Must have a highlighter.

name: Life Renewal
description: Start a new life as anyone/anything at any age with any qualities/appearance/attributes in any situation that is in the present. They don't have to exist. You MUST change your appearance and situation, otherwise it won't work. You don't remember past lives and have to discover your abilities. You will always discover them and you will always have this ability. Could make it so you get to use this power on the event of your death.
summary: The ability to start a new life as anything you want
strengths: Immortality - can invoke power upon death
Be anyone/anything at any age with any powers/appearance/attributes in any situation you want
Always discover powers before death
weaknesses: Don't remember past and must discover powers
Must be in the present

name: Redo
description: Whether you say or do something wrong or whether you fail to say or do something right, you can simply redo it.  If you choose to redo an event from 10 years ago, you are now stuck living in that new alternate timeline and time.  So, sure... redo your first love, but now you're only how old?!  Then again...
summary: The ability to redo any event from your life.
strengths: Ensure a pretty mistake free existence (to everyone else's perception)
Enjoy that "last" delight over again.
You can be as young as you want.
weaknesses: The drive to make everything perfect may consume you.
You can't redo a redo.  You can't go back to the future.
The movie "Groundhog Day" may start to annoy you.

name: Time Recycling
description: This ability allows the user to "recycle" the time he used in the past in order to pause or fast forward time. This means erasing past events in the user's life. The erased time is then converted into extra time for the user. Then he can add it to his time in the form of time frees or an "event replay". A event replay is when the user can replay the event that happen to him in the past but in the present. It may be different though since the user is in a diferent time or place.
summary: The ability to erase moments of one's past in order to convert into add extra time in one's present moment.
strengths: Have extra time
Replay certain moments
The user can chose what moment he wants to erase.
weaknesses: Classic Time Warning: Change the past, change the future

name: Vicarious Reality
description: A vicarious reality is where people prefer Star Wars over everyday life, or someone who plays World of Warcraft once too often. As a superpower, you can trade places with these fictional characters, such as Dante from Devil May Cry, or Neo from the Matrix. Plus, you will have the powers, skills, and memories of the fictional character you trade places with.
summary: The ability to trade places with fictional characters.
strengths: Become your favorite fictional character
Escape reality for a while
weaknesses: You may not want to come back to the real world
You may have to fight Freddy Krueger or Lex Luthor

name: Object Displacement
description: Now you see it, now you don't. A person with Object Displacement can 'drop' nearby objects out of our reality with a wave of the hand, making them totally nonexistent. When they bring displaced objects back, they reappear in exactly the same location moving at the exact same speed in the exact same state as it left. The more heavy an object is, the harder it is to shift; speed is less of a factor but still influences the difficulty of the displacement.
summary: The ability to shift objects into a parallel dimension
strengths: Killer magic tricks
Displaced objects return in the exact same state they left
Can be used at a reasonable distance (10 yds)
weaknesses: Must get a clear thought in at the object, nothing rushed
Displaced objects return at the same velocity
Speed and weight affect the difficulty of the displacement

name: Ultimate Tk(Space Time)
description: With this power, you can use your hands to grab space-time. You can use space as a shield and you can create slides and other things out of space. When you touch someone else, you can rip apart their bodies via "space cutting. " You can even grab time frames where an attack exists and crush it. You can rip open a portal then rip open time/space for your exit. You can create artificial gravity by creating a funnel toward an object. Be creative and you could do more things
summary: The ability to have tactile kinesis over time and space
strengths: Your hands are the ultimate weapon
You can do virtually anything with your hands
weaknesses: You are only limited by your creativity and your willingness to mess around with the universe
If you do not immediately undo what you have done, it could lead to consequences
You can only bend what you can see

name: Time Code Mastery
description: In any universe you are inside of, there are two 'time codes'. One allowing travel to the future, and one allowing travel to the past, which are used by reciting the code out loud, and then stating the destination time. You know what the two codes are, and can change them at will, along with how time travel via the codes works (for example, what happens if you create a paradox while traveling by using the code). Anyone who knows a code can use it, but they'll be stuck unless they have both.
summary: The ability to control the two codes allowing time travel
strengths: Not only time travel, but time travel you can allow your friends to use, and revoke it, too
You know what happens if you create a paradox, since you can change that aspect, so no worries
If anyone gets the code and you do not want them to, you can just change it, and it'll be useless
weaknesses: Someone can use the code before you can change it (particularly if you don't know about them)
They could even erase your existence, preventing the code from being changed
If you don't give someone both codes, they'll be stuck without either help or another way to travel

name: Silvertongue
description: Using this power while you are reading out loud you would be able to read characters and objects out of books. People can even change the events of reality using this power. You can read yourself into and out of books too, along with others. I do not own Inkheart, and to be honest this is where the idea came from.
summary: The ability to read people and characters into and out of books
strengths: You can read your favorite character out of books.
No more paying for items, read aloud a grocery list or catelog and you're set!
You can read youre enemy into a book with a terrible ending.
weaknesses: When you read yourself or someone else in or out of a book, someone has to take your place.
You have limited control over which character or object comes from the book.
You can easily accidentally read someone into a book.

name: Eternal Eclipse
description: With this ability, the user can generate high amounts of dark energy and gravity. Dark energy (at Full Body Transform) allows the user to do nearly anything, from complete destruction, to time/space travel, to infinite knowledge. Gravity allows the user to create things like black holes, or the user could even collapse a star to create a supernova. There are three forms to this ability: Human Form, Angelic Form (comes with two black wings and an exploding darkness spear) and Full Body Transform.
summary: The ability to govern the powers of dark energy and gravity
strengths: Not just for bad guys
Power to become an energy being
In Full Body Transform you gain the ability to regenerate as long as there is a particle of you left
weaknesses: Angelic Form and especially Full Body Transform are hard to master
If you stay in Full Body Transform for too long, you will be stuck that way permanently
Tread CAUTIOUSLY around energy absorbers (don't forget you have gravitational powers, so use them! )

name: Total Remote Viewing
description: You can see past and present activities anywhere on Earth and other planets. You can even find planets with other humanoid life.  You can also view three things, in three places, at once.
summary: The ability to use remote viewing in its strongest form.
strengths: You can find anybody, and anything.
You can see past and present things.
weaknesses: You can only see either past or present things.
Some things are better left unseen.

name: Remote Viewing
description: By closing your eyes and concentrating, you can revisit any past event and witness it exactly as it happened.  You can see what is CURRENTLY happening anywhere in the world (and universe) as well.  Watch any game, concert, or event as if you were actually there!  Unravel mysteries that have been lost in time!  What really happened to the dinosaurs?  What really happens at strip clubs??  The possibilities are endless!
summary: The ability to see any past or present event through your own eyes.
strengths: See anything that happened or is happening
Revisit moments you were too drunk to remember
weaknesses: Some things are better left unseen
You might potentially spend a lot of time remote viewing

name: Avatar Of The Universe
description: You will age but only if the universe will be someday die;otherwise your immortal. Your immune to anything that the universe is immune to. Reality altering powers will affect you. Antimatter doesn't affect you. Black holes can affect you.
summary: The ability to link together with the universe.
strengths: Immune to everything but reality alteration.
weaknesses: Destroyed by reality alteration,but who wouldn't be?

name: Celestial Consciousness
description: A telepathic branch of power that allows you to transfer your consciousness to celestial bodies including, but not limited to stars, planets, moons, even nebula.  Requiring immense energy and focus, once your consciousness has transferred you can move through space, as a conscious star, and can exert control over your gravitational influences.
summary: The ability to transfer your consciousness to celestial bodies.
strengths: Control the power of the sun with your mind.
Control the celestial properties, and forces that the body you transfer into can control.
weaknesses: Leave your body defenceless, and unconscious during the period of transference.
Further the celestial body, the more focus required.

name: X Men
description: The overview pretty much explains it all. Even if the mutant is dead. Also you get complete control over their powers. But there's only one problem: The user can only use up to 3 powers at a time.
summary: The ability to possess/control up to 3 superpowers that any mutant from the x-men movies, comics, and series have.
strengths: Everything!
weaknesses: Limited power usage at one time, but no biggie!

name: Stare Of Truth
description: With this ability, no one can ever lie to you... Unless you aren't staring at them. Your gaze will simply be too horrific and paralyzing for anyone to lie to you.
summary: The ability to get the truth out of someone by staring at them.
strengths: You get the truth, yey.
weaknesses: You are scary.

name: Starcrafter
description: This power is the ability to control the stars and space: including contracting and expanding atmospheres, going supernova, and even create stardust. Star distance measure power level. If body and power usage are not within equilibrium, the body will heat up and shut down.
summary: The ability to control power of stars and dark matter.
strengths: Control of thermal emission
Atmospheric shifting
Control over dark matter
weaknesses: Star distance measures power level
Complete darkness is a weakness
If the body is to hot it will destroy everything around it

name: Sinister Empowerment
description: In X-Men, Apocalypse is the first mutant. It is said that most mutants got their powers from him over time. With this power, you can give people powers, but only one at a time. You can wait until they master their powers, or you can increase them so that when they are powerful enough, you can steal it from them!
summary: The ability to bestow superpowers, then steal them back.
strengths: Become a powerful supervillain
Give people powers, then steal it from them
weaknesses: You can only give them one power at a time
You can only steal powers that you have bestowed

name: Fictional Reality Hopping
description: You are able to enter any fictional show's, video game's, or book's reality. You can spend an infinite amount of time doing so: while using this power, time in the real world/reality is stopped. When entered, you gain similar powers to the main characters. You must have one memory of the visual appearance of the reality. Can bring things/ living beings with you into the fictional reality, but not take things from that reality back to your own.
summary: The ability to switch between realities.
strengths: Can gain superspeed in Sonic the Hedgehog.
Can gain multiple powers in Heroes.
You can take things/people with you into the dimension
weaknesses: Could have to fight evil-doers.
Can't take stuff from that dimension back with you
If you die, you get outed and have to wait 24 before using this power again

name: Cause/Effect Reversal
description: An effect must be preceded by some causes it to happen, but with this power you can make the effect happen first and the universe will retroactively make up the most logical cause based on what you wanted to do.   For example, if you decided you wanted to cook a huge dinner and used this power, you would immediately have a huge dinner cooked in front of you. The universe would then work backwards, subtracting the ingredients from your kitchen and hitting you with the fatigue from cooking.
summary: The ability to reverse the law of cause and effect.
strengths: Make it so that any action absolutly suceeds, immediately.
Save time.
weaknesses: Actions taken must be physically possible by you.
All energy it would take to cause the effect is subtracted from you all at once.

name: Possibility Manipulation
description:
You can look at yourself in parallel universes and imitate your parallel self's skills/abilities/powers for a limited amount of time. This means that it's possible to become the very best you could possibly be for a short time, although doing something like that would take more energy than taking something minor (like the skill to cook teriyaki as opposed to the power to stop time).
Only one ability/skill/power can be taken at any given time, although with enough skill you can switch quickly.
summary: The ability to take skills from parallel yous.
strengths: Become the best you could possibly be
Have a wide variety of powers on call
Be good at almost anything
weaknesses: You can only take one skill at a time
There's a limit to how long you can keep a skill

name: Axis Access
description: This ability allows you to move along the spatial axes of existence, like a point on a coordinate plane. X-Axis Travel would let you distort space to move horizontally (side-side). Y-Axis Travel would let you distort space to move vertically (up-down). Z-Axis Travel would let you distort space to move forward or backward. And Coordinate Travel would allow you to combine any two of these effects at a time, for more dexterous maneuvering. This ability is often accompanied by a Geometric Sense.
summary: The ability to psychically move oneself along the spatial axes of existence
strengths: Relocate yourself easily along the spatial axes of existence, like a point on a coordinate plane
Relocation is fairly quick; it looks like teleportation (and Y-Axis Travel allows levitation)
Often accompanied by the power to perceive space geometrically (makes using this power efficient)
weaknesses: Not as efficient as true teleportation
Not as efficient as normal Spatial Manipulation (can't distort space to avoid bullets or the like)
Spatial Manipulation can make this power act erratically

name: Limited Reality Warping
description: You can warp reality, but once you have performed an act, you can never use your power in that way again. For example, if you turn something to gold, you can never turn something else to gold again. Your power is not endless, as you cannot destroy the universe or affect an entire planet, etc. You can warp reality in different ways for similar effect, such as turning one enemy into smoke, then turning another one into water vapour. You do not have to speak for your power to work.
summary: The ability to warp reality, but never warp in that way again
strengths: Can do basically anything you want
It will be rare that you will want to use your power in a way you have previously used
The ways your power can be used in combat, transport, etc. are endless
weaknesses: Must make sure you do not carelessly use up a useful warp
May not be able to reverse an unwise warp
Have to remember how you have used your power before

name: Wait For It...
description: First, you must start saying something. Then, before you finish, you say, "wait for it. " Time will stand still. Nothing will age, including you. Nothing will move except you and things moved by you. However, frozen objects are harder to move, being unaffected by gravity or wind resistance, but being heavily affected by static friction with the fabric of time. The only way to unfreeze time is to speak or to die. The first thing you say will unfreeze time by finishing your sentence.
summary: The ability to freeze time until you finish your current sentence.
strengths: Can keep yourself from aging.
No aging means no need for sleep or food.
Can do all sorts of things with frozen people and things.
weaknesses: Must remain completely silent (vocally) while using this power.
Moving objects is roughly five times harder than usual.
Accidentally tripping and shouting out in pain while trespassing, unfreezing and alerting everyone.

name: Mirror Moving
description: They say mirrors contain the exact opposite of your life in our "world". And that what you do here is the exact opposite of the mirror world. By using this power you change the outcomes of what ever mistakes you do here in our "world" or completely change the events that may have caused you distress and problems. It's sort of reality warping but with the limits of a parallel universe being affected.
summary: The ability to control your parallel universe
strengths: You can change the result of any thing like getting a low scores in test then use
The power to switch the "universes" and get a high score. You could also change the outcomes of
Wars,fights and even gambling bets in which if you lose here you can win if you switch the universes
weaknesses: Can alter the death of others but cannot alter your own death
Positive results for you may cause negative outcomes for others
Can destroy the veil of the two universes with constant use and can cause great strain to the user

name: Painting Master.
description: With this ability you can paint a scene of a certain person thing or place, and whatever you painted will happen. If it a time is not specified with the painting it will occur before Twelve a. M. If you think of a person and randomly paint something you will paint a picture of what that person is doing at that exact moment, a later moment, or an earlier moment in time.
summary: The ability to control reality with your paintings
strengths: Make anyone do whatever you want by painting them in a picture.
See what other people are doing whenever you want.
You can paint anything you want with perfect clarity.
weaknesses: Never draw cartoons. Ever.
How the scene occurs, and what happens afterward is not controlled by the first drawing.
You have to complete the drawing for it to take affect.

name: Lie Realization
description: A person with this power can turn other people's lies into truth. As such reality bends to make it true. If history has to be rewritten then an alternate universe is created where the lie is true. Only the lying person is aware of the change. If the person that told the lie admits what he said was a lie, either in person or in a journal after death etc, there will be a backlash that reverses the effects of this power and goes back to the moment that lie happened.
summary: The ability to turn other people's lies into truth
strengths: No one can lie to you if you don't want them to
Make things you want to hear true
If people flatter you, you can make what they say true
weaknesses: Does not come with lie detection ability
Does not work on your own lies
If someone starts telling the truth this power gets reversed

name: Mark Of Hati
description: In Norse mythology, hati was one of the wolf brothers (the other being skoll) who chased after the sun and moon god. During the day of Ragnarok, hati devoured the moon God and gain his power. With this power, you have the ability to turn into a werewolf or gaint one with immense strength, speed, healing factor, immoratality. You also have power of a Moon God and can use elements like water, dark, and gravity and can become more powerful at night.
summary: The ability to become a lunar lycan
strengths: Super strength and speed of a werewolf
Power of a moon god
Stand up against gods and devour them
weaknesses: Other gods might want hunt you down
Might be hard to control at first
Not as strong during the day

name: Hormone Manipulation
description: With this power, one can control hormone production. Production levels return to normal over time, but can be restored at will, provided they have not yet returned to normal levels; otherwise it needs to be applied again. In yourself, however, levels are constantly maintained. As bonuses, one can sense hormone levels and diseases related to them such as type 1 diabetes as well as cure said hormone disorders, even when the levels must adjust for specific conditions.
summary: The ability to manipulate hormones.
strengths: Cure hormone-related disorders, such as diabetes type 1.
Alter hormone levels to control factors as you desire, such as quantities of fat and muscle.
You can instantly reverse any changes you have done to a person's hormone production.
weaknesses: Effects wear off over time unless maintained.
You cannot cure a hormone-based disease if the individual has no allele for it.
You can only control hormones, not other proteins such as enzymes.

name: Nonexistence
description: This is the temporal ability to erase oneself from the time-space continuum, and thus not be bound to the "boundaries" of what is physically possible in the material realm (it would only allow defiance of space and time, and the like, not things like Summoning or Reality Bending). Not to mention, all memory of the user will be erased (they will not appear in pictures or prophecies, and there will be no evidence of their existence other than their presence), until they phase back into space-time.
summary: The ability to move outside of space-time, giving the impression of not existing.
strengths: Immunity to time manipulation, bodily alteration, reality bending and recording devices (no traces).
Loss of bodily needs to eat, drink, sleep and breathe.
Defy space-time (walk up walls, teleport, leave people's memories when you leave their presence).
weaknesses: People with Chronokinesis can make this permanent.
Might get annoying if people forget who you are as soon as you leave their presence.
Makes robberies and such too easy (MIGHT get boring).

name: Sound Displacement
description: A person with this power can remove the sound produced by any action including speaking. They can remove the sound of their footsteps and even the sound of an explosion. In addition they can then place the sound that they captured in a new location. They do not need to place the sound immediately somewhere else and can store the sound for prolonged periods of time.
summary: The ability to take away sound produced by anything and place that sound anywhere
strengths: Completely silent movement--useful for sneaking around
Can later place that sound anywhere--misdirection
Protection against sonic based attacks
weaknesses: Needs practice to use effectively

name: Gravitational Attraction
description: This ability allows you to create a gravitational attraction between yourself and anything you want to attract. The attracted object will rotate around you no matter how heavy it is.
summary: The ability to create gravitational attraction between yourself and anything you want.
strengths: You can make anything rotate around you and use it as a protection against incoming attacks.
weaknesses: You can't really manipulate the speed of the objects circling around you.

name: Luck Steal
description: A person with this power has the ability to steal people's good luck and fortune and give it to other people. Their right hand steals luck while their left hand gives luck. Thus the user needs to wear gloves all the time to prevent accidentally transferring luck around.
summary: The ability to steal people's luck through touch and give luck to other people
strengths: Perfect assasin-people die by natural causes/accidents
Can use stolen luck to give yourself luck or give others luck
weaknesses: You have wear gloves on your hands
You need to touch people to use this power

name: Newton's Second Law
description: Force is equal to mass times acceleration. With this power you can change the mass or acceleration of an object to change the net force applied to the object. The direction of acceleration can also be controlled in the X Y or Z planes. Mass is harder to change in the object than the acceleration of the object is.
summary: The ability to control mass and acceleration to create a force.
strengths: Mass can be increased or decreased in any object without changing volume.
Acceleration can be applied in any direction to move an object
Acceleration can be used to cancel out forces like gravity.
weaknesses: Mass is more difficult to change.
Large changes in mass may hurt the object you are changing.
Will have to take into account the forces already acting on the object.

name: Temporary Total Mimicry
description: A person with Temporary Total Mimicry is to be watched at all costs. They can totally mimic another person: appearance, any skills they may have, and even their superhuman abilities. As such, they are one of the biggest threats to any organization. However, the ability takes some concentration to activate, has a time limit of an hour, and a range of a football field.
summary: The ability to take on the form, skills, and powers of another person for an hour
strengths: Mimic the strongest person there
Absorb all the skills they might have
Even lets you use any powers they may have
weaknesses: Concentration to activate
Time limit of an hour
Range of a football field

name: Quick Fix
description: Have you ever accidentally knocked over something fragile, or blurted out something you did not mean to, and then instantly realize the mistake you made? With this power you can correct the mistake you made without any consequences. As long as you realize the mistake within a couple seconds of it occurring you can warp reality to make the right outcome occur. If you do not realize your mistake soon enough then this power has no effect.
summary: The ability to correct a mistake if you realize it soon enough.
strengths: Fix your accidents.
Never blurt out the wrong things.
Warp reality to create the correct outcome.
weaknesses: Have to realize the mistake you made.
If you do not realize soon enough then this power has no effect.
If you think that you could never make a mistake then this power is useless.

name: Phenomena Rejection
description: One night, you are walking late after a midnight party with your friends. You talk about the future and all that stuff. Suddenly, a mugger comes and tries to mug you. Your best friend fights him and he gets shot. Wouldn't it be great to have this power. It consists of rejecting any events by warping time with in a barrier. Its combined with memory reversal, time reverstion, barrier, and erasure of matter.
summary: The ability to reverse time and space anywhere with in 5 km radius.
strengths: You can avoid death
protect your feveryone you love
Save humanity.
weaknesses: Be death
Be excluded by family and friends
Eradicate humanity.

name: Immutability
description: One with this ability cannot be transformed into another form, genetically altered, shrunk, expanded, weighed down or affected by Obliteration or Reality Bending. All attempts to do so are null and void. In addition, he cannot be vaporized, liquefied or the like. His body is entirely resistant to unnatural change (even magical body alteration). However, he can still age, and is still vulnerable to conventional harm (guns, knives, bad comedy).
summary: The ability to resist all unnatural physical change
strengths: Your body is immune to powers like Biokinesis, vampiric or therianthropic conversion, etc.
Cannot be aged, de-aged or reduced in intelligence, looks, or size
Cannot be vaporized, liquefied or affected by Reality Bending directly
weaknesses: Still vulnerable to normal harm
Still age
Still feel pain

name: Universe Control
description: You will be able to make black holes, more stars, control where stars and planets are, and if it's too hot outside, you can cool the sun down.
summary: The ability to create black holes and control the universe's celestial objects.
strengths: Cool down a sunny day
Make your own constellations
Make your own new inhabitable planets
weaknesses: You might accidentaly destroy the earth if you're not careful!

name: Create Time Loop
description: You can create a personal temporal prison for someone or something. The person or object vanishes and repeats an amount of time chosen by you endlessly... Until the end of time itself.
summary: The ability to put someone or something in an endless and repeating period of time.
strengths: Enemies gone forever.
End nuclear war.
Eliminate toxic waste.
weaknesses: You have to plan ahead to use this power.
Enemies will try to kill you from a distance.

name: Prescience
description: This power enables one knowledge of future events before they even exist. This isn't like your ordinary future-seeing power. No. This specifically says "Knowledge". You are seeing the future. You simply know. You can use this power to tap into any timeline that isn't present or past.
summary: The ability to knowledge of future events before they exist
strengths: Knowledge of the future
Gain advance technology via recreating them
Be the cool prophet
weaknesses: Like the present. The future always changes
No lamscience or sufsience, future only
Might freak knowing when and how you die

name: Reality Reincarnation
description: This ability allows a user to be reincarnate in different universal version of yourself. Most of the time you will look like yourself and sometimes you look different. You could wind up being a slave or a conquer, a animal man or an advance human. You won't know.
summary: The ability to be reincarnated in a different universe.
strengths: Be recarnated in a new world.
Gain experience
weaknesses: Unless you are immortal or have some special condition you can only do it once.

name: Implosion
description: With a hand gesture of crushing, you make objects fall onto/into themselves into nothingness. A building, car or person will start to cave in from the inside out till there's nothing left of it. Where it goes from there is a mystery--like the other side of a black hole. All you know is: it was there, you imploded it, now it disappeared.
summary: The ability to destroy things by making them collaspe on themselves
strengths: Make things suck into themselves till gone
You can clear an obstacle blocking you from your destination by imploding it
weaknesses: You have no clue where your imploded things go to

name: Shatter
description: People with this ability, called "Shatterers," can break anything by touching it with their right hand and saying "Shatter. "
summary: The ability to break things
strengths: Fights are relatively easy
It is an impressive ability
Everyone wants a "right hand of death"
weaknesses: DON'T sleeptalk
You always need to watch what you say... "Oh, crap, I shattered a glass... " this just won't do
Many will fear you

name: New Reality Vortex
description: You can create vortices that take you to a new reality that is either much better than this world, or horrible. Are you alone, without a family, and want a new start? Cornered by bullies or thugs? This power lets you escape. But you can also pull in enemies, sending them into a barren, desert-like place similar to Erebus, the dark netherworld crossed over when going into Hades, from which there is no escape. You, on the other hand, can always end up in a better place if you choose it!
summary: The ability to create vortices that lead to another dimension that is either good or bad
strengths: Getting rid of enemies? No problem!!
Live a better life in a happier place if this one doesn't suit you!
You can choose, and therefore control, whether the endpoint is in a good or bad place
weaknesses: Vortices are weak when you first acquire the power
They will open unintentionally if you don't control the power
You need to consciously focus on either the good or bad destination

name: Key Of Infinity: Dimension Key
description: Turn the key in midair or in a keyhole, and a door will appear. Think of a dimension (This counts alternate universes, like if you would have worn red socks instead of blue ones) and go through the door. You'll appear there! But without the Key of Space or Key of Time, you'll appear randomly in the past/future and/or in some random place
summary: The ability to use a key to go to a different dimension
strengths: Going to alternate dimensions
Having fun in them
weaknesses: Might appear randomly without other keys
Might die when appearing randomly

name: Snap You're Gone V2
description: With this power you can send people to other planets by snapping saying their name and the name of the planet you want them sent to. This power does not allow them to breathe in space so if they can't they'll probably die when you send them to a different planet. The planet does not have to be in your solar system or galaxy but is has to be in your universe. You can bring them back by saying their name and the name of the planet they came from. This power works on corpses and animals as well.
summary: The ability to teleport people to other planets by snapping
strengths: You can send people to other planets
Get paid by NASA to send astronauts to Mars
weaknesses: This power does not allow people to breathe in space

name: Power Using
description: This power will let the person having this gift use any power the person wants to use. The power can only last a short time. The longer the power is in use, the more it becomes part of them. If the person goes over their time period, the power they have will stay and it will be their only power.
summary: The ability to use any power for a short amount of time
strengths: You can use any power you want
The gift you pick to use will be as strong as a normal person with this power
weaknesses: You can lose most of your powers if you use one or more powers over your time limit
The powers you use over your power limit can most likely kill you

name: Fictional Factories
description: This power allows you to produce items made by fictional businesses in books,movies,tv shows, etc. There are limits though, you can only obtain 5 fictional factories at any given time.
summary: The ability to recreate fictional products made by fictional businesses.
strengths: Have awesome things from books and movies.
weaknesses: Only 5 factories at a time (but an unlimited amount)

name: Lord Of Oblivion
description: By deleting a piece of reality and then controlling the void that replaces it, you alter reality. You can only have three changes retained at once, plus however many you can focus on. If you lose focus on one that isn't 'saved,' the piece of reality and everything connected to it disappears (death with no afterlife). If you SUDDENLY lose focus, not only does it disappear, but it is replaced by a chaos demon with similar powers that will attempt to destroy reality. Changes must be in line-of-site
summary: The ability to alter reality by controlling the void of non-existence
strengths: Create something you want by deleting some air and then writing what you want over it
After you're done with a creation, just let it turn into nothing again, can control minor demons
With training and practice, you can increase range and even get a few semi-saves ('while awake')
weaknesses: Can not give yourself powers (as you're 'connected' to whatever you change) without a 'change save'
Friends and family lost to the void can be brought back, but will use up a 'change save' to keep
If someone with this power is lost to the void, the resulting demon can slay gods with a blink

name: Moon Blade10th Timeless Silver
description: The 10th MB, has a large hand guard, with 2 silver clock-hands meeting at an angle to form a triangular blade. The blade can cut portals into any time and dimension, and well as bypass any time paradoxes (ex. Going back in time to kill someone, will only make the person disappear in current time, w/o affecting any people they interacted with). The blade also allows to absorb an attack into a timeless dimension, and then spill it out from portals around the target (ex. In comments)
summary: The ability to summon the blade of time.
strengths: Controls time
Disables time paradoxes
weaknesses: Difficult to comprehend time change

name: Temporal Restoration Field
description: TRFs allow you to reload points of time. By creating a TRF and restoring it, you will be taken backwards in time to that point. Minor restoration fields can be used to repair objects or heal people by restoring it to an earlier state, without the need to create a TRF for them. You can duplicate things by reloading their TRF too. Also comes with an innate understanding of TRFs, enough so that someone with sufficient engineering skills might be able to make a TRF Machine with your knowledge/help.
summary: The ability to manipulate "Temporal Restoration Fields"
strengths: Load a gun with one clip, then just reload the TRF from its loaded state when it runs out.
Hopeless situation? Want to time travel? Load a TRF. Someone injured? Reload the state of their body
See a nice car/weapon/whatever? Reload its TRF and have it.
weaknesses: Loading a TRF made in the future takes you back to that future, regardless of changes to the past
Can't go back further than when you got the power, you go back to the place you made the TRF
You must have encountered an object to duplicate it, it must have been functioning once to repair

name: Strike Delay
description: With this power you can delay the strikes of your attacks until you choose to trigger them. Your initial attack dose no damage, but you can then choose to trigger the strike whenever you want. Say you punch someone 3 times in the face with this power. It would be as if they had not even gotten punched. But, you could then trigger those punches at a later date. This power also works with objects and space. You can leave an attack hanging in the air to catch someone off guard.
summary: The ability to delay the impact of your attacks.
strengths: Control when your attack connects.
Works with any type of damage from physical or weapon strikes to energy blasts.
Set traps by leaving attacks hanging in space until called upon.
weaknesses: You can not trigger individual attacks. When you trigger they all strike at once.

name: Decentralization
description: Decentralization allows the user to voluntarily expand himself across several parallel realities or dimensions. When split, damage is only applied to "slices" directly affected. If you were to split many times immediately before a blast, for example, you could let only 1/1000'th of you take the damage, and re-merge essentially unharmed. At least one "slice" must remain in the reality of origin, and the thinner spread the user is, the less he is affected by, or can affect, his surroundings.
summary: The ability to split your existence between multiple realities.
strengths: Quick reflexes can make for effective invulnerability.
Can be used to make one less noticable, which is perfect for stealth.
Can be used to make decoys.
weaknesses: The thinner a user is spread, the less he can sense and interact with any given reality.
The thiner a slice is, the easier it is to destroy; even weak attacks can be lethal if synchronized.
If one slice is obstructed, all slices are obsructed. Obstructions may exist in other realities.

name: Legendary Pokemon Summon
description: With this power you can summon any of the 47 legendary pokemon from any generation of the series. They are under your complete control and removing them from their universe will not cause their universe to go into a state of chaos as the capture of legends usually does. You can only summon up to four legendary pokemon at a time and when you're done you can just send them back.
summary: The ability to summon any of the 47 legendary pokemon
strengths: You can summon any legendary pokemon
You want cause the Pokemon universe to fall into a state of chaos
You can unsummon them when you're done
weaknesses: You can only summon up to four at a time

name: Solaris
description: With this power, you are able to be in superheat form, which is when you are completely blazing and you can super-melt anything you touch. You can also control what temperatures you would like to use.
summary: The ability to harvest the power of the sun.
strengths: Can cook your own food without oven.
weaknesses: Can't control the sun.
Works with your emotions.

name: Electronic Fog
description: A person with this power can create the effect of the Bermuda Triangle anywhere by creating electronic fog. Within the fog electronics don't work and people caught in the radius will be blinded and their sense of space and time is distorted. Compasses are broken too. After a while things will deteriorate. You are immune to any and all negative effects of your own power.
summary: The ability to create and control the fog that makes up the Bermuda Triangle
strengths: Disrupts electronics
People can't see through the fog and will suffer spacial and temporal disorientation
You are immune to the effects of your own power
weaknesses: Only useful for killing or sneaking

name: Ability Commutation
description: You're using a power but then realize you need to change it for another one. You would normally need to stop using the current one and then activate the one you want, possibly becoming open to attack. With this power, you can instantly switch from one power to another, without needing to fulfil the conditions to stop the current one and to start the new one, if conditions are required. However, the switch will be broken if the next power has effects that entirely depend on those conditions.
summary: The ability to instantly switch a power you're using to another one, bypassing the condition to activate the latter
strengths: You won't lose time switching between superpowers the normal way.
You won't need to fulfil the conditions to activate the next one.
Rapidly switching from an offensive power to a defensive power.
weaknesses: The switch will break if the next power has effects that depend on the conditions of activation.
To use this power, a superpower must already be activated, which can be short in time.
Switching a superpower for this one or this one for another doesn't count.

name: Fall
description: With this power you can make someone collapse on the ground just by saying "Fall" and then pointing at the person or saying the person's name. The person can get up whenever they like and you can use this power on as many people as you like as many times as you want.
summary: The ability to make people fall
strengths: You can cause people to collapse on the ground
weaknesses: The person can just get back up

name: Planar Intangability
description: Planes are the layers of reality that exist on different levels than our own. This power grants the user the ability to selectively become intangible to these different planes. This allows the user to travel time, space, and evade attacks on different planes. Because space and time function differently based on the plane you can traverse these in a limited manner. Also because most actions exist on only one plane you can evade ALL actions on a plane you're intangible on.
summary: The ability to selectively become intangible on the different planes of reality.
strengths: Easily evade single or few-plane attacks.
Limited space and time travel.
Become intangible on the spiritual plane to resist possession.
weaknesses: If you have no knowledge of the mechanics of different planes.
Reality benders.
Attacks that are multi-plane.

name: Position Reset
description: A person with this power can return objects to a previous position and inertia in space and time. When the power is used the objects move back to previous positions similar to a rewinded video. When moved back to original location, the objects inertia becomes equal to the inertia it had at the time. With practice you can reverse objects indefinitely to "immobilize" objects.
summary: The ability to return the positions and inertia of objects to where and what they were in a previous time
strengths: Cleaning your room, making your bed
CSI purposes
Can fake telekinesis
weaknesses: Can only return positions of objects, not return objects to current position
Does not work on people or animals or energy

name: Temporal Degaussing
description: One is able to open a (temporary) rip in the spacetime continuum, allowing one to enter it and exit at any destination in history of their choosing.
summary: The ability to cause a momentary rip in spacetime.
strengths: Time travel is always useful
You could bring anyone with you
weaknesses: In the brief moment's it open, anybody can fall in
You're always susceptible to paradoxes

name: Celestial Creation
description: The ability to create, control and negate all celestial phenomena that occurs outside of our atmosphere. The creation of certain phenomena may affect the earths unique stability
summary: The ability to create celestial phenomena
strengths: You could create an alternate world
Could advance the knowledge about all celestial phenomenon
The body adapts to the rigours of space
weaknesses: Negating certain celestial phenomena may take its toll on the body
The use of certain celestial phenomena may affect the unique stability of the world
The body adapting may have bad side-effects from the changes to cope with space

name: Time Traveler Possession
description: Sort of like Quantum Leap, you go into a deep trance & have an outer body experience. Your spirit travels back in time & inhabits a living person in the past that's the same gender as you & approximately the same age. You can't change or make big influences the past for it might throw the cosmic universe off balance, even if it seems for the better. You can't also inhabit your past self. Your spirit will meld with the past people so you have their knowledge & memory experience.
summary: The ability to have mind & soul time travel possessing someone in the past for 6 hours
strengths: Possess someone in the past for 6hrs
Your spirit will intertwine with the spirit of the person you inhabit, so you have their knowledge
You also gain their memory experience & skills
weaknesses: Cannot change the past majorly
Cannot possess your past self for risk of cosmic rifts. Your present body is in catatonic state
You possess random past people unless truly focused on a person & die if they die

name: Karma Incarnate
description: With this power, you have the ability to manipulate reality, but only to serve karma. You have the ability to punish the wicked with an appropriate punishment and help the innocent by giving advice or items. However you feel compelled to use your powers every time you see something wrong instead of letting things resolve by themselves. Since the user is karma incarnate, they are also immune to their own karma so punishing the wicked or assisting the innocent does not help or hurt their karma.
summary: The ability to deliver karmic retribution or salvation to anyone by altering reality
strengths: You can punish those that deserve it
You can help those that need it the most
You are immune to other karmic powers or karma
weaknesses: You have to serve karma- you feel compelled to use your power whenever you see something wrong
You sometimes come off as a jerk since you can not show any sort of mercy to the wicked
You can only use your power if you witness a person's own cruelty or kindness

name: Moon Warp
description: Whenever the full moons up, most people grow hair and paws. Your ability is much cooler - the fuller the moon, the easier it is to alter the very fabric of space. Unfortunately, you have no power during the new moon, and as the moon gets fuller you glow with power. So people will know when you are powerful or weak.
summary: The ability to gain power over reality when the full moon is up.
strengths: Reality Changing/Warping during the full moon.
Almost never totally powerless.
Waxing moon makes your power increase.
weaknesses: You can only affect what you can perceive.
Waning moon saps your power.
No power in the day unless you can see the moon.

name: Instant Attachment
description: A person with this power can grab an object and make it touch another object and the two objects will be stuck forever(unless sufficient force breaks one of the objects away from the location of sticking). For example, someone with this power can use this to create impossible works of art with objects that seemingly defy gravity. This power is also practical for close range combat sticking opponents to walls, pinning people's hands to tables, and other more creative uses that embarrass.
summary: The ability to make an object you touch stick to another object it is touching permanently
strengths: Useful in arts and crafts, engineering, surgical applications, and more
Useful in close range combat
This power cannot be undone after the fact by power negation but can still be negated initially
weaknesses: Don't try sticking stuff on to your self
Its permanent so may not want to use it that much
Short range power(you would need to be within grabbing distance and require two objects

name: Breaking The Fourth Wall
description: Comic books are divided into panels; by breaking the fourth wall, you can step over the gaps in these panels and thus move forward effortlessly in space or time. You can also read others' thought bubbles and see narration. Your ability allows you to manipulate the world slightly, for example, using a speech bubble as a physical weapon or trapping another in an inescapable panel. You can also climb columns of words like ladders and write on the fourth wall when lacking paper like on a window.
summary: The ability to take advantage of artistic devices used in fictional media as if they applied in real life.
strengths: Travel without wasting time or money
Have a unique understanding of your world
Use your own story as a tool IN your own sotry
weaknesses: You may go mad from comparing reality with fiction
Requires concentration and good parallel thinking to avoid the above
Cannot change what happens a few panels away on a massive scale, only add in "plot twists"

name: Shattered Glass Universe
description: With this power you can travel to an alternate reality that is the complete opposite of your home universe (i. E. Villains are heroes and vice versa). Once you're there you do not become the opposite of yourself but you stay the same and keep all the powers you had in your home universe. Once you're done in the alternate universe you can simply travel back to your home universe.
summary: The ability to travel into an alternate reality that is the opposite of your home reality
strengths: You can travel to an alternate reality that is the complete opposite of your home reality
You keep your personality and powers
You can go home when you're done
weaknesses: The alternate version of yourself might try to kill you

name: Time Lock
description: This power traps a person or object one second out of sync with the rest of reality so that they do not exist in the present. They will remain continually one second in the future until another time power (or this power) releases them. If the power is successfully used on something, then it will appear that the object disappeared in a flash of light. When returned to sync with reality, there would be a flash of light and matter would be displaced where the object was.
summary: The ability to trap a person one second in the future so that they will be unexistant.
strengths: Trap things out of sync with reality so they temporarily are non-existant.
Can be used on anything you have the power to affect.
Perfect Jail.
weaknesses: People with time powers like, Time Defiance or Anachronism can easily escape (Only imperfection)
The larger the object, the harder it is to time-lock.
The matter displacement of large objects returning could be deadly.

name: Cronochorokinesis
description: With this ability one could manipulate the space related dimensions on an object or the "Co-ordinants", thus, the object transports to another dimension. This is very similar to Object Displacement the only difference being that objects that you transport to another dimension you can not get them back. The object transports to a random dimension.
summary: The ability to manipulate the space related dimensions of an object.
strengths: Transport foes or any other bothersome object to a random dimension.
If one can develop this power enough one could transport one's self to a different dimension
weaknesses: Once transported an object or person is almost impossible to get back.
One does not have knowledge of these other dimensions

name: Enslaving Wish Granting
description: You can grant almost any wish and get a new slave who you can command to do anything you want, even if it's against their morals. You cannot grant wishes that make others omnipotent, omnipresent, omniscient, reality bending, etc. You also cannot create love between two beings nor force one being to love another. Also all commands given must be specific or the slave might try to do something you don't want them to do or do something you haven't ordered them not to do such as killing you.
summary: The ability to grant the wishes of others and make them one's slaves in exchange
strengths: Can easily assemble an army... Or maybe a harem!
Give someone genius-level intellect and have them research anything you want.
weaknesses: You can't grant your own wishes.
You have restrictions on the wishes you can grant.

name: Reverse Aging
description: This ability allows you to reverse your age at any time, while still retaining the knowledge and experience you have now.  Although you have to power to never die of old age, you won't necessarily be immortal.  You are still susceptible to physical harm and illness.  However, if your illness is due to natural causes from old age, you can reverse the process.  Any age goes, be it 20, 15, 10, even the age you were born.  But be careful--once you reverse your age, you can't fast-forward.
summary: The ability to reverse your age at will.
strengths: Eternal youth
Never get flabby arms or have a wrinkly ass
Hot 18 year olds
weaknesses: Others get older while you stay young.

Explaining to people why you look so young when you're 180 years old

name: Mark Of Skoll
description: In Norse mythology, Skoll was one of the wolf brothers (the other being Hati) who chased after the sun and moon god. During the day of Ragnarok, Skoll devoured the Sun God and gain his power. With this power, you have the ability to turn into a werewolf or gaint one with immense strength, speed, healing factor, immoratality. You also have power of a Sun God and can use elements like fire, light, and gravity and can become more powerful with sunlight.
summary: The ability to become a solar lycan
strengths: Super strength and speed of a werewolf
Have the power of the sun god
Can stand up against a god and devour them
weaknesses: Other gods might want hunt you down
Might be hard to control at first
Not as strong at night

name: Power Sharing
description: Every time you accept someone as a fellow member, any power they possess, except for this very power, is added to the group's collective powers and is now possessed by every one of its members until they die or leave the group. In other words, every member of a group share the same powers. You can belong to more than one group. In that case, you have access to all the powers of your fellow members, but your fellow members only have access to the collective powers of the group they belong to.
summary: The ability to share the powers possessed by your group between every member.
strengths: You have the potential to form the most powerful team of superhumans.
Give powers to someone who doesn't have any and give a useful power to someone who has a crappy one.
You can belong to more than one group and become even more powerful than your fellow members.
weaknesses: A passive power remains passive until the original owner of the power has a better control over it.
The power 'Power Sharing' and any similar power cannot be shared.

name: Temporal Spike
description: One with this ability is a dangerous foe; this power allows the user to generate shards of tangible time, and fire them at foes for various effects. They may inflict wounds that don't heal, stop the foe in time, speed him up, slow him down, or reverse him in time. The shards could even age the foe, de-age him or blink him from the space-time continuum. The user can only control the effect as he gains more control over the power.
summary: The ability to generate spikes of temporal energy to affect one's surroundings
strengths: Release painful shards or spikes of solid temporal energy, which even affects non-living matter
Inflict wounds that don't heal, or produce numerous other time-based effects
Not many people in the world are time-defiant
weaknesses: Time Defiance can be used to resist this power
Cannot be used to travel through time, and cannot effect others with this ability
Can inflict wounds on the user if he is stabbed with his own spikes/shards (but they heal)

name: Turning
description: You have the advantage of making foe into friend for 3 days. You can turn up to 100 foe at a time.
summary: The ability to turn enemies to your side.
strengths: You can make enemies kill their friends.
Having a spy comes in handy.
You have a ramie of enimies killing each other.
weaknesses: You can only keep them friends for 3 days.
None.
None.

name: Solar Projection
description: With this power one can control the stars they make and also release coronal mass ejections (C.M.E's), solar flare, super novas etc. And a master would also be given slight control over gravity. For the best use of the power one would have to fight alone. If these powers are not released the user would get body trembles and eventually  emit a devastatingly massive C.M.E that could kill everybody within a 15 mile radius.
summary: The ability to control and make stars.
strengths: Personal heat source
Unlimited power supply
weaknesses: Must use powers constantly.
Must fight alone all the time for best results

name: Talisman
description: Remember that show "Jackie Chan the Animated Series?" It was on almost every Saturday. Well, this power will give you the power of each of the twelve talismans. If you end up using the tiger talisman power, you could have to chase yourself all over the planet. You can only use two talismans at once.
summary: The ability to have the twelve powers of the talismans from the animated series Jackie Chan
strengths: Can do nearly anything
Have power that some people would call god power
weaknesses: Can only use two powers simultaneously. One for each hand.
Tiger power could use up a lot of time.
Takes concentration to switch between powers.

name: Ultima X Power: Portal
description: With the proper controlled use of Ultima-X forces, you're able to tear space time asunder and create dimensional gateways to any anime universe you wish. However, as with every great power, there are always catches, so be extremely careful. Equip yourself well, and have an awesome adventure!  This also applies to anime based games and other associated media.
summary: The ability to create a rift to the japanese anime world of your choosing.
strengths: Enjoy adventuring in your own episode of any anime you choose with your favorite characters!
You become an anime version of your real self upon entering the portal.
Enjoy the comical physics of the aniverse! They all apply to you as needed.
weaknesses: To open a new portal you must close the first, wait for 3 months, and a new moon.
Leaving portals open is BAD. To say the least, space time is fragile!
Portals are one way, and you cannot return until you've progessed the main story far enough.

name: Nano Knife Injection
description: Touch someone and inject a single nano knife into him. He won't feel anything. The 'knife will start doubling in number. In thirty seconds your victim will have close to a billion 'knives in him. Once this happens the 'knives will start cutting him all at the same time. Your victim will fall apart before your eyes. This power doesn't work anyone with a invulnerability power or immunity to slashing/cutting damage or who is not made of flesh. You are immune to your own power.

strengths: Undetectable and kills in thirty seconds.

Great power for a martial artist or assassin.
weaknesses: Useless against certain foes.
