name: Click's Remote
description: Remember the movie with Adam Sandler and Kate Beckinsale? You can do the exact same thing. Press pause and everything pauses around you. Pres play and it starts again. You could fast forward too.
summary: The ability to use your remote for your life.
strengths: Mute Kids
Pause and steal stuff
Forward and get it over with
weaknesses: You could lose the remote
Remote could break
You're on auto pilot during fast forward

name: Dwarf Star Vision
description: Channel a star's phenomenal energy. Use starlight itself as windows to see most of the Earth, solar system, galaxy and maybe universe at once. Coronal Mass Ejections will allow you to burn, combust or disorient targets. It destroys tech similar to an EMP. You could track anything by following its magnetic trail. Stellar flares focused through your eyes will hurl super-heated plasma at a target at light-speed.

strengths: Dwarfstar vision allows you to see anywhere starlight shines. EVERYWHERE a star's light is seen.
Small portions of the stars' gravity allowing flight and a low level shield
Have CME phenomena, stellar flares and blinding light burst from your eyes
weaknesses: Your shield stops bullets but not much else

name: Inconspicuous Trenchcoat
description: Unnoticeable means no one knows you exist, you are pretty much invisible, except people subconsciously avoid you and ignore the floating cup of hot chocolate. You also don't leave footprints (you do but no one notices them) you can also make your presence known to certain people and no one will notice they are talking to an empty space.

strengths: Good for playing hide and go seek

Good for not getting followed
weaknesses: Can accidentally disappear

name: Volume Expansion
description: This power allows the user to increase to any volume the capacity of a container. The container looks unchanged from the outside, but it can actually contain much more than it appears. However, you can only put something in it if it can go through the opening, so you can't put whatever you want inside. If you decide to reverse the effect or decrease the volume you've attributed, the excess contents will pour out if they can. If not, all the contents will be crushed to fit inside the new volume.
summary: The ability to increase the capacity of a container, without changing its appearance.
strengths: You can put much more inside a container than what it appears.

weaknesses: You can only put things that can fit through the opening.

name: Return Attack Doubling
description: Any time you are attacked you can then double the force of your enemy's attack and hit them with it. They suffer twice what they make you suffer. Plus you become more resistant to each power used against you.
summary: The ability to return double the force of any attack you are hit with.
strengths: Hurt them more than they hurt you.
Become more resistant to repeated power attacks.
weaknesses: You still suffer the injuries and pain of any attack.
If you deflect or prevent an attack it doesnt count and you cant use it against them.
If an attack is strong enough to kill you, You die. Cant turn attacks against an enemy if you dead.

name: Wikipower
description: This power simply involves the ability to alter reality depending on updates made by the user to any Wikipedia page. Perfect for those occasions when you've lost an argument or find yourself stuck for an answers in an exam, just log onto the nearest computer afterwards and change the basic rules of the Universe according to Wikipedia.
summary: The ability to manipulate reality and alter history by modifying wikipedia articles.
strengths: History and the laws of Physics can easily be changed to suit you, as well as the future controlled.
For articles regarding future events the more unlikely the scenario, the more power you acquire.
weaknesses: The McFly Effect: You may unintentionally prevent your birth and consequently begin to fade away.

name: World Preserver
description: Galactus is the eater of worlds. He preserves his life and power by consuming worlds. A world preserver is the opposite of this, for they gain power from the preservation of life, not its destruction. Every time something dies, you will sense it and it will weaken you, so you would take care to preserve as much life as possible!
summary: The ability to maintain power from life in the universe.
strengths: Gain power from all life in the universe!
weaknesses: If a planet or a star dies, it will weaken you
Cemetaries are your bane

Discovering other lifeforms in another planets

A powerful demonish source might stun you for 5 min

name: The Devil's Temptation
description: Make anyone do your bidding, no matter what it is. Only able to use it during the night time. The person will stop at nothing to finish the task you have given them.

strengths: You will be able to control anyone
If you tell them to forget, they will
To get revenge on your enemies! MWUHAHAHA

It won't help you during the day when they are after you for controlling them

name: Stardust
description: The ability to project (shoot out of hands) a gold, super cosmic energy dust called stardust. It is an explosive, an energy source, a light and a heat source all at the same time. It can also be used to surround objects and move them. It is linked to the users emotions, so the user must always be in control of their feelings.
summary: The ability to project (shoot out of hands) a gold energy dust called stardust.
strengths: Can help when escaping from a room
Can be used like telekinesis
Can be used to attract the attention of allies
weaknesses: Can attract unwanted attention
Is highly combustable
Requires constant emotional control

name: Temporal Trail Perception
description: You can see a person's future trail and past trail. It's a line that moves forward and backwards from them, showing where they have been and where they will be. You can physically interact with it to alter their future or past (for example, by stabbing their future trail and then leaving, when they reach that point, they will suddenly be wounded). If someone has some idea about how your power works, however, they can attempt to readjust their trail and cause it to attack you.
summary: The ability to see a person's temporal trails and change their past and future
strengths: Tell where people are going to be, and, to a certain extent, what they are going to do

weaknesses: Attacking a future trail allows someone to know where you've been

name: Flashback Viewer
description: A person with this power has the power to see the past. They can access information from any time in the past. They also have the ability to show their information to others. The limit to this ability is that it cannot show things that occurred before the user's birth. The user decides a time and places. They and everyone in the room and new people who come in will view a flashback, similar to the movies. People cannot change things in the flashback. No one can attack while flashback is playing
summary: The ability to see the past and show it to others
strengths: CSI: You see what happened

No one can keep secrets from you
weaknesses: Cannot see the future

name: Rift Induction

strengths: Ultimate destruction.
Gets rid of annoying things like walls.
Useful at crime scene clean-ups. Also, leaves no evidence, apart from everything being gone.
weaknesses: Might accidentally suck in something important.

Can get boring.

name: Homunculus
description: It takes only a thought to make a homunculus. A homunculus personifies anything you target with your power. While that element is personified, it ceases to exist as the thing whence it was derived.  There may only be one homunculus at a time, but it can be dispelled with a thought.  Anything done to homunculi affects their true form (killing the homunculus with fire would put out that fire even after the homunculus is gone).  Targeting concepts, planets, etc are all acceptable but dangerous.
summary: The ability to create a personification of any thing.
strengths: Easily defeat enemies using your mind, surroundings, or simply dissecting them (or their character).
Make people un-sad, -angry, -etc. (Just watch out for gloom and rage beasts or something. )
Talk to animals, your toaster, whatever!
weaknesses: Homunculi may not like you (one made from evil, for example).
User must take care; taking out the sun (or classical elements) might have repercussions.
Power of homunculi may be unreliable.

name: Fictional Vehicles V2
description: With this power you can summon any fictional vehicle and use it for whatever you want. You can summon batmobiles, UFOs, Star Wars vehicles, even Transformers but they're stuck in their vehicle modes. You can only summon vehicles that don't exist in real life or modified versions of real vehicles not regular vehicles that just happen to appear in fictional universes.
summary: The ability to summon any fictional vehicle
strengths: You can summon any fictional vehicles
If you summon Transformers in vehicle mode or other sentient vehicles they are under your control
You can summon and unsummon the vehicle whenever you want
weaknesses: The vehicles can be destroyed
You can't summon real vehicles

name: Gravity
description: This is the sister ability to Axis. Like Axis it is both passive and totally epic. Gravity will always point in the direction of your soles within a five-mile radius. If your feet are facing two different directions a weaker gravity will take place between them. This offers a wide range of uses with barely any concentration, just a little bit of forethought. You will always land right side up, but its up to you to not die.
summary: The ability to direct gravity toward the soles of your feet
strengths: Always land right side up
Deliver punishing kicks
If you do the splits you achieve anti-gravity
weaknesses: Will probably be exiled to the countryside where you won't topple any buildings
Even walking causes a little wobble
Very Disorienting

name: Arcana 17: The Star
description: You may use this power to perform some action. That action, no matter how impossible or improbable, will succeed. This will result in the best possible outcome for that action. (Such as not merely winning the lottery, but winning the million dollar prize)However, for every time you use this ability, you will fail horribly some action you take in the future, and even this power can not aid you.
summary: The ability to bend probability and logic to your aid - for a price.
strengths: Guarantied assurance at success.
Works even when the action would be logically impossible.
weaknesses: Something terrible will happen to you sometime in the future after using this ability.
Creatures or being that dislike probability and reality bending may take offense.

name: Keys Of Infinity: Time Key
description: This artifact just requires you to turn the key into air or a door. If it's in the air, a door will appear. Then, as you open it, think of a time. You will appear at the same place you were, but at whatever time you thought of. *can be combined with the Space Key and Dimension Key to make the Infikey.
summary: The ability to use a magical artifact that allows you to move around time.
strengths: Go to the past, future, anything
Portable key
Can be combined with the other Keys of Infinity
weaknesses: Might reappear someplace where a wall was/is now, so you could die
Cannot control where you go without the Space Key

name: P.O.W.E.R.S Power
description: This ability will work if it is an object(noun),action (verb),and a describing words (adjective). If it is an object, you should see that object before manipulating it. If it is a verb, you should choose a specific person that will do that action. If it is an adjective, you should choose a specific person to possess that adjective that you ascribe to him or her.
summary: The ability to manipulate any object,action or describing words that start with letter
strengths: You can make enemies PERISH
You can make other people SLOW
You can make a person or an object SOFT
weaknesses: You are not able to use other letters except p,o,w,e,r,s
If you have a bad vocabulary
Powers that keep you from speaking or thinking clearly

name: X Treasure Chests
description: With this power you can cause a treasure chest to appear whenever you draw the letter x in white on the ground. You can repeat the process as many times as you want and you get to keep all the treasure and the chest even if the x is erased.
summary: The ability to cause a chest full of treasure to appear whenever you draw a white x on the ground
strengths: You can get tons of money
You can sell the chests for even more money
It works whenever you draw the letter x in white on the ground
weaknesses: Only works on the ground
Only works if the x is white
Does not work on white surfaces

name: Training Space
description: The training space will have what you need in order to train your natural and supernatural abilities in an environment where no one, except someone training, will get hurt. If a mountain is needed the space will have a mountain, if a bunch of holograms are needed to fight against, then there will be holograms. The only thing it won't have though, is food. Time in the training space runs the same as the dimension you came from.
summary: The ability to teleport into and out of a space that is only for training
strengths: Always has what you need to train.
No chance of harming anyone except yourself while perfecting a dangerous technique.
It's a place outside of any dimension so only you or dimensional travelers can enter it.
weaknesses: You can starve if you forget to leave for food.
When you teleport out you will be at the same spot you were at when you teleported in.

name: Super Awake
description: You never ever need to sleep.   While others get tired after being awake for to long, being awake simply doesn't affect you that way.   This also makes you immune to powers that induce sleep.   You are still able to sleep if you'd like.  But it would just be your choice.
summary: The ability to live your life without ever having to sleep
strengths: More time to spend
You can do things while others need to sleep
Sleep deprivation has no effect on you
weaknesses: To much time to spend
Some could expect you to do things while others are asleep
Long lonely hours during the night

name: Reality Flux
description: After an often random interval of time, reality would simply change to cause some new occurrence (normally in favor of the user of the ability), or until the power is deactivated.
summary: The ability to cause reality to change randomly after only activating the power once
strengths: Gain the upper hand of foe
Get out of a situation
weaknesses: Now telling what would happen, the flux may not even apply to the user.
Useless occurrences

name: Existence Blink
description: The ability to cause a subject's physical being to be removed from this plane of existence, and then relocated back to another dimension of the user's choosing. This can be used to send people back in time, to the future, to alternate dimensions, and the like. However, you can't relocate yourself. And if you can't decide where to send the foe, you have a short time before they return.
summary: The ability to change the dimension that a subject currently occupies
strengths: You can transport anything (oncoming bullets, etc.)
They can be transported anywhere
They can also be brought back
weaknesses: Can only keep them out of existence for a short time before they have to go SOMEWHERE
Can only transport them to existing dimensions (no making up NEW dimensions)
Can't transport yourself

name: Myth Power: Aeon's Essence
description: Aeon (Aion, Chronus, Chronos, Khronos), in Greek myth, was the god of eternal time, eternity or infinity. As such, channeling him allows one to psychically perceive the passage of time, and withstand age and temporal manipulation. In addition, by touch, one can psychically induce a trance, in which subjects try to count to infinity. Furthermore, one becomes effectively immortal; if ever fatally wounded, the soul leaves the body and solidifies into a new body, complete with a new soul of its own.
summary: The ability to channel Aeon's command over the essence of eternal time, eternity and infinity
strengths: Perceive the passage of time (Chronopathy); Withstand temporal manipulation (Time Defiance) and age
Psychically induce dazed Aeon Infinity Trance, by touch, in which subject tries to count to infinity
If ever killed, soul is released, and turns into a new body with its own soul (Aeon Immortality)
weaknesses: Can't be used to manipulate/travel through time; still can die when power is NOT in use (NCN)
Pro #2 prevents foe from eating/drinking/sleeping (maybe bad for your conscience...)
Pro #2 is permanent until developed; cannot share Aeon Immortality by touch until developed (NCN)

name: Geometry
description: this allows you to project a 3-D graph of the immediate area. you can then manually change the graph, which reality then reflects. also acts as a map.
summary: The ability to manipulate reality in immediate area
strengths: change reality
weaknesses: takes time

name: Zoom Lens Eyes
description: With this ability, your eyes can zoom in on distant objects.  You have perfect vision no matter what distance you're zoomed in at!
summary: The ability to zoom your vision to any distance with perfect clarity.
strengths: No need for glasses
Zoom in on distant planets and stars
Read tiny writing from miles away
weaknesses: It'll be so much fun you'll probably want to zoom in on things all day

name: Air Drop
description: Your mysterious supplier gives you a phone number. The supplies have to drop from the sky. Any sky of of any planet in this universe. Any phone will work. You can't supply a army, just a group of friends. The supplies only drop after you're outside if you made the call from a hardline (phoneset with a wire). The supplies will always land no more than 10 feet away from you. Some things might not be availiable to you (rare and/or deadly things: Kryptonite, 100 megaton warheads, zombie viruses etc)
summary: The ability to call for a air drop of supplies from a mysterious supplier.
strengths: A source of supplies if you're not underground or in another universe.
Any phone, even the first phone ever used, works.
weaknesses: You need a phone.
Supplies can be moved away from you

name: Life And Death Transcendence
description: For starters a person with this ability can no longer be classified as living, dead, undead or anything in relation to these terms. His very existence is altered in such a way that anything (definitions, limitations, rules, etc) that applies to life or death (or anything in between) no longer applies to him. His ability or inability to act will no longer be governed by these two ever present opposing forces. This is a one way process after which you will exist in a way no one has ever before.
summary: The ability to be liberated and transcend all existential limitations of both life and death.
strengths: Transcend the need to live and the inevitability of death.
This ability also applies to superpowers that works with or against life and death.
Never again will your being alive or dead determine if you can think, act, or exist in your realm
weaknesses: You can't use any superpower that has to do with life or death, including healing and immortality
Permanent and cannot be reversed, even if the ability is nullified. Say goodbye to healing forever.
The process is instant but overwhelmingly painful and you may lose your mind as an effect.

name: Convenient Pre Boss Generosity
description: In a video game how do you know when a boss fight is coming? Because you'll find a healing station, or a shop, or a save point and a mountain of ammo piled right outside a suspicious door. With this power, the real world now works under this logic. Every time you're about to be involved in a particularly dangerous fight the universe will provide you with the means to recuperate and prepare for the coming battle. You'll find something to restore your energy or bullets. Anything convenient.
summary: The ability to have the universe be generouse right before a dificult fight.
strengths: Know when a dangerouse fight is coming because of the generousity of the universe.
Be more prepaired for the coming struggle.
Power is balanced to your power level. If you were ordinary, a mugger would count as a Boss.
weaknesses: If this power activates, it means there's no avoiding the fight. It's inevitable.
It dosen't give you an advantage, just prepares you for what is to come.
This power will not activate for fights that are impossible for you to win.

name: Temporal/ Spatial Strength
description: This ability gives the user strength that will depend on how far away they are from the time and space they were born in. If you are sent to another time or dimension, you will gain strength. In your time and space, there are two things that will give you a little bit more strength. One, a different time zone. And two, different places.
summary: The ability to gain strength through different parts of time and space.
strengths: Gain strength.
Good when you are travelling.
weaknesses: When you are in the place you are born, you are powerless.
You have to be outside city range to gain some strength.

name: Philosophic Power
description: Your strict moral code--good,evil or chaotic--lets you control, create or destroy as long you follow it every minute of every day. Time, space, energy and matter are playthings to you. However, should you waver for just one second, willingly or not, you lose all power.
summary: The ability to do anything as long as you follow a strict moral code
strengths: You're the master of the material world (time/space, energy/matter)
weaknesses: It's tough being really good all the time
Chaotic people will have trouble balancing good and evil actions.
Power only recovered after a incredible act of some kind to restore one's sense of morales.

name: Lumen Naturae
description: This power lets the wielder use the lumen naturae. This gives the wielder unrestricted access and use to all forms of nature from atoms and gravity to the classic four elements.
summary: The ability to create,control & use the lumen naturae,the light of nature
strengths: It grants the user the powers of nature
The usages of this power are very varied
It can be extremly usefull for breakthroughs in science
weaknesses: It is a very diverse power and has many responsibilities
The knowledge that comes from having this power may be too much of a burden for the user
The power of lumen naturae may have effects on the body

name: Utopia
description: Once you activate this reality bending power, anything and everything that is harmful, dangerous, ugly, and undesired will disappear forever, such as: pollution, war, homicide & suicide, physical & psychological disabilities, inner & outer ugliness, illness & disease.
summary: The ability to rid the entire planet of all things harmful, dangerous, ugly, and undesired
strengths: No more harm, danger, ugliness, or anything undesirable
weaknesses: Too perfect?

name: Do I Exist?
description: With this power you exist outside of everything; this isn't exactly omnilock, as it has a few more limitations. You exists outside of time, allowing others not to affect time while you are around. You exist outside of space, allowing others not to send you through space/teleport you etc. You exist outside of probabilities, allowing you to resist luck changing, etc. You cannot be erased from existence and have knowledge of knowledge of the effects of Reality Warping happening.
summary: The ability to exist outside of everything.
strengths: Exist outside of some (not all) things.
You resist some things.
weaknesses: Not the true omnilock power.
Still not immune to most things.

name: Mirror's Edge
description: This allows the user to separate light and dark matter. The user is then free to form the dark components into any scenery which will then affect the light components, and vice versa. Destroying one half of the space will affect the other half.
summary: The ability to create bizarre spaces interwined with each other.
strengths: Can easily travel through impossible areas.
Dissappearing ground can be a nasty surprise.
Fun to watch.
weaknesses: Won't distinguish friend from foe.
Could wreck home by mistake.
Heavily damages spacial stability.

name: Zodiacal Abilities
description: You could gain the aggressive strength of Leo (the lion), gain the control and balance of Libra (the scales, gain the attributes of the picses (the fish), eg. breathe underwater etc.  You can only obtain 1 attribute at a time.
summary: The ability to gain certain attributes of any of the twelve Zodiac signs.
strengths: Can have a choice of mulitple superpowers.
All attributes have many uses.
Very unique.
weaknesses: Slow to switch superpowers
Only can use 1 at a time.
some zodiac sign are quite useless; like Virgo (the virgin)

name: Enhancement
description: This is a support. It does nothing until attached to another power. When attached this power increasee all aspects of a power randomly up to 50%. This power can be turned into other enhancements, but loses any part that they don't have. If stolen, this power permanently affects the abiliyt it's attached to and this one is given to the thief. This can be attached to only one power at a time.
summary: The ability to enhance the all the attributes of a power by attaching this power to it
strengths: Enhances all attributes.
Can turn this into the other Enhancements.
Still have if stolen (kind of).
weaknesses: Loses any part another Enhancement doesn't have when changed.
Can only be enhanced up to 50%.
Only one power at a time and useless without another power.

name: Reality Drawing:Temporal Blast
description: This ability's formal name is Temporal Blast. This ability will allow the user to have a powerful offense. This offense ability does have the price of taking away the speed of your time depending on how powerful it is. Once the force has disappeared, all time will return back the way it was before. This ability is the sister of the ability Reality Drawing: Spacial Block.
summary: The ability to absorb the reality of one's time to form an energy blast, but before released, it slows down time.
strengths: Will have a powerful defense.
Will be immune to the ability's time-slowing effect.
weaknesses: Absorbs speed in one's time.

name: Mood Stone Jewelry
description: With these "Moon and Star" themed artifacts, you can use almost any power depending on the color. If you're happy, you gain the ability to cause powerful euphoria to the saddest person alive. If you're excited, you get the power of electricity. If you're angry, you gain the power of fire. It all depends on your mood. There are thousands of moods. If you wear all three artifacts at the same time, you will glow the same color as the artifacts's mood stone, and your power multiplies by 900!
summary: The ability to wear a necklace, two bracelets and a ring which change the power they give depending on your mood.
strengths: Use almost any power.
Be all-powerful and well-rounded.
Have all 3 artifacts, and you can GO OVER 9000!!!!
weaknesses: Don't use drugs while you're wearing one of them.

name: Card Stack Abilities: Jester
description: Your very existence creates ripples in existence which allow you to be unaffected by any reality manipulating powers as well as break the laws of physics by manipulating reality. You are the jack of all trades but master of none when concerning the powers of the Card Stack spirits. You can use all of their abilites but not to the same extent. As in a the king can always make himself move faster than you by speeding up his own time. You can also create or destroy rocks that can change reality.
summary: The ability to create ripples in existence.
strengths: Break the laws of physics with your will.
Completely unnafected by changes in the time stream, even if they would undo your birth.
Seer type ability users cannot detect you because of ripples in reality.
weaknesses: Takes a huge amount of power to use to any large extent
Only provides immunity to other Card Stack abilities if you are of an equal or higher level

name: Tv Dimensional Travel
description: This ability allows you to go into a TV and be in a TV show. When you go into the TV world, you can do what ever you want in there... anything. You can bring things into that world, and take things out, from small things to people. You can even put things from other shows and put them into other shows, but make sure you bring them back otherwise you can't get out. You can't go in reality shows because you would screw up time itself. You can't travel into games, computers, or ipods. Just TV's.
summary: The ability to travel through TV universes
strengths: Be like a god in any TV show
Control the things you bring from TV
Get out of jailby through a TV
weaknesses: You can only travel through TVs
You can't go into reality TV shows
You will take up time when in TV worlds

name: Lunar Granting Powers
description: Every time the moon shines at night, you will receive superhuman powers.  Each night, you'll become stronger & faster all cultimating to the full moon phase where you'll become a being of pure unknown energy. You'll be powerful at night, but will have to turn back to normal in the day. The only time you'll receive power in the day is when there is an eclipse. You will become a being of cosmic solar energy.
summary: The ability to gain power during phases of the moon
strengths: Gain power each night when the moon is lit
Become energy when the moon is full
Become cosmic solar energy during an eclipse
weaknesses: Turn back to normal when day approaches
Daylight savings makes your nights of power shorter

name: Refresh Upon Timeout
description: When you die, this power allows you to be reincarnated back into your mother's womb, and live out your life again. Wish everything had gone differently? This power's for you.   Any superpowers acquired in life are also inherited, so each cycle allows you to become that bit more powerful. Studying in one life will also have a knock on effect on intelligence in the next etc.   Generally the past lives cannot be remembered (except through deja vu), but 'Unforgettable' or something could solve that.
summary: The ability to be reincarnated as yourself when you die, and live your life again.
strengths: Build upon the experience and abilities of past lives
Put right any wrongs you may have committed in your life
If able to remember past lives, this is a form of precognition
weaknesses: Trapped in an infinite loop (like a 'Groundhog Life')
Cannot always remember past incarnations
Must live through all stages of your development again (birth to adulthood)

name: Sensory Deprivation
description: The user creates a mist or fog which upon contact with someone paralyzes them and cuts off all, or some of their senses as you desire. This ability does not reach full effect instantly, but creeps up on the victim. The ability manifests as a mist, nearly invisible, that moves slowly away from you toward your target, blanketing all the space in between. You are able to project this mist several hundred meters and you can also control who is affected by this ability.
summary: The ability to selectively block any sense.
strengths: Powerful ability.
Selective sense blocking.
weaknesses: Takes time to work, several seconds.
Targets can run away.

name: Alien Database
description: With this power you will know absolutely everything about every alien planet and alien species that exists in your universe. This power applies to every planet that has life on it except for your home planet.
summary: The ability to have extensive knowledge on every alien planet and alien species that exists in your universe
strengths: You will know everything about every alien planet and species
weaknesses: If their are no aliens in your universe this power is useless

name: Temporal Memory
description: When an event of the past is changed, no one remembers it, because it never happened, right? With this power, you will remember the events that took place before the change, even though no one else does.  So, let's say Bob Doorstop goes back in time and stops himself from being born, so he never existed. Thing is, you'll somehow remember him, and you'll have the motivation to go back in time and stop him.  You'll remember people, events, wars, etc even when they've been erased from time! Cool!!!
summary: The ability to remember the previous time stream after it's alteration.
strengths: Remember things that never happened.
With a time machine, you could bring events and people 'back'.
Super memory, and your friends will never be erased from existence.
weaknesses: In order to right the wrongs, you need a time machine; otherwise, you'd just remember.
Your friends would think you're crazy, remembering non-existent things.
Your brain could be a mess, provided you have a tendacy to go insane.

name: Picture Perfect
description: You can move into pictures, movies, a television, the internet and so on. You can also throw people into and trap them in the 2D dimension. You can do the opposite too, by pulling 2D characters, items, creatures and such out of the 2D world into your 3D world.
summary: The ability to move between 2D en 3D worlds.
strengths: You can move between 2D world en 3D world.
You can throw things/people in 2D world or you can pull them out.
The changes made by people/things you throw into movies for example alters reality,even when you die
weaknesses: If you die everything resets, everyone and -thing returns to their own dimension.
You cant control the things you pull out of 2D worlds, if you pull out a villain, it stays a villain
The changes made by people/things you throw into movies for example alters reality,even when you die

name: Strange Visitor
description: Each day you can say the words Strange Visitor X, & you become any fictional extraterrestial. A Kryptonian, Silver Surfer, a skrull, a Predator, a Necronom Alien, Riddick, a Covenant Elite, Lion-O, Saiyan, Jeeves (MIB), Autobot, Decepticon etc. You will look like a hybrid of you & the extraterrestrial, have all there powers & the intelligence to create whatever technology or paraphernalia they use.
summary: The ability to transform into any fictional alien ever created
strengths: Any known extraterrestial being from books, tv, movies, video games, legend etc
Sangheili, Kherubim, Oans, Daxamite, Klingon, Q (Trek), Viltrumite, Klendathu Bugs
Power lasts for 24 hours, or until you take enough damage to force you into normal form
weaknesses: The power is random and shaking off the alien's fictional agenda takes 10min.
Alf, ET, gleek, grunt, jackal, MIB worms, Ferengi, Ewok, Hutts, vulcans, Marvin the Martian
Becoming Galactus will make you want to gnaw on our pretty blue planet

name: Alternate Synchronization
description:
With this power you have an ability very close to omniscience but only in the present. You get to know all the knowledge in all the alternate universes and apply them to another universe. 

For example, if a vaccine was developed in one continuity, you can reproduce the vaccine in another continuity.
summary: The ability to have the knowledge of every alternate reality version of yourself on demand
strengths: You know a lot of people before they meet you as well as their weaknesses
You can take over the world with your knowledge
Access to a lot of technology
weaknesses: If the main one is destroyed all the other ones will disapear too
You have to collectively thwart all the enemies within each universe
Does not see the future or the past (weak against time travelling)

name: Paradise Planner
description: God saw how you're dissapointed with the world he's made, so he gave you a chance at creating a universe to see if you can do better. You must plan this universe precisely, from every event(assuming you want time to exist), to the nature of life in that world, to the location of every object(assuming this universe is physical). Every soul that has ever lived in the old universe must be included in your new universe somehow, and after it has ended they will judge it and compare it to the old one.
summary: The ability to plan, create, and live in your idea of a perfect world.
strengths: You are given a room with a computer for notes and every form of comfort that you could ever want
You will live forever in any form you choose, and you will never forget anything.
You can try as many times as you want, and, if you give up, you can return back to the old world.
weaknesses: People might not like any of your ideas of paradise.
Highly likely that, unless you're extremely determined, you may eventually give up after some time.
Highly unlikely that you will ever create something better than someone who is already omnipotent.

name: Just In Time
description: With this power whenever you have to be at an event or a show or anything you'll always be exactly on time not a second before not a second later. You can turn this power off so you can be early to things or fashionably late for things if you want.
summary: The ability to be just on time
strengths: You will always be on time
You can turn this power on and off
weaknesses: Not much use in physical combat

name: Star Sight
description: The ability to predict future events on earth by watching the stars and planets.
summary: The ability to predict future events by watching the stars
strengths: Being able to predict natural disasters
weaknesses: Some times you will feel separated from reality.
You have to see the stars.

name: Timeline Protector
description: The timeline from the moment you acquired this ability to the moment you lose it cannot be altered or prevented from flowing. In other words, any power that manipulate time won't work. There may be moments when your ability is cancelled, but, once it's reactivated, the timeline will snap back to what it should be, voiding any modification. Also, if someone travels through time during a period when your ability is cancelled, they can't go outside this period, as your ability acts as a time wall.
summary: The ability to protect the integrity and existence of your timeline.
strengths: Always active. As long as you have this power, time can't be slowed down, sped up or stopped.
Any power that affects reality or allows time travel won't work.
The periods when this power is active can neither be changed nor travelled through with time travel.
weaknesses: Can be cancelled. Though any modification is voided when your ability is reactivated.
If you're discovered, time manipulators may try to kill you to use their abilities.
You can't alter time either.

name: Vanishing Act
description: You can vanish for up to a millenium and you can choose when and where to reappear. However, it has too be on the same continent you vanished from. You would essentially be non-existant during that time, so you have no information of what happens during your absence. To you, your absence seems like a second. The only way it can be undone is by yourself or by time travel.
summary: The ability to vanish off the face of the planet.
strengths: Vanish for any amount of time up to a millenium.
Excellent evasion and mystery.
Great teleportation: you can reappear anywhere on the continent you vanished from.
weaknesses: Irreversible (except for time travel).

name: Danger Cloaking
description: This ability really uses the term "Hidden Dangers" to a new extreme. This ability affects anything that the user conceives as a threat or danger like a volcano about to erupt, lion ready to pounce, or even a new disease. Then they will place it into a pocket dimension. The user can use this pocket dim. In 2 ways. It could store the threat until the user escapes or use that threat as a trap for others. The second option shows that these dim. Have time stopping effects on things inside them.
summary: The ability to hide threats and dangers in a pocket dimension (dim.).
strengths: Put anything you think is a threat in a pocket dim.
Use that chance to escape the threat or use the threat as a trap for others
The trap activates as soon as the victim steps in to the area where the threat was sealed.
weaknesses: When not used as a trap, the threat will come out within an hour or so.

name: Chronopathism
description: Anything that gets within 4 millimeters of you gets aged by hundreds of years in mere seconds. You're forced to wear a thick suit that can withstand old age.
summary: The ability to age anything (or anyone) you get near by hundreds of years in a matter of seconds.
strengths: Every type of weapon, bullets, laser, nuclear bombs or toxins, become too old to effect you in range
Anyone you feel must be "taken out" will be easily dealt with at the mercy of time.
After training and loyalty are developed, a child can be quickly aged to the middle of their prime.
weaknesses: Full blown relationships are pretty much impossible.
Could only be considered a good bad guy power.
Everyone who's heard of you probably hates you

name: I Phone Mimicry
description: You are able to call, text, send emails and go on the Internet like any iPhone, but in your head. You also are constantly recording whatever you see, as well as being able to have an internal clock with the time. You are able to download apps and music and play them whenever you want. You can also read other people's texts and emails, as well as listen to their calls. If you are in a place without coverage or wifi signals, your powers won't work properly.
summary: The ability to mimic the functions of an iPhone from your head.
strengths: You have an iPhone in your head.
You can listen or read other people's calls or texts.
weaknesses: You powers won't work properly without coverage or wi-fi signals.

name: Reverence Of Time
description: This power grants the user the respect and high held reverence of time and temporal beings. You gain the trust of temporal entities automatically and they act favorably to you. You gain access to temporal artifacts and locations normally inaccessible to people but only if you are capable of doing so. As a bonus you are also held in a higher regard than other non temporal beings meaning that you can both converse more easily with them and they treat you better than they would treat others.
summary: The ability to hold the respect and reverence of time and it's direct associations
strengths: Ally yourself with high power elementals of TIME.
Gain temporal entities favor and hospitality.
You gain access to temporal artifacts and locations.
weaknesses: You only get PERMISSION to access temporal items/places not any necessary temporal power to do it.
You have no form of time control from this power.
You only gain the favor of temporal ENTITIES not just people with time manipulation.

name: Dimensional Rule Immunity
description: This power has two parts. The first is that you are able to resist a foe forcing you into another dimension that was created or was already there. The second part is that you are unaffected by said rules of a dimension if they tricked you into it. For example, if it only let you use your powers a certain way you could defy that rule and use them anyway. This also provides immunity to rules of Personal Realm.
summary: The ability to be immune to the rules of other dimensions
strengths: Be immune to the rules of artificial or natural dimensions.
Can't be forced into a pocket dimension.
weaknesses: There are other methods of harming you.

name: Top Hat
description: The ability to pull anything out of a top hat. The object must be able to fit through the bottom in the top hat. The item must already exist, no imaginary things, but can be from different times and dimensions. You must reach inside the hat with your hand to retrieve something.
summary: The ability to pull anything out of a top hat
strengths: Can pull anything out of any top hat
Top hat can be any size
The thing can exist in alternate dimesnions and throughout time and space
weaknesses: Must be able to fit through the bottom of the top hat
Must already exist
Have to reach inside the hat with one of your hands

name: Pet Vehicle
description: Never be stranded again! This power grants you a telepathic link with your vehicle. It comes to you when called AND it can transform into any other vehicle you can possibly think of (restrained to the boundaries of reality, of course), from a unicycle to a space shuttle. You will still need fuel for all gas consuming forms, and rocket fuel for rockets, naturally. If you are driving in car form and fuel is low, it will give you a five minute warning before turning into a bike.
summary: The ability to command a transforming vehicle
strengths: Comes to your call
Can order it to run people over with no danger to you
Could even turn into Da Vinci's self-powered flying machine
weaknesses: Still need fuel
Must be realistic: no magic buses that run on dreams and songs and pony puke
No other cons

name: Induced Paper Effects
description: A person with this ability has the power induce 'paper like' changes to everything around him. This enables him to tear, cut out, crumple, shred, throw away, write on, and fold the universe along with everything in it. Facing Invulnerable opponents? Stop them from doing anything by crumpling both space and time or even reality itself around them! After that, why not throw them away? Far, Farrr away. And that's only the beginning, the possibilities are ultimately endless! The only downside is...
summary: The ability to affect everything around you as if it was paper.
strengths: Having trouble being hit by projectiles? Why not fold the space around you? Say adios to direct hits
Up against telekinetics? Stop them dead by cutting them off from the rest of reality!
The act of someone tearing his foes into two pieces then throwing them away is a sight to behold.
weaknesses: Ohhh nothing really, except that you can't acquire or use other abilities!
This ability aside, you are still basically human with basic human weaknesses and basic human needs.
Cannot be used by 'shadowy' egotistic maniacs who think they're god or something.

name: Backwards Reality
description: The ability to manipulate or change reality by saying sentences backwards.  For instance, to stop someone in their tracks you say, "tracks in your stop."
summary: The ability to manipulate/change reality by saying sentences backwards.
strengths: You can do anything you can put into words.
weaknesses: If you are gaged you have no powers.
Got to turn sentences backwards.

name: Reality Drawing: Spacial Block
description: This ability will allow the user to have a powerful defense. This defense ability does have the price of taking away the unoccupied space depending on how big it is. Once the force field has disappeared, all space will return to its rightful place. All things that occupies space will start moving towards the user without any physical damage. This ability is the brother of the ability Reality Drawing: Temporal Blast.
summary: The ability to absorb and hold the reality of one's space to form a force field.
strengths: Will have a powerful defense
weaknesses: Causes space to come closer

name: Exact Condition
description:
When using this power the person always does things exact no more no less and reality warps subconsciously to make a person "exact"

Slight reality manipulation always have the exact amount in your wallet, when in the lab all measurements are exact and reactions perform exactly as calculated with very precise equipment
summary: The ability to always be exact
strengths: Always take exact measurement
You are always "exact"ly right in calculations
You will always have "exact"ly what you need
weaknesses: You can never be better than "exact"
If someone asks you for the exact value of pi and you try to explain, same with meaning of life

name: Instant Replay
description: Perhaps you get yourself in a debate and you'd like to repeat certain points that the opposition pointed out earlier. Instant Replay is just the thing for the job!  Forgot where you put the keys? Don't know what you ate for breakfast? Instantly Replay it in real space that you can project anywhere, anytime! What better way than to say "I told you so!" when you can just show it?
summary: The ability to instantly replay a scene, moment, or a recurring image in public
strengths: Can repeat important information required during missions
No need for electricity or gadgets
Can replace TV
weaknesses: Will only replay whatever you have seen and heard
Must have surface to project onto
Will only play reruns (hence replays) of shows (if used as replacement for TV)

name: Alti Power
description: I didn't make this. It's a power that someone named Alti has on Xena: Warrior Princess. When she touches people she can make them go through something in their past or future in the present. Once she touched Xena and made her experience being crucified from the future, and Xena's hands and feet got nail holes in them. She also made her legs feel broken another time, but didn't actually break them because she wasn't touching her.
summary: The ability to make people experience something from their past or future.
strengths: Its a friggin awesome power
You can see a person's future or past with it
It makes super PWNage
weaknesses: You have to touch a person to do it fully.

name: Adventure Time!
description: Your life is boring? Problem solved! When you say the magical words "Adventure Time", you will be treated to an awesome, dangerous and funny adventure. This way you will never get bored, and you can go on all crazy adventures that you always wanted. The adventure usually starts when something weird happens exactly after you say "Adventure Time", so have fun!
summary: The ability to make crazy, funny and cool things happen by saying out loud "Adventure Time"
strengths: You will never get bored (saying Adventure Time causes SOMETHING randomly cool to happen)
Adventures are dangerous, but you will never die in them, and they are always awesome.
weaknesses: Has no battle purposes, except maybe escape

name: Time Defiance
description: Also called Atemporality/Extemporality, Atemporal/Extemporal Existence, this implies total immunity to any and all time-based attacks, abilities and effects. A chronokinetic could speed up, slow down, reverse or even stop time, and the user would be aware of it all, because it wouldn't affect them in the slightest. The user couldn't even travel through time, or be affected by time in any way shape or form besides normal aging.
summary: The ability to resist unnatural temporal effects
strengths: Immunity to Chronokinesis/chronokinetic effects (Temporal Spike, MythPower: Kronos' Craft, etc. )
Cannot be aged/de-aged, sped up, slowed down, reversed, stop or the like (no Obliteration, etc. )
This power is often accompanied by Chronopathy, so the user can also detect temporal anomalies, etc.
weaknesses: Can't travel in time (no undoing mistakes)
Can't receive good temporal effects (superspeed, etc. ) unless you have other chronokinetic powers
Still age

name: Dream Dance
description: Dream Dance is the most vaguely-defined extradimensional energy force for you to draw your power. Dream Dance is also seen as a physical space to which you can astrally travel inside someone else's head while they are knocked out or asleep and you'll be able to detect actions and events in their dreams.
summary: The ability to simply force yourself in and out of time when you're inside someone else's dream.
strengths: You'll be able to warn someone if they are in danger.
You might tell someone if something's wrong in real life.
weaknesses: Never travel in someone else's nightmares.

name: Word Fusion
description: A person with this power has the ability to alter reality by making something new by taking two objects and mashing their names together. For example, combining an orange with a sports car to make an orange sports car, or sports car with a drink to make a sports drink or gas (car drink). You can combine two people together as well, for example you can take a Mr. Moore and a Mr. Butts to create Moore Butts. Fusions separate out after 24 hours.
summary: The ability to create a new object/person by taking the words of two objects.
strengths: You can be creative in your fusions.
You can use synonyms, i.e. you can make firefly into lightning bug to make your fusions easier.
Make valuable usable items such as rocket fuel.
weaknesses: People fusions can be totally random -- you don't know the result.
Fusions only work for 24 hours and you cannot unfuse them before then.
If things are usable items, using them will make the two composite items gone forever.

name: Remote Control Control
description: With this ability you can: make a TV remote control time, or a remote-control-car control your cat, or the dash board on your car control probability by just touching it! The problem is that you have to squeeze it for 2 minuets to get it back to normal.
summary: The ability to make some thing that controls something control something else
strengths: You can control everything
there is a loop hole to this power see if you can find it
weaknesses: You have to squeeze it for 2 minuets to get the control back to normal

name: Iamscience
description: Iam- (now) -science(knowledge) is the ability to know everything that is happening at the very moment. It doesn't mean that you know the future or the past beyond your normal ability. But you do know everything NOW. Where everything is, what everything is, and what anyone is doing or thinking... Now.
summary: The ability to know everything in the present, but not the past or future.
strengths: Useful for finding... Anything
Could be used to read minds, but not alter them.
See "Laplace's Demon", a mathematical theory.
weaknesses: Not very useful for combat
You don't know what is going to happen.

name: Schrodinger's Cat Infliction
description: The person affected by this ability is forced to replay a certain time frame between 5 minutes-1 week that may have different consequences each time depending on the person's actions. The affected person will repeat the scenario a set number of years(max 10) at the user's discretion. The scenario will restart if the person affected dies. All changes will be reversed when the scenario replays. Once the effect has worn off the person affected will regain all memories of the scenarios.
summary: The ability to freeze a frame of time for a sentient being
strengths: You can inflict on your enemies a fate worse than death(until the time limit)
You can freeze yourself in a frame of time to predict the consequences of your actions
weaknesses: There is a time limit of 10 years that you can freeze a sentient being in
The results can be unintended, for example: personality change

name: Admiral Awesome
description: Rob a bank and don't get caught when you dazzle everyone in the room by doing anything. Chewing gum, yawning, even breathing. This power is also refereed to as Fonz-ekenisis. Look at a mirror and you're trapped, staring at yourself until someone breaks the mirror.
summary: The ability to dazzle anyone into forgetting what you were doing.
strengths: Do anything and not get in trouble
Never wait in line for rides
Get rich quick for doing nothing.
weaknesses: Look out for mirrors.

name: Constellation Rearrangement
description: A person with this power can change the position of stars in the night sky by diffracting the light from the stars to change the position of stars when viewed.
summary: The ability to change the "position" of stars in the sky
strengths: Can rearrange constellations at will
Can use for advertising and message relaying
Since its actually diffracted light no damage to the cosmos occurs(directly at least)
weaknesses: Not useful in combat(or at least I can't come up with anything)
Could cause mass panic

name: Anachronism
description: One with this ability is actually born into the wrong timeline, and thus being from a time before or after their current timeline, they gain certain powers. You may be faster than normal, and age slower than normal (though this is not always the case); you may even have random or intuitive knowledge about your own timeline.
summary: The ability to exist outside of one's natural timeline as though one belonged there
strengths: If you're from the future, you may psychically get information (or visions) about the future
If you're from the past, you may psychically get information (or visions) about the past
The fact that your temporal presence is distorted may result in you being faster than normal
weaknesses: If you're born in the past, and you're from the future, people MIGHT think you're a witch.
Being a temporal anomaly sometimes results in you moving slower, or aging faster than normal
Coming into contact with anything from your true timeline, while still in the wrong one, kills you

name: Zzzzzzz Point
description: With this power whenever you point at someone they will instantly fall asleep (and probably fall to the ground) and start snoring extremely loudly. This is useful to disrupt class or get people in trouble in class by making them fall asleep and start snoring in class or you can make your enemies or criminals fall asleep long enough for you to defeat them or for the cops to come and arrest them. The person wakes up and stops snoring as soon as you stop pointing at them.
summary: The ability to make people fall asleep and start snoring by pointing at them
strengths: You can make people fall asleep and start snoring loudly
You can disrupt class
You can cause enemies to fall asleep
weaknesses: You have to be pointing at them or they'll wake up
You can't make them fall asleep without snoring

name: Ultima X Power: Transport
description: The Ultima-X Powers are a series of forces that form the bond between reality and Japanese animated, and/or drawn fiction. They can be found in anyone that has a supreme, yet healthy love for anime and anime characters. This particular Ultima-X energy allows you to pull a character through to our dimension freely, and vice versa(send the character back. ) The Ultima-X energies themselves however are not meant to be controlled, but to keep the balance between reality and fiction. Use carefully!
summary: The ability to summon modern japanese anime, manga, music, and game characters to your side.
strengths: The character you summon remains in his/her animated state, and does not change.
Having that favorite anime character beside you in times of need has never been easier!
Characters can be summoned as long as they are modern anime-styled, or drawn as such.
weaknesses: Keeping a character for too long outside of his/her reality will disrupt the fabric of reality.
Remember, the character has no knowledge outside of what he/she already believes.
Only one character can be summoned at a time every 3 months, during a new moon.

name: Surface Phasing
description: The ability to become 2 dimensional on a flat surface (similar to a shadow) and to move fluently throughout the room.
summary: The ability to move inside flat surfaces.
strengths: Chances of confusing the opponent are endless
Able to reach high and low places
weaknesses: If wall is damage, results could target you

name: Third Eye: Telekinesis
description: This power is gained by using the Third Eye power. The third Eye power slowly turns into this power the more you stare at objects from far away. You can move anything you can see with your third eye. You can stil use the Third Eye powers.
summary: The ability to telekinetically move any object one's third eye can see
strengths: An evolved form of Third Eye.
Can move objects mentally.
Can still use the Third Eye powers.
weaknesses: Must use Third Eye and look at objects a long way away.
Must see the object with your third eye.
Can't get the other formerly possible power.

name: Open Dark Voids
description: You can open up voids that will suck your enemies into a dark and unknown dimension that they can't escape from until they die. You can also control the suction force.
summary: The ability to open voids that suck people into them
strengths: Sucks in huge swarms of enemies at once
Your enemies can never escape
weaknesses: You can get sucked in too
May suck in innocent people too

name: Hgc Correlation
description: Imagine if you control and manipulate what's happening right now. You could control your friends and it would be like a some sort of video game (kind of like the movie Surf Ninjas). You might even look into the past, presant, and future on your Gameboy Advance.
summary: The ability to control events looking through your handheld game console.
strengths: It could even be like a real life Beat 'em up and Platform game.
weaknesses: You don't want to get caught.

name: Cellphone Creatures
description: You will start off with one mystic symbol on your cellphone that you can use to summon one specific species of normal animal on Earth. As you develop this power you will gain more images with which to summon creatures. The creatures that can be summoned range from lice and mice to chimera and dragons. Each image can only summon one creature at a time and you cannot summon more than 5 creatures at a time. Summon by pressing "call" while looking at the image, "end call" to unsummon.
summary: The ability to summon creatures using images on one's cellphone then control the creatures
strengths: All summoned creatures are under your command.
After developing the power you can have extremely powerful creatures.
Noone else can use your summons.
weaknesses: You need a cellphone that can process images. One cellphone can be used at a time for this power.
Summonable creatures unlock in order from weakest to strongest. Lost cellphone means a restart.
The number of images you can have is limited by your cellphone's memory.

name: Cosmic Dice
description: A few rules. No repeated results on the list. Any sized die works. The written list doesn't matter once you empower a die. One result on the list must be 'nothing happens'. The dice you make can be destroyed or stolen but are immune to probability powers. You can affect a force of the universe or a single person. Your dice only work for you. The effect of a dice roll is undone when that die is rerolled.
summary: The ability to write a result list for a die that really happens when you roll that die.
strengths: There's a die with 120 sides if you have the creativity.
Lack creativity; the 2 sided die
Will only work for you and you are unaffected by probability powers.
weaknesses: Dice can be destroyed and stolen.
Accidental die rolls that affect the forces of the universe.
A die roll that backfires against you.

name: Action Inalterable
description: Every action you complete can only be undone by you or someone else with this power. In other words, if you break something, only you can fix it. If you make something, no damage can be done to it other than damage inflicted by you. In addition, this ability also allows you to reverse your actions and re do them up to thirty seconds after said action. Time for reversal doubles itself after each use.
summary: The ability to insure anything you do remains done.
strengths: No one can break anything that you make.
No one can duplicate an object you've broken within a certain limit.
Nothing you break can ever be fixed by anyone else.
weaknesses: If you accidentally break something, without realizing it.
If you destroy something needed to society.
Cons cannot be negated.

name: Queen Of Hearts Impossibilty
description: The Queen of Hearts told Alice that she believed "as many as six impossible things before breakfast. " This power allows you to to turn belief into power! Starting at 6am in whatever time zone you are in at that time, you can alter up to six laws of physics and/or logic for up to three hours. You can determine upside-down gravity, 2 and 2 are 5, on and on. Power can only be used whilst on Earth. Laws return to normal at 9am. You cannot alter the speed or flow of time of that three-hour interval.
summary: The ability to alter up to six laws of physics and logic between 6am and 9am
strengths: You can fulfill your wildest fantasies once a day, every day
You can continually experiment with the universe
You can make things so you don't have to go to work/school before 9am
weaknesses: You have to be awake during those three hours
No matter how you alter reality, it will return to normal, and quickly
You can develop a God complex

name: Creator Of Worlds
description: This power allows you to create planets. Of course they are not created from scratch, but using the cosmic material already present in sorrounding space. The person who creates the planet can give it any desired characteristic (making it habitable, giving it a breathable atmosphere, etc. ), "hearing" at a distance every change he affixes.
summary: The ability to create planets.
strengths: The planet is perfectly autonomous (if you want so);
You can "feel" anything is going on your planet in a detailed way.
weaknesses: It could be affected cosmic balance;
You have no way to go to your creation, if not in classical ways (space travelling).
You only can create good life conditions, NOT life itself.

name: Time Spaced
description: You can invert someone's 3 spacial dimensions and 1 time dimension so he lives in 1 spacial dimension and 3 time dimensions. The effect is, if a victim moves or is moved forward, they will age, and if they move or are moved backwards, they will get younger. A victim will age either way one day for every foot they move. Time traveling victims will teleport. Teleporters will time travel in the spot they stand. This power will affect someone who can live in more then three spacial dimensions.
summary: The ability to invert someone's space-time dimensions.
strengths: Cripple super fast opponents and teleporters.
Mess with someone's existence.
Move a foe into old age or turn him into a baby.
weaknesses: Immortals.
Once time travelers learn how to teleport, they could come after you.

name: Myth Power: Helios' Help
description: Helios (Helius), in Greek myth, was the god of the sun, sunlight, sight and oaths. As such, channeling him allows one to psychically generate and manipulate sunlight, at will. In addition, one can absorb natural sunlight to gain physical power (and sustenance) at will. Furthermore, one can psychically propel oneself in flight, at will. One can also psychically propel oneself into outer space, at will (and survive its conditions). One can even psychically turn into an entity of sunlight, at will.
summary: The ability to channel Helios' command over the essence of the Sun and sunlight
strengths: Psychically generate and manipulate sunlight; gain physical power, sustenance from sunlight
Fly, propel oneself into outer space and survive its conditions
Transform into an entity of pure sunlight, at will; psychically perceive lies, at will
weaknesses: Cannot cast illusions of sun's course (rising, setting, solar eclipse, etc) until developed (NCN)
Cannot banish foes to the Sun, by touch, or open portals to the Sun, until developed (NCN)
Cannot psychically project vision anywhere the sun shines or cure blindness, until developed (NCN)

name: The Architect
description: Ever felt that your room needed more space, lighting, color, etc.? This is the power for you! Use the materials of your house or building to change it at will, even making them move.
summary: The ability to manipulate buildings
strengths: Mobile home takes a new meaning
If there are weapons in the structure, you may relocate them
Change home every day
weaknesses: You need materials in order to make changes that involve size
You can accidentally break rules in the apartment or dorm
You need some type of building

name: Bottomless Pit
description: Disclaimer. Bottomless pit is actually a dimension and it's only 1 billion miles deep. You can open a pit under someone who up to 200 feet away from you. The pit opening can be 20 feet wide. Inside the pit it's five miles in diameter. The pit will collapse on itself if a victim dies,lands on bottom or escapes. You can collapse your own pits but not pits of others.
summary: The ability to open a bottomless pit at will under someone.
strengths: You can hide in one in you need to.
As long as a foe lacks certain powers he's gone.
weaknesses: This power is useless against teleportation,dimension jumping and those who fly.
Any other powers that would counter the effect of this power.
A foe with this power.

name: Animal Humanoid Evolution
description: All you do is touch a non human animal like a dog or ape & they will start to instantly evolve into a humanoid. They will have the characteristics of man increased intelligence, speech, bipedal for some etc. Depends on what animal it is. Their whole structure will change to resemble a human's except their genetics will stay the same. Though they might try to take over, fight & enslave man for domination & their primitive instincts could surface like killing to eat.
summary: The ability to make animals anthropomorphic
strengths: Make a man-like walking talking animal
Who knows what secrets we could learn from the animal kingdom
weaknesses: Might rise up & try to claim for domination of the better species: man vs man-imals
Their animal instincts could surface & take over them. Making them deadlier.

name: Catalysis
description: If you paid any attention in Chemistry class, you might remember that a catalyst is a substance that speeds up the chemical reactions of other substances.  With the power of catalysis, you can speed up any chemical process. This is actually a warping of space/time, but targeted to specific chemical processes only. For instance, you can make someone's car rust instantly, or age the cheddar in your fridge. Or, disable your enemies by speeding up their cell division rate, causing them to age!
summary: The ability to speed up chemical processes using your mind
strengths: Speed up decay processes to render almost anything unusable
Cause wounds to heal quickly
Always have perfectly aged cheddar cheese on hand!
weaknesses: Once you've used your powers, there's no reversing the process

name: Nudality
description: By doing a simple gesture, your foe is surrounded in a puff of smoke. Your opponent loses their clothes and starts to shiver covering their most private parts.
summary: The ability to make all of your opponent's clothes vanish completely.
strengths: A greater thing for embarrassment.
weaknesses: None.

name: Allpower Time
description: Ever wanted a particular power, but could never find it? You knew there was a time when all were available, but it was just as elusive. Well, with this power, you will sense when the time is active.
summary: The ability to sense when all powers are available on the superpower list.
strengths: Always gain a power you want.
Help your friends on the site too.
Harmless, so nobody will fear you.
weaknesses: You may not have site access at the time.
You need to acquire this power first, which puts you in a Catch-22 position.
People may nag you for the time.

name: Collective Noun Creation
description: A herd of elephants,a troop of gorillas or a howling of werewolves. If you can find the collective noun for a creature somewhere(the internet,a book)you can bring a average-sized group of that creature into existence. The group of creatures obeys you. You can only have one group at a time. What you create still has any traditional weaknesses. Your coven of vampires is still affected by sunlight and also affected by undead control powers.
summary: The ability to bring the collective noun for a creature into existence.
strengths: There are many useful animals that have collective nouns.
There are collective nouns for mythical creatures... A dignity of dragons.
Yes,you can create a crowd of people.
weaknesses: There's more collective nouns for natural animals than mythical ones.

name: Time To Die
description: With this ability you can look at any living organism and see it's life span. You will be able to see exactly when, where, and how someone or something will die.
summary: The ability to see exactly when and how someone or something will die.
strengths: You will know when anything will die
You will know how long you have to prevent the death, if you want too
You will know what you should do to prevent the death, if you want too
weaknesses: You cannot know learn your own fate
You might upset the natural balance sooner or later
If you did look at your own timeline somehow, you'd die right after you're done looking

name: Dimension Destination Control
description: Within 100 feet of you someone dimension traveling will go to a dimension of your choice. You can mentally preset this dimension or change it at will. This power also effects those traveling to other planes or alternate universes. Anyone who possesses the power PA:Ithuari is immune to this power. A few dimensions are off limits for this power (No con negation).
summary: The ability to control where someone goes when they dimension travel.
strengths: Decide where (universe, plane, dimension) dimension traveler goes.
Ergi, the dimension where it's 11 billion degrees.
weaknesses: You can't send anyone to Nameless(i.e. the power PA:Nameless).

name: Gaze Of Contempt
description: A sort of reality warping that allows you to project your willing suspension of disbelief onto the world. While it will not depower anyone, it will prevent powers you find to be ludicrous or logically incoherent from affecting you directly. You may still be harmed by secondary affects (e. G. A building falling over, etc)
summary: The ability to ignore any superpower you personally deem to be stupid.
strengths: Humiliating defeats will be a thing of the past.
Power through annoying novelty midbosses like a hot knife through butter.
weaknesses: Silver age superheroes will think you're a jerk.

name: Temporal Transformation
description: When the user transforms time will either stop or will be slowed down. It's basically like how the characters from Sailor Moon or Winx Club do transformations and the enemy seems not to move at all until their finished transforming.
summary: The ability to freeze or slow down time during a transformation
strengths: Time slows or stops during transformation
weaknesses: Time Defiance or other time powers can interfere with this

name: Syringe Manifestation
description: With this ability, you can materialize a syringe filled with a virus. The virus responds to your will and can be easily programmed to cause any effect simply by thinking it. Once injected into a person, the effect begins to take place in the time designated by how you imagined it. Any physical effect can be caused by the virus, including but not limited to illness/curing cancer/transformation/brain washing. The effects do not wear off and are not affected by immune systems.
summary: The ability to create syringes filled with magical reality-bending viruses.
strengths: Control people's bodies entirely through injections.
Cure cancer.
Use it on yourself to give yourself physical-based superpowers like super strength.
weaknesses: Once the virus manifests itself for one use, the needle can be used against you.
Once injected, you will have to administer another dose if you wish to change the transformation.
Some transformations may turn out wrong and you may be overcome with guilt.

name: Breakdown
description: When touching organic material with skin-to-skin contact, the area being touched will start to break down on the cellular level, eventually turning the object or area into a puddle of ooze. Contact must be maintained the entire time. It only affects the area being touched extending out at all angles within a six-inch radius. The ability is always on, and the user is not immune to their own abilities. If applied to a normal human at the shoulder, the arm would break down and drop off in 2 min.
summary: The ability to break down organic material
strengths: Breakdown starts on contact
Most wounds are fatal if contact is maintained
Can cause aggravated damage
weaknesses: Must maintain skin-to-skin contact to work
Can damage yourself
Hands must always have some kind of synthetic covering on them

name: Pharmacy!
description: Have you ever had a problem where the insurance doesn't cover medication cost? Worry no more! With this power, you can make any medicine appear instantly! Limited to three types of medication at a time. Side effects may include hypervigillance and paranoia. These side effects are only temporary. Talk to see if pharmacy is right for you.
summary: The ability to make any medication appear in your hands.
strengths: Make medicine appear in your hands.
Side effects are temporary.
Can't summon medicine that makes you high.
weaknesses: You will be hypervigillant.
You'll have paranoia.
Can't summon medicine that makes you high.

name: Past Revival.
description: With this power you will reincarnate in the past anytime that you die. You will reincarnate a certain number of days in the past that is equal to the number of days that you lived. You would be born to a random family that is having a baby at that time. You keep your same appearance even if the family you are born too has a different appearance. Upon turning five all your memories come back from your future lives. You could meet yourself if you lived longer than previous life.
summary: The ability to reincarnate in the past.
strengths: Can live major moments in history.
Could change the future since you know future events.
Wont die until you get back to the time of the first humans.
weaknesses: Everyone you know would eventually not be born yet.
Most modern day things would not be invented yet if you go back far enough.
You wont have your memories first five years of life, if thats a problem.

name: Rebirth
description: With this ability you can start life over anytime in a new body & family. On 2 conditions: you can't use the power before the age of 13 & your body turns to ash as your soul remains in the state he is until a new baby body is available. Also, you keep memories of your ancient life and that you have the power. On your 13th birthday, you will receive a notebook reminding you fully of your old life and the reason you used the power.
summary: The ability to be reborn into a new body any time after the age of 13.
strengths: Can start life over
Practically immortal
weaknesses: You can possibly wait a long time before your rebirth
Can't use your power before the age of 13
Sudden memory of past life can cause trauma and nightmares

name: Death Hallucination
description: Basically, you trap someone in a hallucination that ends with their death. The time spent in the hallucination can't be longer than a day, which means their death is guaranteed. The hallucination is instantaneous in real time, so no matter how long they spend in the hallucination, no time will pass outside. The hallucination can be anything from the world exploding, to a zombie apocalypse, to just getting hit by a car.
summary: The ability to trap people in a hallucination that ends with their death.
strengths: Pretty fun.
Can be used on yourself
Experience the world blowing up, if you're bored
weaknesses: May drive people insane if you aren't careful.

name: Aut   Phone
description: The AUT - phone is a handheld device that resembles an iPhone, the time on the phone is unlimited.
