A whitish silver portal is opened by pressing a button on the phone that sets it to open a wormhole to a new dimension, and with this phone, it can instantly gain knowledge from any universe you travelled in.
summary: The ability to travel to any paralell universe with the use of an alternate iPhone.
strengths: You might find interesting cultures in many alternate universes.
weaknesses: If you don't like this universe, you'll leave.

name: Omni Vampire
description: Are you getting sick and tired of people with omnipotence? Worried about being spied on with omnipresence? Can't catch someone with omniscience? Well, if you get this power you will continuously drain the life out of them. Their powers are blocked. This power can affect the whole universe.
summary: The ability to drain life from omni-powered beings.
strengths: Get many powers.
Omnipotence is no longer invincibility!
No more omni powers!
weaknesses: Warning: Ownership of omni powers in conjunction with this is suicide.
Whatever you do, don't choose omnipotence.
Can't use this power against someone else with this power.

name: Awakened Power
description: A person who has the Awakened Power has the ability to max out all of one's abilities to the maximum level the dimension can handle. Such as strength, speed or other super powers to their most powerful, making the person more powerful than even most gods for a short period of time. To use the Awakened Power, one must know the name of their soul, not the name given to them by their parents at birth.
summary: The ability to max out all of one's stats and powers for a cost.
strengths: You can become stronger than anyone to the point the Hulk looks as weak as a kitten
Your senses will also be maxed out, such as sight and sound and even touch.
All other powers will also be maxed out such as semi fire control into universal fire control
weaknesses: Must know the name of your soul.
Best used by immortals as it can shorten a mortal's life span by 10 years each time they use it.
Maxed out senses mean maxed out sensitivity

name: Evolution Of Pokemon
description: With this power you can pick a combination of two Pokemon types and evolve up to two times to gain powers based on which combination you choose and how you use your powers while you are evolving. As you evolve you become more Pokemon like. Which types you pick as your primary and secondary types changes how you will become. You will learn four skills as you evolve based on how you train power. You can change out of Pokemon form at will. Can change types but will have to retrain powers.
summary: The ability to evolve in a similar way to the way a Pokemon does.
strengths: Become any combination of Pokemon types.
Learn up to four special skills to use while in Pokemon form.
Can change type choices and can change out of Pokemon form to normal at will.
weaknesses: Can not use learned skills if not in Pokemon form.
Have to retrain if you want to add the ability to change into a different type combo.
Watch out for MasterBalls.

name: Apocalypse
description: Nuclear War, pandemic, alien invasion, robot uprising, economic collapse, environmental collapse, EMP strikes. These are among threats that could end civilization as we know it. You can select and shift details of any sort of apocalypse you choose, and travel to alternate timelines where it has occurred or where it will occur. Your power will eventually choose a time in the main timeline-and slowly torture you if you refuse to end the world. This is open to modification by other powers, however.
summary: The ability to control the end of the world as we know it
strengths: Have private access to alternate timelines of your choosing/control, along with privacy in them
If the time isn't 'right,' you can reverse the damage of other potential apocalypses
You can also start the apocalypse at will, but then reverse it or dampen its effects
weaknesses: Unless you are VERY careful with the real time-line effects, people will try to kill you
If you choose to enter one of the timelines and be able to take things out of it, you can die in it
The glorious post-apocalyptic genre of fiction might get to be pretty boring for you

name: Superpower List A Day
description: This ability lets you have any power on this list in order for 12 hours when you start to use it
summary: The ability to have a power from the superpower list everyday
strengths: Any power on the list
Cool powers
weaknesses: Only last one day
Only for 12 hours of that day
In alphabetical order

name: Artistic Influence
summary: The ability to get any power depending from the meaning of an artwork.
strengths: A very wide range of acquirable powers, as various as the artistic production;
The possibility to choose some favorite artworks which effect is more appreciable;
The power is mantained for all the time the subject needs.
weaknesses: The subject must have a representation of the artwork with him, and in front of him;
Every power is limitated;
The subject's feeling must be properly "inspired".

name: Spacial Scroll
description: The spacial scroll is a giant red scroll with black star which. By touching an object and saying seal the object will then be teleported into the scrolls hammer space. to get an object out of the scroll just think of the object and say release and it will teleport out of the scroll.
summary: The ability to ustore unlimited items with in it
strengths: Store unlimited amount items
Make packing easy
weaknesses: teleporting large obejects out may hit you
scroll can only teleport objects inside and outside

name: The Master Musician
description: With this power you can play any musical instrument perfectly and you can play any song on it. You can play as many instruments at a time as you want provided that it is humanly possible (if you have one of those one man band things you could play that perfectly)
summary: The ability to play any musical instrument perfectly
strengths: You can play any musical instrument perfectly
You can play as many musical instruments at a time as you want
weaknesses: Not much use in physical combat

name: Inheritance Manipulation
description: The user can use this ability to inherit anything that he/she could inherit; the ones that give the user the inheritance do not have to be dead. One can inherit anything from your family or other kinds of relationships. It can be powers, wealth, possessions, skills, etc. Of course, that means you are actually taking their things before their time. The only people that are not affected by this ability, other than people you don't have a close relationship with, are your descendants.
summary: The ability to control anything that you could inherit.
strengths: Get your inheritance early
Manipulate them
You can give your off-springs some or all of the power.
weaknesses: Descendants

name: Cosmic Lost And Found
description: With this power any object that was totally destroyed or negated from reality in a 5-mile radius of you will appear in your immediate vicinity. A nullified superpower will move to your body then back to the person who lost it. The bigger the object, the further it will be away from you-Giganto the 50-foot-tall hero won't appear in your house, he'll appear in your street. Objects small enough to fit in your shirt pocket will appear there. This power will bring objects that could hurt or kill you.
summary: The ability to undo the negation of things and superpowers and bring them near you.
strengths: Stop a fellow hero from suffering an ultimate death and losing his powers.
Help a fellow hero recover priceless equipment.
weaknesses: The super villain who just was erased from reality appears before you.
This power doesn't filter out the harmful things from harmless things.

name: Bleeding Time
description: Time exists in the marrow of your bones. Temporal abilities are produce with each new blood cell. Your heart is a pathway to temporal awareness (you can feel time & space within your heart). Oxygenating your blood causes you to slip from one place in time to another. You can direct your path by tasting your blood & thinking of where to go. You can take a friend with you by cutting them & mixing blood. If your heart is pierced, you will not die but you will exist forever, nowhere.
summary: The ability to bleed moments of time with each cut or laceration you suffer
strengths: Slip into any point in time, reduce space by altering the time it takes to go from A to B
You will never need a watch, you can feel in your heart exactly what time it is
Heal yourself and others by temporally speeding up the healing process
weaknesses: Blood born pathogens, you may learn to isolate and age pathogens but you're not immune
You must consciously to heal yourself
You must taste your blood or you risk slipping into any random timestream

name: Theme Park Reality
description: This reality power affects an area the size of Disney World and only works from 9 a.m. to 10 p.m. Once this power is activated, any structure will change into rides and attractions based on your life experiences and your powers. Any other super beings around you will become normal people pretending to have super powers. The Hulk would become a guy wearing a Hulk costume. Actually leaving the park or trying to hurt or kill someone will revert reality back to normal.
summary: The ability to turn your surroundings into a theme park based on you.
strengths: Make lots of money.
Who wouldn't want their own theme park?
Imagine a ride based on spacetime indemnity.
weaknesses: Some attractions/rides could require people to be 18 or older.
Dull powers equals low attendance.

name: Simon Says
description: You can possess a unique power of warping reality by yelling out "Simon Says". For example - You could rearrange the molecules of your body at will into any form you choose, psionically levitate yourself in any of your forms, reproduce by dividing yourself into two identical beings, deflect projectiles, cause enemies to stumble or otherwise suffer the effects of misfortunes, teleportation, and/or you can do everything at once by saying the title name.
summary: The ability to manipulate reality and the laws of the universe by saying the title name.
strengths: The Title says it all.
weaknesses: You can only say it if your name is Simon or Simone (Female name for Simon).

name: Indirect Total Immunity
description: This power renders you immune to powers a person uses against you that they have not directly gained. This means that no mimicked, shared, gifted, or other indirectly gained power a person tries to use against you will work. This applies to the users of power sharing or gifting who give others powers in excess to make powerful teams. The exception is that if a person uses a power to figure out how to use other powers can and you are still affected by powers replicated from reality warping.
summary: The ability to be immune to powers that a person themselves have not directly gained.
strengths: A good defense against teams of people who share powers to become extremley powerful.
You can still use all powers that you have mimicked and can be affected beneficially.
You can still use power sharing or gifting yourself.
weaknesses: If a person has a lot of directley acquired powers to start with.
If people dont share powers but work together.
Still affected by weapons created by shared powers.

name: Survival Board Game
description: This power allows you to create a survival board game like Jumanji except you can create any theme you want, such as a zombie board game. Each player takes turns rolling a dice to see how far to move their character on the board, when they do they will get a card. Whatever is written on the card will come true in real life, such as "Zombies attach your school, move back two spaces" which is where the survival part comes in. Reality resets once the game is completed.
summary: The ability to create a survival board game like Jumanji.
strengths: Create multiple types of board games.
Fun for the whole family.
Reality resets to the point when the game began once the game is completed.
weaknesses: Requires at least two people to use.
The effects of the game won't end until the game is finished.
It is called a survival board game for a reason.

name: Soon
description: With this power, you will always know the exact time down to the second, someone is referring to when they say "soon". The person doesn't even have to know when they're referring to, but you will know when the payoff will happen. For example, if you ask a teacher when you're going to get your test grades back, and they say soon, but actually have no idea when they'll gave them back, you will know exactly when you'll get it back.
summary: The ability to know exactly when somebody is talking about when they tell you 'Soon'
strengths: You will always know when someone will do something when they say soon
weaknesses: This power is very confusing to explain to people
Not much use in physical combat

name: Enhancement: Exponential
description: This is a support. It does nothing until attached to another power. When attached, it boosts the other power exponentially. Ex: If the power level of a power is 1 it is boosted to 1, 2 it is boosted to 4, 6 it is boosted to 46656, etc. If attached to powers that are already too powerful this power acts like Enhancement: Uncontrollable, without the benefits. This power can only be attached to one power at a time. If this power is stolen, the power it is attached to is permanently enhanced.
summary: The ability to boost a power exponentially
strengths: Attaching this power to a shielding power.
weaknesses: Useless without another power.
Beware of backlash from attaching it to powers that are already too powerful.
Con Negation and similar powers have no effect on this power.

name: Under Space (Sub Space) Access
description: Under-Space (Sub-Space) is a dimension that lies between the 3rd and 4th dimensions. This dimension is the storehouse of cosmic information. The universal harddrive. The user of this ability would be in a sense, WI-FI connected to this dimension at all times.
summary: The ability to mentally access the dimension of Under-space (Sub-Space).
strengths: All information desired would be known.
Infinite knowledge.
Read 1 and 2.
weaknesses: Infinite knowledge sounds great, but do you really want to know everything?
Until one really learns to control this power, one will know things they don't want to know.
Can drive one mad. MAD FOR ABSOLUTE POWER!

name: Reality Destruction
description: This power allows the user to release the energy within his/her body in the form of an energy explosion which will destroy anything in the vicinity, even the fabrics of time and space. This will cause abnormal phenomena, most of which defies the natural laws, to take place in the affected area. The bad news is that the user gets destroyed as well.
summary: The ability to destroy/disrupt the natural laws through an explosion
strengths: Destroy everything in the area near you
This move can't be stopped by anything, even other superpowers
weaknesses: You'll end up destroying yourself afterwards
The resulting damage from the attack is permanent and irreversible.

name: Atomic Knowledge
description: With this power, you know the elements that make up every molecule of every substance you can see. You can inspect anything in sight, and remember everything. You can choose to forget things you've seen, unless it comes back in sight. You can't turn off this power, and it might overwhelm you if you aren't careful.
summary: The ability to know atomic makeup of everything in sight.
strengths: Be the ultimate scientist.
Figure out the truth of the world.
Forget unwanted elemental compounds.
weaknesses: No combat uses. (Except for knowing your opponent's atomic makeup, if it is confusing. )
You cant control this power, and you may get overwhelmed.
Sometimes, the dark secrets of the universe overwhelm you before you can forget about them.

name: Temporal Destination Control
description: Within a 100 feet of you, time travelers go to a past or future time of your choice. Mentally preset this time or change it whenever you want. The time you choose can't exceed the temporal limits of the time travel power of anyone affected by this power.
summary: The ability to control when in time a time traveler goes when they time travel.
strengths: Send foes to a dark, dead and cold future universe.
A good combo with a teleportation control power.
weaknesses: Time defiance or powers like it provide immunity to this power (NCN).
Someone's time travel ability may be limited.

name: Myth Power: Chaos' Cataclysm
description: Chaos (Khaos, Aer, Air), in Greek myth, was the god of emptiness, lower air and the unordered cosmic discord of outer space. As such, channeling it allows one to psychically disperse one's molecules into a nearly invisible cloud, or to turn intangible. In addition, one can psychically manipulate space, at will (even generating vacuums of airless space; within structures, they implode). One can even send back matter to a state similar to original chaos, effectively obliterating matter, by touch.
summary: The ability to channel Chaos' command over the essence of emptiness, the lower atmosphere and cosmic discord
strengths: Spatial Manipulation (Vacuum Generation, Phasing, entropy/disintegration/vaporization immunity, etc)
Send matter back to its original chaotic state (obliterating matter)
Withstand being directly perceived or affected by any other MythPower
weaknesses: Cannot travel to/survive unaided in space (Vacuum Adaptation) until developed (NCN)
No Dimensional Energy Manipulation (Dimensional Travel, etc) until developed (NCN)
No Entropy Manipulation, Molecular Manipulation or Aerokinesis until developed (NCN)

name: Musical Reality Bending
description: Do you see those music videos like "Cooler than me" by mike posner? Where he gets to stop time while he sings, or Rihana being able to sing while she's on fire? Well guess what, now you can too!!! Using these songs, you can bend reality to suit your needs. You can start off mimicking those music videos which were already created, but it's much better if you make your own.
summary: The ability to warp reality in a way similiar to music videos
strengths: Make dancing zombies shuffle.
Teleport from one place to another with different clothes as well.
weaknesses: Those who do not know songs.
Mimicking from music videos lack originality.

name: Anime Entering
description: You can enter any image - as long as it's done in anime style. You'll be a character in the story/picture and be part of that story/world (won't show on the outside). You can return in the exact time and state that you left in
summary: The ability to enter any anything that's drawn in anime style
strengths: Can be from anywhere- including fanart
You'll look like an anime character
You can bring other people with you
weaknesses: It must be done in anime style
If you die, you'll return to the real world and can't head back for a year

name: Nova Outburst
description: One can create mini or massive supernovas with their hands. The massive supernova starts from one's heart. Then, one begins to glow bright, exposing heat and radiation. Afterwards, one explodes, causing an extremely luminous bright light to be seen thoughout the galaxy. Anything in a hundred mile radius will be eliminated, except the core. Sometime after, the massive supernova, a neutron star or a black hole is created.
summary: The ability to create a supernova from inside oneself
strengths: Create luminous light
Can create a neutron star
weaknesses: Can eliminate things close to you
Creates harmful radiation
Can create a black hole

name: Holy Power: Reality Distortion
description: Using the Gunslinger Pistols, you can absorb dark matter and then concentrate it into your pistols, using it as bullets. When your shots hit the foe, you distort the reality around them and create small "Crushes", completely destroying them. This attack is precise and deadly, but absorbing enough Dark Matter to use it, takes time and wastes too much energy.
summary: The ability to shoot a powerful attack, that distorts the universe around your target and destroys him.
strengths: You can destroy nearly anything.
It is very hard to block this power.
weaknesses: This power is slow and wastes energy.

name: Shuriken Strike
description: With this power you can shoot super sharp shuriken (ninja stars) from your palms at your enemies
summary: The ability to shoot ninja stars from the palms of your hands
strengths: The stars are super sharp and can pierce through metal, rock and just about anything else
weaknesses: You might accidentally cut yourself

name: Reflection Switching
description: This power is difficult to describe. You don't actually have a reflection, but you can trade places to where your reflection would be, effectively disappearing in the real world. When in "mirror world" you are still vulnerable to reflections of things, but anything that isn't reflected doesn't exist, and is replaced by a white void that you can move through at will. Through this realm, you have access to all mirrors and reflective surfaces, but searching for the portal you want may take time.
summary: The ability to trade places with your reflection
strengths: Get into any facility with a mirror
Awesome hiding place
weaknesses: Must have a mirror
Still vulnerable to reflections
Switching through non-uniform surfaces (puddles or broken mirrors) could seriously mess you up

name: Doom
description:
This ability permits the user to cast a time-limit on a person for how long left they have to live.
The minimum time is 60 seconds and time-limits can not exceed 12 months. Can not do instant death or cast an infinite time-limit. The time-limit you cast can not be changed afterwards.
summary: The ability to cast a time-limit on people till they are dead
strengths: Cause people to die in exactly 1 minute.
People who deserve to die can die as soon as a minute is up thanks to this ability.
weaknesses: Can not cause instant death.
Can not reverse or stop time-limit. (Be careful who you use it on)

name: Myth Power: Pandia's Pander
description: Pandia (Pandeia), in Greek myth, was the goddess of the full moon's light and youth. As such, channeling her allows one to psychically generate moonlight, at will. In addition, one can psychically absorb ambient moonlight to recover and gain physical power, at will. Furthermore, one can psychically propel oneself in flight, at will. One can also psychically propel oneself into outer space, at will (and survive its conditions). One can even psychically restore health and youth, by touch, at will.
summary: The ability to channel Pandia's command over the essence of the light of the full moon and youth
strengths: Psychically generate full-moon moonlight, absorb moonlight to gain physical power and heal, at will
Fly, propel oneself into outer space and survive its conditions
Psychically restore subjects' health and youth, by touch, at will
weaknesses: Cannot psychically induce/negate madness, or lycanthropy, by touch, until developed (NCN)
Cannot psychically turn subjects into stupid, deformed mooncalves, by touch, until developed (NCN)
Sun/moon/sky/celestial-based MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)

name: Offensive Bubble Breath
description: A person with this power can blow out bubbles of many different colors, each with a different effect. They can blow out all of one color or various colors at a time. The effects are listed in the Pros and Cons.
summary: The ability to blow out bubbles with various effects depending on their color
strengths: Red Bubbles-explode on contact,
Green Bubbles-sticks on skin, is lightly acidic, and becomes a bubble prison
Blue Bubbles-expands and pushes things away
weaknesses: Black Bubbles-releases poison gas when popped
Orange Bubbles-ignition on contact
Yellow Bubbles-electric shock on contact

name: Man Boido Dangan
description: Some may call this overpowered, but the art of Man Boido Dangan (Ten-thousand void bullets) is quite complicated. The user brings out many bullets from the void, and can control them with his/her mind. One bullet is quite weak, but many can be powerful. The user has a limited amount of bullets though, but can stop shooting at any time.
summary: The ability to cause a vast amount of bullets to come out of a void, and be able to control them..
strengths: Powerful when used in a large amount.
weaknesses: Has a limited amount
Weak on their own

name: Pixmension
description: One must hold a photograph, drawing, picture, etc, and then blink. When they reopen their eyes they are in the pixel dimension. Once in the dimension one can only explore the region of the picture and can only get out through the picture they came in--unless there is a picture in the picture; then they can get out from there. Back in the real world in the picture/whatever one entered, the user will be in it. If the picture/whatever one entered is destroyed then the person is trapped forever.
summary: The ability to enter the pixel dimension
strengths: Go to the past
Travel the world
Visit make believe worlds
weaknesses: Only can stand for 15-20 hours
Can only re-enter after 5-10 hours
Destroy the Picture means lost forever

name: Enhancement  Sharing
description: With this power you can share almost any enhancement power you have with others. There are 3 rules. 1. You can only attach an enhancement once to a power. No getting multiples of the same enhancement and attaching them to the same power. 2. You can have an enhancement attached to only one power at a time. 3. Enhancement: Untouchable and Enhancement: Reflecting cannot be shared with others. This power cannot be altered for more or less rules.
summary: The ability to share almost any enhancement power
strengths: Help allies with the enhancements you have.
Rules can't be added by enemies (or allies).
weaknesses: Useless without enhancements.
This power cannot be affected by Con Negation or similar powers.
Cannot share some enhancements.

name: Myth Power: Astra Planeta1
description: The Astra Planeta (Astra, Asteres) in Greek myth, were the gods of the five Wandering Stars (Planets). As such, channeling Stilbon (Stilbos, Hermaon- Planet Mercury) allows one to fly, as well as gain adaptation to survive in space, and on Mercury. In addition, one can psychically generate an aura mimicking Mercurian gravity, weather and air conditions, at will. One even gains favor with Mercury's patron, Hermes, to resist and benefit from his domains (cunning, theft, speed, language, etc).
summary: The ability to channel the Astra Planeta and their command over the essence of the planets
strengths: Gain flight; gain adaptation to survive in space, and on Mercury (physical change voluntary)
Psychically generate an aura mimicking Mercurian gravity, weather and air conditions, at will
Gain favor with Mercury's patron god, Hermes; resist and benefit from his domains
weaknesses: Cannot teleport self to Mercury at will (others by touch) until developed (NCN)
Cannot generate Mercury-patterned forcefield (or project Pro #2 onto others) until developed (NCN)
MythPower: Hermes' Hustle and sun/moon/sky/celestial-based MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)

name: Holy Power: Star Extinction
description: Using the Gunslinger Pistols, you can absorb the energy from the stars, from the galaxy, from the planets and the universe itself, concentrating this energy into the Gunslinger Pistols, and then shooting it in the shape of light. When this light reaches your enemy, its energy create a small Big Bang, destroying the target. Surviving this attack is nearly impossible and it wastes a lot of energy.
summary: The ability to shoot a volley of light over your enemy, creating a small Big Bang over him, destroying him.
strengths: Nearly impossible to escape.
This power can destroy most of the things in the universe.
Immortality is probably the only power that would save your enemy's life from this ability.
weaknesses: Wastes a lot of energy.
You can hurt a lot of people if you use this on the wrong place.
Gunslinger only.

name: Induce Insanity
description: Insane in the membrane. This is a mental attack, with it you can cause madness in a person or group of people that have no mental illness. If you stare at them using your power, they'll become completely schizo. They'll lose total grip of reality becoming delusional, lose control over themselves, paranoid, catatonic, & even hostile. So be careful not to get to close to them. You can also make them sane again. This power doesn't work on people already mentally ill though
summary: The ability to cause someone to go mad
strengths: Cause madness in a person or crowd
Create total anarchy when unleashing craziness to the world
Can make them sane again
weaknesses: The victim may become hostile & dangerous to you
People already with mental illness cannot be affected

name: As The Crow Flies
description:
With this power you can find all the shortcuts from one place to another

This includes finding gaps in space time. 

This also makes you competent in parkour
summary: The ability to have the knowledge of the shortest path and the capacity to make it there
strengths: Parkour Master
Be the fastest in a race most of the time
Find hidden passages
weaknesses: Can only move from point A to B
Does not make you invincible or immortal

name: Existence Hostage Taker
description: This power is of solipsism. A sphere up to 1000 feet in radius surrounds you when you choose to activate this power. When made asleep or unconscious, everything you could see in the radius of your power will vanish from reality. If you are killed, the same thing happens. Using drugs or sleeping gas on yourself will also make things vanish. If you're erased from reality, this power still works.
summary: The ability to make reality around you vanish if you're killed or knocked unconscious.
strengths: A foe's instant destruction power won't have any advantages against you.
An opponent will be forced to take you alive and conscious.
weaknesses: If you can't be killed, made unconscious or put to sleep.
Someone with immutability or a power like immutability.

name: Power Of 10
description: A person with this power can use any power as long as it involves the number 10. The only limit to this power is imagination and restrictions that involve the number 10. The user can only use this power 10 times a day. Each power usage last 10 seconds of real time. The user must have 10 written or worn on their body to use this power. The user cannot use the exact same power after using that power 10 times before. Clones cannot make more clones and has same "power counter" as when they were made
summary: The ability to use any power you can think of as long as it involves the number 10 with restrictions on power usage
strengths: Can use almost any power(as long as it involves the number 10 in application and usage)
A skilled user can use loopholes to their advantage
Has many practical applications
weaknesses: Must involve the number 10
Restrictions involving the number 10
Must take notes etc and overuse of power leads to short power lifespan--practical wise

name: Mirror Your Enemy
description: A defensive power, using this you copy your opponents move at the exact time he makes them, making you as if you just his image in a mirror. This extends to powers, but you can use those powers until your Mirrored enemy does.
summary: The ability to mirror your enemy.
strengths: Good defensive power.
weaknesses: Sucks at offense.

name: Pick Of Destiny
description: Anyone who obtains the pick of destiny can play the Instantly become the best guitar player in the known universe. First seen in the movie "Tenacious D and the pick of Destiny"
summary: The ability to play the guitar masterfully
strengths: Play the guitar better than anyone ever.
weaknesses: Satan will try to steal the pick.

name: Emesis Inducing
description: With this power you can cause anybody to vomit whenever you want. You can even make them vomit multiple times in a row. Eventually they will have no food left in them and become sick therefore making them easier to defeat. Or you could just use this power to make people throw up on each other which is hilarious.
summary: The ability to make people vomit
strengths: You can make people vomit
You can make people sick
weaknesses: You might accidentally step in the vomit

name: Beginner's Luck
description: Have you ever done something really well the first time and somebody says "Oh! It's just beginner's luck"? Well, with this power, it really is. The first time you do anything, you will always surpass expectations and do better than thougth possible.
summary: The ability to succeed at anything the first time you do it
strengths: You will always succeed at something the first time you try it
You could do really amazing/crazy things
Get a boost in skill, and go from there
weaknesses: Only works once on each action
Can still suffer from side-effects, like a gunshot ricocheting

name: Reality Anchoring
description: With this ability one can prevent true reality from being changed within a radius. The radius of this ability is up to two hundred yards. If a time traveler were to go into the past and change the future, meanwhile in the future anything within the radius would not be affected. Keep in mind, one can not undo the changes outside of the radius. This ability is always on.
summary: The ability to prevent reality from being bent or warped within a certain radius.
strengths: Nothing can change within the radius.
Rendering any power that changes reality useless, unless out of the radius.
weaknesses: The changes outside the radius.
One cannot undo changes.

name: 0: Zero Hour
description: One with this ability is very lucky. It allows the user to surpass or extend temporal delays. In other words, the user can cause shorten or lengthen the amount of time before an event takes place, as long as he knows it will happen. This makes waiting in line a breeze, and homework is no longer so much of a hassle.
summary: The ability to surpass or extend temporal delays
strengths: Shorten or lengthen the amount of time it will take until an event happens
Snap your fingers, the teacher suddenly decides homework is due two weeks from the actual due date
Snap fingers/nod/wave/think, and people just start walking out of line at the movie theater
weaknesses: Can't reverse an event once it is happening or has already happened
Can't prolong the event indefinitely (the user must have a time-extension in mind)
The farther ahead in the future an event is, the harder it is to prolong or speed up

name: Superhuman Conversion
description: With this power you are able to convert the current version of any superhero or supervillain to a version that may be more appealing version towards you. This process may only be done one time per superhero or villain.
summary: The ability to convert any current version of a superhero/villan that you have the powers of to a different version
strengths: Change into a more appealing version.
weaknesses: You may only change it once.

name: Children's Game
description: With this ability, you and your opponent will play a children's game. You can change reality to make the game harder. You can also "create" other players. The players will look like your childhood friends and have their personalities. The loser will be in extreme pain and paralyzed, and the winner goes free. The games have no time or player limit. (EX: If playing hide n seek, you can change reality to make it so that players can hide in shadows, can fly, etc).
summary: The ability to change reality according to the rules of a basic game you are playing
strengths: If you're good at the game you are playing, you might win
weaknesses: Chance the opponent will win

name: Countdown Timer
description: This power causes a red numbers to appear on someone's left hand which then starts counting down to zero. Only the victim can see the number and the number can be as large or as small as you choose. Nothing happens at the end of the countdown.
summary: The ability to conjure a countdown that only the victim can see.
strengths: Stress people out by making them think something terrible is going to happen.
Make people question the victim's sanity. Make the victim question their own sanity.
Use it as a warning or to keep time.
weaknesses: It doesn't really do anything.
You can't predict how someone will react to it.
Do it too much and people will stop worrying about it.

name: Oxymoronic Powers
description: A person with this power has the ability to override reality at specific instances allowing them to do the impossible. The user literally has every power that deals with an oxymoron (i.d. contradictions). There is almost no limits to this power except the user's imagination.
summary: The ability to have any power based on an oxymoron
strengths: See the invisible
Do things accidentally----on purpose
Move the immovable
weaknesses: Need to know what oxymoron is relevant for a situation
Sounds awesome but is more useless than it sounds

name: Other Negator
description: This is a useful ability for someone with imagination. You could negate air flow in a room to stop your foe from getting oxygen or negate gravity to float. Your negations may be able to be undone by certain powers and you cant negate magic or superpowers. However, you can negate life or reality.
summary: The ability to negate things other than superpowers or magic.
strengths: Power with very diverse effects
Not too hard to learn
weaknesses: Your negations don't last forever.
Your negations can be overcome by certain powers.

name: Interdimensional Sword Monster
description: This is similar to the arrow, hand, bolt etc. Monsters, except this isn't a ranged attack. When you command it, a special one-handed slightly-curved sword will materialise in your hands. This is the carved claw of a giant interdimensional monster, not like the small, spherical monsters. Anyone or anything you stab will be displaced to the dimension the monster came from, and they will not be harmed in any way. You can also pull them out at any time, with the same rules as the Hand Monster.
summary: The ability to summon a special sword
strengths: Stab anything with the sword,and it will go to another dimension
The victim won't feel a thing (except maybe fear) and you can pull them out at any time.
Nothing like weilding a slightly-curved one-handed sword to make you feel AWESOME!
weaknesses: Not good for killing or hurting.
If you use the sword to slow your fall, the object you stab will disappear.
Make the earth disappear... Not good at all.

name: Grim Reap Yourself
description: Think carefully if you decide to use this power. All future events that need to happen will happen-probable or improbable-to keep you alive until your death day. You can still be imprisoned or banished. This power could get you a life sentence in prison or banished to another universe. You could lose free will with this power if what you love in life contradicted with what would keep you alive. This power will try and take the safest route-instead of defeating Superman you just avoid him.
summary: The ability to choose when you will die.
strengths: Hopefully you'll live to be 90 years old and die in the arms of a playboy playmate.
Your worst enemies-the ones who can disintegrate you-can't. It's improbable.
weaknesses: This power defies reality so foes who defy reality can kill you.
Someone could negate this power and kill you.
This power is meaningless if you couldn't die without it.

name: One Man Band
description: With this power you can mimic the sounds of any musical instrument with only your mouth. Unless you happen to have more than one mouth you can only mimic the sounds of one instrument at a time.
summary: The ability to mimic the sounds of any musical instrument
strengths: You can mimic the sounds of any musical instrument
weaknesses: You can only mimic one instrument at a time

name: Enhancement: Triple
description: This is a support power. This power must be attached to another power at which point it triples the effects. This power is gained by using Enhancement: Double several times at which point it evolves into this power. Because of this anything that goes for Enhancement: Double goes for this power. Can only attach this power to one power at a time.
summary: The ability to triple the effects of a power by attaching this power to it
strengths: Triple the effects. Triple Fireball!!!
Anything that goes for Enhancement: Double goes for this power. May be con for certain parts.
If used enough may quadruple.
weaknesses: Some powers that are useful doubled might be useless tripled.
Useless without another power.
Must have had Enhancement: Double and then used it.

name: Enhancement: Permanence
description: This is a support. It does nothing until attached to another power. When attached, it makes the temporary effects of a power permanent. The permanence lasts until this Enhancement is taken off. This power can only be attached to one power at a time. If this power is stolen, the power it is attached to is permanently enhanced.
summary: The ability to make the temporary effects of a power permanent
strengths: Permanently enhanced strength, speed, dexterity, defense, etc.
Used on defensive powers, this will beat the sniper!!!
weaknesses: Useless without another power.
Do you really want to make self-damaging powers permanent?
Makes bad effects permanent as well as good effects.

name: Error Immunity
description: This ability allows the user can be immune to all the flaws in a false reality.  In a video game , the user would not be frozen the world crashes. In a cartoon, the user will not be harmed by that reality's flaws.
summary: The ability to immune to any or all glitches and errors in a false reality.
strengths: be immune to errors
weaknesses: only works in false realities.

name: Political Plumber
description: Basically, with this ability you can make a complete overhaul of whatever country you happen to be in at the time. It will dismiss/dismantle it's government and replacing it with the perfect system which will eventually lead to the end of all of it's problems, creating the ultimate Utopian society within at least two and a half months.
summary: The ability to fix any government.
strengths: Help corrupt countries
End wars and civil unrest
weaknesses: You'll erase cultures

name: Third Person Perspective
description: This power basically allows the person using it to be able to see themselves in a third person flying camera that can change angles. This also allows you to slow down time to do slow motion moves (because slow-mo makes anything better). You can still control your body and mind completely and can go back to first person if you want to. If the camera hits an obstacle, it will automatically move to the nearest free space.
summary: The ability to see yourself in a flying camera mode
strengths: Seeing yourself do awesome dance moves
Able to check yourself out
weaknesses: Hard to coordinate at first
You also are slowed down by the slow motion
The camera is always fixated on you

name: Alien Summon
description: With this power you can summon aliens from any planet in your universe. You cannot summon aliens from other universes. The aliens are not under your control so try not to summon hostile ones. You can send them back to their home world when you're done with them.
summary: The ability to summon extraterrestrials to your location
strengths: You can summon aliens from any planet in the universe you're in
weaknesses: The aliens are not under your control

name: Doomgiver
description: One of the 12 Swords of Power. This sword's power is one of the most defensive. Doomgiver's main power is that it takes harm directed towards the wielder and reflects it towards whoever caused it, such as making an arrow reverse its course. Doomgiver does not protect against attacks or harm that the wielder deserves. If you attack someone, they can attack you back without the sword's defense. Doomgiver also allows one to view distant locations and people by staring at the blade.
summary: The ability to wield the sword of justice.
strengths: Can't be harmed by random attacks.
Can view distant places.
Super sharp, well balanced blade that is resistant to harm.
weaknesses: Doesn't protect from attacks you have provoked.

name: Paradox Solver
description: When a paradox is about to happen, you are sent to the location(s) and filled in on the situation. Until you solve it, you are given various abilities that can only be used in order to solve the paradox. The abilities are carefully chosen so no new paradox can ever occur by solving the current one. They can be anything, e.g. exploding the area, creating parallel universes where the different outcomes happen, turning the responsible parties into stone, or just talking them out of causing it.
summary: The ability to solve paradoxical situations.
strengths: You could be given huge powers.
The choice of the outcome is generally yours.
You don't have to be impartial, so you can tip the balance in favor of one party.
weaknesses: You're going to be very busy solving the paradoxes.
You could die or even destroy the world in the process of trying to solve a paradox.
The abilities you're given can only be used to solve the paradox.

name: Orbit
description: The three can be used for concussive attacks, and can also take on the powers of other things known for orbiting, such as planets and electrons. They can light up and create other kinds of energy, a nod to electrons. They can become like celestial bodies, such as comets and maybe even black holes with practice.
summary: The ability to have three particles orbit you at all times.
strengths: They almost have a mind of their own, and can retaliate to attacks you aren't paying attention to.
A force field of sorts.
weaknesses: They never go away. They may leave orbit and fly a limited distance, but they always come back.
They almost have a mind of their own. This could be bad for people around you.

name: T&S Disembodiment
description: If you really want to reach out and touch someone, then you would instantly open gateways in space through which you can project your own body, allowing you to teleport parts of yourself to other locations.
summary: The ability to project parts of your body through time and space.
strengths: You can use it to annoy your opponent.
weaknesses: If you die, your limbs will get lost forever, drifting between dimensions.

name: Least Desired Powers Mimicry
description: A person with this power can access any of the least desired 100 powers in the superpowerlist and can choose which ability to activate at any time. Think that this power is useless? Guess again. The user also has the ability to use any of the powers in conjunction with each other making it possible to have deadly combinations you might not even imagine.
summary: The ability to access any of the 100 least desired powers on the Superpowerlist
strengths: Can decide when to use each power---it's not always active
Can find out combinations that make these oh-so-useless powers deadly
Can access more than one power at a time
weaknesses: The list always changes so you need to keep track of what powers you have

name: Rapid Prototyping
description: After creating the initial design of an object, the next stage is often to prototype it. With this power you can quickly and skillfully mock-up a working prototype out of anything you have at hand. The finished creation will by definition be unfinished; like beta software it will need to be refined. Added to this, some designs are beyond the scope of reality: you couldn't create an LHC prototype out of cardboard and scissors. As a design aid or quick solution, though, this power is very useful.
summary: The ability to quickly mock-up a working prototype of a design out of materials you have at hand.
strengths: Be able to quickly and skillfully create prototypes for a whole range of products.
Ingenuity and modelling/design skills are included within this power.
It will be far quicker to get a design from paper to finished product.
weaknesses: The prototypes will likely be a bit temperamental/rough-and-ready.
This power is somewhat limited by feasability or access to tools/materials.

name: The Twilight Zone
description: The twilight zone is an alternate dimension. It is more widely known as the Bermuda Triangle or the Devil's Triangle. Having this power gives access to manipulation of that dimension, spectral fire, magnetism, time warps, spectral flares, UFO-like transport constructs. If the user does not have a strong will or control of the power, they might be dragged into it.
summary: The ability to gain access and control the twilight zone
strengths: You can use time warps to capture people
It can be used to recover the missing ships, planes and people that have gone missing
The wielder can reveal the true mysteries of the Bermuda Triangle
weaknesses: If your will is not strong enough, the twilight zone may destroy you
The twilight zone is a very unknown topic, so there is not a lot of knowledge about it
It is a very dangerous power

name: Evil Eyes
description: This is Where you literally have evil eyes. This Power is most kept dormant, due to the fact that when they are active, any and every person you look in the eyes will run away in fear. This is activated and deactivated every time you close your eyes for exactly 3 seconds, so you don't have to worry about waking up with your evil eyes.
summary: The ability to have the evil eyes.
strengths: You can make your enemies run away in fear, no matter how strong or brave.
It puts no strain on your eyes, so you can use it forever.
weaknesses: It doesn't work on animals, so you are vulnerable to tigers and other dangerous animals.
If someone isn't looking you in the eyes, you are still vulnerable.

name: Q Power
description: Q is a fictional character from Star Trek, he is omnipotent, and all powerful. It is the Q's duty, to keep balance and order in the cosmos. Any misuse of your power and the Q continuum will judge you, to see whether you should remain Q or be a disgusting human.
summary: The ability to have the power of the Q, from Star Trek.
strengths: Have all power and immortality.
Be sworn enemies with patrick stewart.
weaknesses: Misuse of power can result in loss of power.
Must maintain order and balance in the universe, being a Q.

name: Create Cosmic Perfection
description: You can focus on a area and join together anything in that area that was unified before the Big Bang happened. Matter, energy and gravity rejoin and collapse as time reverses billions of years in one second. Everything in the area shrinks smaller than a atom. The universe around this area will rush in to fill in the lost imperfection. Restored perfection won't become another Big Bang.
summary: The ability to restore the perfection that existed before the Big Bang
strengths: Your technically not destroying anything. Your making how it used to be. :)
Works on anything that came into existence after the Big Bang.
weaknesses: People might see this power as destructive.
You can't use it near or in certain locations. Banks,The White House,Hospitals,Schools,etc.

name: Power Sacrifice
description: This power is a power blocking power, but it has three differences to normal powers. The first is you must possess that power to block it. The second is that no power can resist it's effects. The third is that you can block as many people as you like. To block a power, you use it on the user and as long as you do not use or lose your copy, their power is blocked. Your sacrificed passive powers turn off until activated willingly. You must be close by to start negating.
summary: The ability to block an opponent's power you possess.
strengths: No power can resist -not even Power Safety, Power Hold and Power Counter.
Block as many people as you like, from any distance, for any amount of time.
Powers like Friendly Power Gifting can still work with the lost power.
weaknesses: If you die, use or lose your version, your victims get their powers back.
Trying to block this power -you won't be able to block any more.
You have to have their power to block it.

name: Reincarnation 6: Legacy
description: In life, you infect others with a touch-based virus which allows infected couple to bring you back as their child. You retain your old memories while your old powers return upon reaching puberty. Each time you return, you get one new, random power related to your last death. You possess it even in childhood. The couple are both rendered fertile, which remains in effect after you are born and extends to their extended family for your gestation.
summary: The ability to reincarnate through your legacy and a special virus.
strengths: If you leave a great legacy, you would be very hard to kill.
Get multiple powers through multiple incarnations.
The family will treat you well.
weaknesses: Takes a few years to return to power.
The family will have high expectations of you.
Requires people to know your legacy, even if it is fake.

name: Sixgun Shooter
description: If you have a ranged power that takes a instant to use and has a target it can affect then with this power you can use that power six time in a single instant. Any target or targets must be within 100 feet of you. This isn't temporal power or time dilation power. Those powers would make this power better if you had them. You could hit a single target six times or target 6 targets in a single moment. Foes with temporal powers could render this power useless
summary: The ability to use a power six times in a instant.
strengths: Target six foes or hit just one foe six times in a instant.
This power is enhanced with temporal or time dilation powers.
weaknesses: If you don't have time powers and your foe does.
Only works with ranged powers.

name: Butterfly Effect
description: With this power you can go back in time indefinitly but only if you change past events so much so that it creates alternate realities and maybe a paradox. However, you can only change other people's lives and only for the worst. You are not effected. The more people's lives you mess up, the more powerful you become. You can choose not to use this power, however.
summary: The ability to travel back in time and cause havoc, chaos and destruction
strengths: Great offensive power
If you hate someone, you can mess up their life
You are not effected
weaknesses: Might become evil
You can only do bad things
The temptation to do bad might corrupt you

name: Four Riders: 1 War
description: You have the power of war. Which means you ride a red horse and cause everyone you ride by to be so full of hatred and indignity that they instantly try to start a war. You also wear full battle armer and carry a huge sword.
summary: The ability to have the powers of the first rider of the apocolypse
strengths: You are extremely powerful and one if the bad guys
You have an awesome out fit.
You ride a bright red warhorse
weaknesses: You are extremely powerful and one of the bad guys
You help bring on the apocolypse
You can only create war. Not peace

name: Myth Power: Course Of Chronoi 1
description: The Chronoi (Khronoi, Times), in Greek myth, were the gods of past, present and future. As such, channeling Parochemenos (Parokhemenos- Past), one can psychically perceive the passage of time, at will. In addition, one can withstand temporal effects. Furthermore, one can psychically receive insights from the past, at will. One can also psychically become imperceptible (except to those who can sense the past), at will. One can also psychically launch subjects into the past, by touch, at will.
summary: The ability to channel the Chronoi and their command over the essence of past, present and future
strengths: Psychically perceive the passage of time, at will; withstand temporal effects
Psychically perceive the past (and become imperceptible, except in past-tense) at will
Psychically project subjects into the past, by touch, at will
weaknesses: Postcognitive Imperceptibility is useless against those who can perceive the past (NCN)
Cannot psychically time-travel to the past, until developed (NCN)
Cannot psychically summon a past version of oneself to the present, until developed (NCN)

name: Temporal Duplication
description: This ability allows you to summon yourself from the past 30 mins. to the present without causing any paradox. This past version of you will automatically be psychicly intuned with you in the present. Meaning the will know all the info you know now. Also if your past version dies, they will have already summoned you/themself from 30 mins ago 100% healthy so the present you won't disappear. You can't have more than you & your past self can be present. No future you for the futures always changes.
summary: The ability to summon your past self from 30 mins. ago
strengths: Have the past you from 30 mins come to the present paradox free
Past slef will be intuned with you
If past you dies, another one from 30 mins ago will appear
weaknesses: Can only have one past version of yourself present at a time
Can't summon future version of yourself for future is always in flux

name: The Infinite Dollhouses Prison
description: A study of the power infinitely regressed led to this power. It creates a universe that is a house missing one wall with a dollhouse in it that is the house with the dollhouse in it. The house the victim finds himself in is a dollhouse in a house ad infinitum in either direction. A victim will always have food and water. There is just enough light. The victim won't suffocate despite an infinite of them existing. This power can only be used once a day due to stresses on reality and yourself.
summary: The ability to trap forever someone in an infinite series of dollhouses.
strengths: Eternal imprisonment is always good.
weaknesses: Only once a day.
Dimensional travelers or those who resist reality changes.
You can't be there to hear the infinite scream of your infinite victim.

name: Trip Wire
description: With this ability, you can trip anyone at any time. Someone walking just a little TOO gracefully? Is there a arrogant bastard at the party that just needs to go down? What about that cop that just pulled you over? Trip them all, with or without them knowing it was you. Just think about it, and you can make it happen.
summary: The ability to trip anyone you want just by thinking about it.
strengths: People watching
Tripping someone you really don't like
Getting pulled over and asking the cop to demonstrate the sobriety test for you
weaknesses: Tripping tight rope performers

name: Infinitely Regressed
description: You have the ability to do the most difficult reality manipulation possible. You can temporarily trap someone in an infinite regression universe. You put the person in a white room holding a white box. Your victim opens the box. Inside is a tiny version of themself looking inside an open white box-it's the room they are standing in. If they shake the box they are holding, their room will move the same way.  The 'white box' universe can be escaped with reality altering or dimension travel powers.
summary: The ability to temporarily trap someone in an infinite regression.
strengths: Imagine if your victim turns the box upside down.
Your power will freak out enemies.
weaknesses: You break laws of the universe-you don't know what could happen when using your power.
Reality changers or universe jumpers.
It's only temporary. Just enough time to get out of sight of any pursuers.

name: Appraiser
description: The user is able to appraise the worth of an object or the power and abilities of a person just by looking at the person. The user of this power can only appraise one person or item at a time, How accurate the appraisal is dependent on the user's mastery of his or her control of this power.
summary: The ability to appraise the worth of an object or the power and abilities of a person by just looking at them
strengths: Can appraise a worth of an object
Good to determine alien objects
Good at finding new recruits to join their team
weaknesses: Has no combat power what so ever
Appraisal might be off the mark if the user's control of this power is low

name: Musical Leech
description: Ever wanted to sing/play a musical composition, but either didn't have the time or just plain sucked at it? This power allows you to absorb the musical talent of those around you through physical contact. The longer you remain in contact, the more talent you absorb.
summary: The ability to steal musical talent from people through physical contact
strengths: Learn how to play instruments/sing quick
People you touch lose their musical talent (embarrass enemies)
Sometimes, retain musical talent permanently
weaknesses: You only gain knowledge on how to play instruments that the people you touch know how to play
People you touch lose their musical talent (angry, tone-deaf people)
Sometimes, musical talent is retained only temporarily

name: Paradox Bestowal
description: This power makes it so that you can bestow a paradox upon someone. With just the flick of your finger, you can bestow an unsolvable paradox that tears through the fabric of space-time so your opponent will be shoved into a state of nonexistence. When in this state, they will still be alive, but the universe will not remember them, and they will not be able to communicate with anything or anyone in any way. Unfortunately, this power is irreversible and cannot be undone.
summary: The ability to bestow an unsolvable paradox onto someone.
strengths: Bestow a paradox upon your enemy.
The enemy will be shoved into a state of nonexistence.
weaknesses: This power is irreversible.
The paradox may destroy the planet...... Just kidding.

name: Enhancement: Mending
description: This is a support. It does nothing until attached to another power. When attached, it causes the power to repair objects and buildings when used. This power can only be attached to one power at a time. If this power is stolen, the power it is attached to is permanently enhanced.
summary: The ability to make a power repair damaged objects when used
strengths: Repair your fortifications with Omni-Directional Blast.
Used in combination with either Enhancement: Healing and people will love you.
weaknesses: Useless without another power.

name: Waifu Control
description: Some people become obsessed with fictional worlds, or even fall in love with fictional characters. You can control that. You can make someone fall in/out of love with a character, change their soulmate to a character, make them desire a fictional world more than the real one (or solve that problem). You can even make characters and worlds respond in kind, 'desiring' a person, though you have less control. At maximum level, you can bridge between fiction and reality, if it's in the name of love.
summary: The ability to control and manipulate love (romantic and platonic) for fictional people/places
strengths: Make people fall in/out of love, make them content (even if the object of their love isn't real)
Play matchmaker: find out who loves/would love who, or MAKE them fall in love
Can eventually travel to and from fictional worlds, and force people and characters through
weaknesses: Best with anime/anime-style, mid with other drawn/animation, worst with writing, and no live-action.
Bridging the gap is only at a really high level, and (NCN) can ONLY be done in the name of love.
Power may be sentient, and might try to play matchmaker with YOU.

name: The Whisperer
description: This power allows you to send your whispers to any location that you can think of. If you begin to speak louder than a whisper while using this power, this power will automatically reduce the loudness of your words. The resulting words are ten to twenty decibels. You can whisper to multiple locations at the same time.
summary: The ability to whisper at things from long distances.
strengths: Can talk to people far away.
Can pretend to be someone's conscience.
Or pretend to be a ghost.
weaknesses: If the target is at a loud location, the whisper might not be heard.
Only works one way, you can't hear them talk back.
Only sends your voice, no other sounds.

name: Reality Poisoning
description: This ability allows the user to create an energy that poisons reality. What do I mean by this? This energy cause everything within the reality it is in to become ill. Everything be in a dull single color, matter and energy become inert,and living creature will suffer energy loss. If kept up for a long period of time, the poisoning will be permanent, and reality will slowly die. The user can concentrate it to certain area.
summary: The ability to create and manipulate an energy that literally poisons reality.
strengths: Weaken enemies
Take advantage of the disarray.
weaknesses: Poisoning will be permanent, if used to long.
The user will also be affected if he spends in it to long.
Continual use will will also be deadly to user.

name: Atheism Powered Abilities
description: This ability is very contradicting. On the one hand, you gain godlike powers through everyone who either questions their beliefs or those who don't believe in God at all. And on the other hand, you lose your god powers once people start believing in the higher-ups again. So to become even more powerful, you would need as many nonbelievers as you can.
summary: The ability to become god-like through nonbelievers
strengths: Through every 1000 nonbelievers, your already existing powers are 1.5 times more powerful
Being like a god would be awesome
With enough faithless, you can do anything you want
weaknesses: Your very presence would make atheists believers again
Born again Christians
Would have to hide that you are a god from everyone.

name: Enhancement: Uncontrollable
description: This is a support. It does nothing until attached to another power. When attached, it makes the power uncontrollable but the user of the power is immune to the power. This power can only be attached to one power at a time. If this power is stolen, it permanently enhances the power it is attached to.
summary: The ability to make a power uncontrollable but the user is immune to the power
strengths: You're immune but your enemies aren't.
weaknesses: Useless without another power.
Getting this power stolen might not be a good thing to do.

name: Objection!
description: You can object to anything you want at any time. Things that bother you, tick you off, make you sad, anything at all. But if you do, you won't be able to bring back the thing or person you objected to. So watch what you object to.
summary: The ability to object to anything that annoys you.
strengths: You can object to anything you don't want to listen to.
If there is anything you don't like, you can object to it.
You can get rid of anything you want to.
weaknesses: Certain things shouldn't be objected to.
Once you object you can't go back.
If you don't think about what you object, you may object the wrong thing so think before you object.

name: Medusa Glare
description: Like the Greek mythical monster Medusa, you will be able to look at someone in the eyes & make them paralyze for a day. It only works if its eye to eye contact though.
summary: The ability to look at someone in the eye & paralyze them
strengths: Paralyze people
weaknesses: Only last for a day
Have to make eye contact

name: Star Arranger
description: With this power you can arrange the stars into whatever shapes or patterns you want. You can write people's names in the stars, write messages, or make funny shapes in the stars. This is also a good way to distract your enemy while fighting at night.
summary: The ability to arrange the stars in certain patterns
strengths: You can arrange the stars into any patterns you want
You can distract your enemies in fights
weaknesses: If it's a cloudy night this power is useless

name: Effect Latency
description: With this power, you can add a delay to a superpower. So, it will take a moment to take effect after it has been activated. In the case of a power that is already in use or always active, variations that may occur during its usage will be delayed. It will even take some time to deactivate if its user wants to switch it off. If the power already has a delay, you can add more time to it, but you can't shorten it. You can assign a different time lag to different superpowers.
summary: The ability to add a delay to a superpower so it takes time to take effect.
strengths: You can affect anyone's abilities, even yours.
Delay a lethal superpower's activation so you can escape!
It's really annoying and frustrating when there's a lag all of a sudden.
weaknesses: The delays are maintained even when you're not around, but at the cost of YOUR energy.
The longer the delay, the more energy it will suck from you to maintain itself.
Can delay the negation of a power, but only if this power's effect is not negated in the process.

name: Selective Unfreezing
description: This power is completley useless if time isn't frozen. If somebody (you or another person) froze time, you would be unharmed and you could also make certain things work, like a car.
summary: The ability to selectivley unfeeze things when time is frozen
strengths: Use items that couldn't function otherwise while frozen.
If you get this you will probably be able to freeze and unfreeze time by yourself.
Use this again if someone freezes your targeted item.
weaknesses: Things can be re-frozen
Useless if time is not frozen
You might wanna be able to freeze time yourself

name: Last Man Alive
description: You can freely enter or exit a parallel dimension where you are the only person(s) on the planet. Anything you do in this other dimension has no effect on the real world. You can bring things to and from this dimension, including bringing people into the dimension. People automatically return if you exit the dimension or die inside it. Wild animals still exist, but pets and anything sentient will not exist in the dimension. You will come back to the original world in the nearest safe spot.
summary: The ability to temporarily become the last person/people on the planet.
strengths: Alone in time.
Can explore areas you could not before.
Can bring things back from the dimension.
weaknesses: Cars, planes, nuclear reactors, etc. will end up crashing without people.
Wild animals may attack.
Cannot trap people inside the dimension

name: Spam Frame
description: This ability allows you to have anything repeat itself for as much time as you want. The time that is surrounding anything you touch including you is being continuously copied until you cancel it. Since time is still passing outside you own touch your actions will still add up.
summary: The ability to repeat any action continuously through continous recycling of time frames
strengths: Never run out of bullets, you can keep shooting as long as you are doing the same thing
Can have near infinite wealth or food. Eating 1 grain of rice repeatedly or continuous money deposit
weaknesses: You can only repeat 1 specific action
Others can change their actions but you cannot until you stop

name: Space Suit
description: The user can create and control a space suit that could be of various designs as long as it matches real world designs of space suits. The wearer of the space suit has access to outer space related powers. The wearer can survive in space indefinitely and can create mini planets, black holes, stars, meteors, and other objects found in outer space. The wearer can also control how gravity affects himself such as the strength and direction of the gravity on himself. Can be remade if original is lost
summary: The ability to create a space suit that gives the wearer space related powers.
strengths: Have personal space suit that lets you survive in space.
Can create mini versions of objects existing in outer space.
Wearer can control his personal gravity, controlling strenght and direction of gravity on himself.
weaknesses: Have to be wearing the space suit.
If the suit is destroyed or lost then you lose access to the powers.
The objects created will be about the size of a human.

name: Induced Temporal Pull
description: First, you can perceive the "chronon" particles that people and objects pile up in them during time travels. Second, you can "read" them to know when they come from or from which timeline they originate. Third, you can create a time pull, causing the particles and their host to be attracted to their origin, so, eventually, they will be tossed into their correct time. However, if they somehow manage to resist, their period or timeline will be pulled toward the current one, merging with it.
summary: The ability to perceive things that are not from this time and cause them to be pulled toward the time they left.
strengths: Send time travellers back to when they come from.
Restore the timeline by sending misplaced objects and people to their correct time.
weaknesses: It probably won't prevent the time travellers from coming back.
If they have the power to resist the time pull, their time will come to them. Very dangerous.

name: Quiescence
description: The user of this ability has a valuable power at his disposal. This ability allows the user to literally phase outside of the realms of time. During this time, the user doesn't have to eat, breathe or sleep, and he is incapable of physical contact with the physical world; he also becomes intangible. However, until the danger passes, the user is also rendered immobile.
summary: The ability to internally produce a temporal silence and stillness
strengths: Cannot be touched by anything that is bound to the realms of space-time
Don't need to eat, sleep or breathe, and doesn't age (state of "temporal dormancy")
Total quiet for assistance in contemplation (remain aware of environment)
weaknesses: Cannot move (stuck in whatever pose you take before ability activates)
Can still be touched by time-defiers, chronokinetics, and "nonexistents"
The user can use this ability at will, but it is SUBCONSCIOUSLY activated upon sensing danger

name: Nightmare Fuel
description: This ability allows the user to, in essence, place a mine in a person that will bring their nightmare to life the next time they have one. Individuals observing the subject with spy based powers are also affected.
summary: The ability to bring people's nightmares into reality
strengths: No contact necessary.
Can be used through spy based powers.
Lucid dreamers with this power can create their own monsters consciously.
weaknesses: Only works once before having to be reapplied.
The user ALWAYS has the "mine" in them.
You have to wait and hope the afflicted has a nightmare.

name: Zonk Out
description: With this ability, you can control the quality and the amount of time you sleep. You control the sleep stages. Sleep as much as you want. Induce your own sleepiness. You can't induce lack of sleep or a poor sleep quality with this power.
summary: The ability to sleep as much and as well as you want.
strengths: Sleep as much and as well as you want.
Get well rested.
Induce your own sleepiness.
weaknesses: Sleeping more and/or better than usual. Get yelled at for sleeping a lot!
The more well rested you are, the more energy you have while awake.
Get too well rested, and you'll stay awake for 24+ hours with strong clean energy if power is off.

name: Fate Switch
description: A person with this power has the ability to switch fates with someone else. For example if they are destined to die at a young age they can switch this fate to someone else. If your defeat is certain then you can switch this with someone else, then reality will warp to give you the advantage. Everytime you switch fate, the results of your last fate switch will start to crumble. If you made an empire then switched fates with a peasant your empire will start to crumble.
summary: The ability to switch fates with someone else
strengths: Switch your death with someone else
If you're erased from existence then you can still switch with someone in existence before erasure
Can switch with an immortal to "defeat" the immortal
weaknesses: If someone you switch with has a worser fate than you
You can still die of old age since that is a universal fate

name: Enhancement: Counter Attack
description: This is a support. It does nothing until attached to another power. When attached, it makes the power automatically counter an attack to you when you're attacked. This power cannot be attached to overly powerful powers such as Power of Imagination, Self-Existence Manipulation (don't know what it would do for one thing), unavoidable attacks, etc. This power can only be attached to one power at a time. If this power is stolen, the power it is attached to is permanently enhanced.
summary: The ability to make a power automatically counter-attack when the holder is attacked
strengths: Putting this on a negation power might be a little overkill on superhumans.
Great for a surprise attack when enemies think you're guard is down.
Don't have to worry about countering anymore because any attack is automatically countered.
weaknesses: Useless without another power.
The attack on you might be a joke set up by friends.
Can only have one of this power at a time.

name: The Power Of Pow!
description: A kind of reality control. As long as you actually pull your punch some and just say POW! You will knock out an opponent regardless of what powers he or she possesses. Your opponent will stay unconscious long enough to be taken away by authorities if you the good guy or if your the bad guy you have enough time to put him or her in a fiendish death trap.
summary: The ability to pull a punch and knock out anyone just by saying POW!
strengths: Ignore invulnerability of any foe.
Knock unconscious that big green guy who always smashing things. You know who I mean.
Your likely very sneaky. See below.
weaknesses: You probably don't go to a gym. Your a weakling.
Any way a opponent could shut your mouth or keep you quiet. Sound control is good.

name: Substance: Chemical Creator
description: With this power, you can create new chemicals. They can be atoms or mixtures, really any type of substance. It just needs to be totally unknown until you bring it to existence. You can also choose what traits or special abilities it might have. It might be a new element that's nigh indestructable or super malleable. It could be a compound that exerts antigravity, or warps time and space. It could be superconductive material, whatever, it just needs to be unknown and you can bring it to life!
summary: The ability to create molecules, chemical elements etc that the universe has never seen
strengths: Combine any number of protons, neutrons and electrons to make a totally new element or compound.
You decide was properties or traits it can have, like one that is, for example, alive! ALIVE! HAHAHA
You can use the -ium, -ite, -ate etc suffixes all day.
weaknesses: Once you have made it, this power will never allow you to make it again, as it is not new.
Without a power to control already known elements, this power could be rendered useless.
In order to name the elements, you might need to learn Latin

name: Room To Tardis
description: To go somewhere specific, you need to sit and concentrate for a minute first, but if you need to escape, you can hop randomly (then when you're safe, sit down and concentrate).
