There are also several ways for the room to manifest: as the door just standing there, any structure that would make sense being there (like a phone booth), or by integrating itself into a building. Internet, phone, etc. Can communicate both with the origin and the new area. Only works with actual, indoors rooms.
summary: The ability to transform a room into a time, space, and dimension vehicle
strengths: Any room is your private TARDIS, with parallel universe and alternate timeline capabilities.
Go to non-existence for a time-stopped fortress. The outside is nearly impenetrable anyway.
By designating an object as a control panel, you can make this permanent and other people can use it
weaknesses: When moving through space, it doesn't actually move, just appears (maybe a pro).
While you can set passwords if you turn it into a permanent machine, it can still be stolen.
Have to be indoors. Bad things can hitch rides. Slight chance of getting lost.

name: Pen Creation
description: This power grants you the ability to create pens whenever you want. With this power, you can create pens at any time like when you are in need of a pen to write a paper just think of it and boom! It is there.
summary: The ability to create pens whenever you want to.
strengths: You never have to worry about not having a pen again.
You will never run out of pens.
You can easily create a weapon out of nowhere if you get in a fight.
weaknesses: When, your pen runs out of ink you will have a useless pen.
You could eventually fill the world with useless pens.
People could think you're a witch and burn you to the stake.

name: Viral Telekinesis Regular
description: This power allows you to create a supernatural virus that infects people to create "bases". You can draw power from these bases to use telekinesis(the power depending on the base size). Eventually the virus will die out and set the size for a base. When people in a base die your power wanes and only one virus can infect a person at a time. However you can create multiple bases and cast out several viruses at once but you are only capable of drawing power from ONE base at a time.
summary: The ability to create supernatural viruses that give you an infected populace to draw telekinesis from.
strengths: Several bases can be created at once.
If you have a large base, you have extremely powerful telekinesis.
You can switch which base you channel from rapidly.
weaknesses: You have no way to determine the lifespan of the viruses.
You can only channel less power from a base that has had many people die.
It can be hard to build up a large base.

name: Standing Ovation
description: Know what one of the all time fears is in America, even worse than death itself? Public speaking! With this ability, you'll never stutter and stumble over your words again. Never again will you feel the nervousness that comes from standing in front of a group of people and speaking. It'll be smooth music to their ears. Perfect placement of humor while always getting the message across. Even if you're completely BS'ing, your speech will be spectacular. So bring on those damn oral presentations!
summary: The ability to be phenomenal at public speaking 100% of the time.
strengths: Deliver amazing speeches with 100% confidence
Woo the ladies in the audience with your eloquence
No accidental sharting due to nervousness
weaknesses: Your fear has been conquered for you, which may not be as rewarding
After you've woo'ed the ladies with your speaking, you're on your own buddy ;)

name: Space Vehicles V2
description: With this power you can summon any kind of space vehicle. You can summon rocket ships, satellites, lunar rovers, space pods, UFOs etc. You also know how to operate any vehicle that you summon. When you're done you can unsummon the vehicle.
summary: The ability to summon any type of space vehicle
strengths: You can summon any kind of space vehicle
You know how to operate the vehicle
You can unsummon them when you're done
weaknesses: Just because you know how to operate a space vehicle doesn't mean you're ready to go into space

name: 3rd Time's The Charm
description: You will literally win at anything you do the third time you do it, unless there is more of a prize than just making you feel good about winning.
summary: The ability to win at anything that doesn't have any prize except making one feel better
strengths: You always win the third time you do something!
weaknesses: You had to fail the first two times.
Doesn't guarantee future wins.

name: The Centipede's Dilemma
description: Ask an opponent to tell you how a power they have works. If they try and fail, they power is gone. This power always works on other powers that control or manipulate complex things like matter, time, space, life, energy, etc. It won't work on something simple like super strength. How it works on anything in between depends on the IQ of your foe and the complexity of the power you want to negate. If your foe can or can't explain their power, your power will never work on them again either way.
summary: The ability to permanently negate an opponent's power if they can't explain it to you.
strengths: Can the Hulk explain why he can't be hurt?
"I can..." isn't an answer to how you control time and space.
weaknesses: Geniuses.
You only get one shot with this power.
The simplest powers can often be the best ones-you can't negate those powers.

name: Gamerverse: Reality Glitch
description: With this power, you perceive the laws of nature as merely sophisticated programming for the universe. With this power, you can create glitches in the fabric of reality. When activating this power, you can voluntarily dump excess 'coding' into any physical space you can see immediately. It will form a random law for that place that might shove you forward or back, teleport you, increase impetus, move people, etc. But it is random, so they may actually hinder you. The possibilities are limitless!
summary: The ability to create and utilise glitches in reality
strengths: Create a glitch in a part of reality that you can see.
Only YOU can be affected by these glitches.
Glitches stay in that part of space for only a couple of hours.
weaknesses: Can only create a glitch in the part of reality that you can actually see with your eyes.
Glitches are random, so they might hinder your efforts.
Glitches might also be completely useless at that current time.

name: Universal Reset
description: With this power, one can reset the universe with all events still occurring in the same way. The only changes are to reality itself; certain people are no longer required to maintain reality, while people who imbued the entire universe with their consciousness are now once again vulnerable to destruction and everybody is capable of nonexistence.
summary: The ability to reset the universe to a near-perfect replica of its current state.
strengths: Repair damage to reality.
Neutralize certain individuals without danger.
Reality is not damaged in the process.
weaknesses: Certain powers such as Reality Anchoring interfere with the normal action of this power.
Only works in your current universe.
Does not protect against anything such as destruction of reality.

name: Looks To Kill
description: If you stare at someone for longer than 5 seconds they will drop dead, peacefully.
summary: The ability to look at someone and kill them
strengths: If you hate someone, it's easy to eliminate them
People will never be mean to you.
You can kill ANYTHING!
weaknesses: You can't have staring comps
People will only like you so you won't kill them
You can't stare at someone you like.

name: Cartoon Power: Mario
description: With this power, you have the amount of lives Mario generally starts off with: five. Meaning that when you die, you instantly come back to life right where you died.
summary: The ability to have five lives
strengths: You have five lives
weaknesses: If you get shot by a criminal and you come back to life where you died you will just get shot again

name: Planar Compaction
description: Also called Plane Merging, this ability grants the user the power to compact the planes of reality together. When any action is performed in a compacted area it affects ALL of the compacted planes. Beings that are in a compacted area also appear on all merged planes so extraplanar entities can come through. In addition due to the different nature of the planes when they merge reality can warp randomly. If uncontrolled, the users very presence will create areas of merged planes.
summary: The ability to compact several planes of reality onto each other.
strengths: Catch enemies on a different plane.
There is a possibility to cause extra planar entities to come to a different plane.
Cause the different planes to warp the reality of one another.
weaknesses: Reality warps are random and uncontrollable.
There is no telling what kind of extra planar entity will come through if ANY.
If someone is just plain in another dimension.

name: Xianyang Theory
description: With this power you can know where any of your enemies are at all times. All you have to is say their name out loud and instantly you will know where they are. This power works for anybody you don't like anybody you've ever fought against or anybody who is competing against you.
summary: The ability to know where your enemies are at all times
strengths: You can know where any of your enemies are at all times
weaknesses: You have to speak their name out loud for it to work

name: Blast From The Past
description: With this ability, you can relive 20 minutes from your past once each day. You can't change the future with this ability--you can only experience 20 minutes of something you did. Whatever changes you make during your trip back will not become a reality after the 20 minutes is over.
summary: The ability to relive 20 minutes of your past once each day.
strengths: Experience something really enjoyable over and over.
Find out the truth about something that once happened.
You can do whatever you want for 20 minutes; they will be reverted after that!
weaknesses: Don't use this to relive the worst 20 minutes of your life, unless you're masochistic.
You can't change the past with this power alone.
You can't travel to the future.

name: Artifact: Tengu No Kakuremino
description: When you say "Adeat", a cloak appears. This cloak allows you (and others) to travel to a different plane of reality. In this plane, is a house complete with a kitchen.
summary: The ability to summon a cloak that can let you travel to a different dimension.
strengths: Has camouflage so enemies don't notice it.
More than one person can enter.
You control who gets in and out.
weaknesses: No combat purposes.

name: Life Force Sacrifice
description: With this power you are able to amplify your powers, but in order for them to experience greater power some of your life-force must be sacrificed, power is measured in 6 months (1/2 years), so this amount of time is subtracted from years to live.
summary: The ability to donate some of your life force in order to amplify powers and talents.
strengths: Powers are greatly amplified.
weaknesses: If Immortal, you can not use this (No con negation)
You will die sooner.

name: A Swarm Of You
description: You start as a swarm of ant-sized versions of yourself. With time and practice you can become a swarm of femto-sized versions of yourself. Femto-sized versions of yourself are small enough to affect matter and energy processes on a sub-atomic level. This power doesn't give you a hive mind. Losing one part of your swarm reverts you to normal form.
summary: The ability to become a swarm of tiny or smaller versions of yourself.
strengths: Affect matter or energy processes on a sub-atomic level(with time and practice).
At a small enough your swarm-self will be unaffected by some attacks.
weaknesses: You're not a hive mind. You have to coordinate all yourselves somehow.
Lose one part of your swarm and revert to normal.

name: Murderous Advice
description: With this power you can give advice that, while seemingly benign or good at that moment, will put that person on a path to unavoidable death. The true ramifications of your advice might not be readily apparent after you give it, and you may have to advise a person many times to guide them toward their own demise, but they will assuredly die if they keep listening to you.
summary: The ability to give advice that, while seemingly good at the time, will subtly lead that person to their death.
strengths: The advise is always seems good in the context of the persons present situation.
Their chances of survivle will drop stedily to 0% if they keep following your advice.
There is basically no way to trace the victim's death back to you.
weaknesses: While good in context, the victim does not have to follow your advice.
The chances that you will be able to kill someone with just one piece of advice are slim.
Killing someone like this could take a fairly long time.

name: Chronological Event Reversal
description: With this power, a specific event occurs twice; once normally, and again only in reverse order. If this power were to be used on a bottle that had fallen off a building and shattered, the bottle would immediately reassemble itself and fly back to the ledge. This is not time reversal; time only goes in the one direction. However, this power makes a selected local event happen once naturally, and again as its reversed form, all during the natural passage of time.
summary: The ability to cause events to reverse themselves during the normal passage of time
strengths: Reverse death, injury, accidents, fix things, reverse aging, etc.
Time flows normally; only, the affected event occurs twice.
No restrictions placed on object/event type.
weaknesses: People could be made younger than they should be (think new-born baby or younger).
Unless you have experience with this power you SHOULD NOT use it on yourself.

name: X Zone
description: This ability to open a one-way portal into an empty dimension, which even someone with this power cannot escape. This dimension is a completely empty void.  No time, no space. The only thing your enemies can do in here is go insane. They are trapped in here for all eternity.
summary: The ability to banish your enemies into an empty dimension for eternity.
strengths: Banish your enemies here for all eternity.
weaknesses: If you somehow get trapped in the X-Zone, there is no escape.
Can not undo the x-zone.

name: Gaze Aversion
description: Good for the person who doesn't like to draw attention, but at the same time not so good. This power will instantly face anyone nearby away from you so you can make a getaway. The effect is very disorienting, and anyone moving will continue in the same direction, adding to the confusion. Still, this ability can sometimes hurt more than help. If someone knows your power, then using it will make it even easier to find you.
summary: The ability to make all people in an area face away from you
strengths: Quick Getaway
Lots of confusion
weaknesses: May give away your position
Not many uses

name: Sun Phoenix Cannon
description: Summon a gold cannon with wings on top (makes it look abit like a crossbow) on your right arm. While can be fired at any time, it is best to do so when the sun is present, because it greatly increases the effectiveness. Aside from the normal beam from the front end of the cannon, by placing your palm on top of it and calling out "scatter" muntiple secctions of the cannon's plating slide back and it fires multiple smaller lazers that home in on the enemy and attack from all sides.
summary: The ability to use the solar cannon.
strengths: Great power when fired during the day.
Even more effective against anything darkness aligned (eg. Vampires, demons)
weaknesses: Less power without the sun.
Rather big; quickly unsummon it, or learn to fight close combat with only your left arm.

name: Pocket Full Of Sunshine
description: A pocket containing the sun's solar rays (sunshine). Can be used to light dark places or make pocket glow.
summary: The ability to have a pocket full of solar rays (sunshine)
strengths: Makes a good night light.
May surprise unsuspecting people.
Makes a slight hand warmer.
weaknesses: Is not lethal in any form or way.

name: Three Steps At A Time
description: Most people take every step. Some people can take them two at a time. This power makes you one of the rare people who can take three steps at a time without fear of tripping and falling. It's active by default, so you will unconsciously climb or get down stairs or ladders three by three. To temporarily deactivate it, you just need to watch your step. However, it doesn't just work with stairs and ladders, it also affects you when you walk toward or from any kind of step, such as a high sidewalk.
summary: The ability to take stairs and ladders three steps at a time.
strengths: A quick and easy way to climb or get down stairs or ladders.
It's always active, so you don't have to think about activating it when you chase after someone.
weaknesses: If the number of steps isn't a multiple of three, you can fall or trip at the end of the course.
This power also makes you take three steps when there's only one to take.
tags: was edited as it was too similar to another power

name: Sing, Sing A Song
description: With this power you can make people sing any song you want at any time even if they're asleep or they've never heard the song before in their life
summary: The ability to make people start singing
strengths: It's funny to make people sing ridiculous songs
Make your enemies break into song during a fight
Make your teacher break out into song in the middle of class
weaknesses: As soon as they're done singing the song they return back to normal until you make them sing again

name: Warning
description: With this power you can cause written warnings to appear on any object. The warnings will list every possible danger the object could pose to the power user. If their are too many potential dangers the list scrolls automatically at a slowish pace (like the opening crawl for Star Wars movies but less epic).
summary: The ability to cause warnings to appear on objects listing their potential dangers
strengths: You can know all of the potential dangers of any object
weaknesses: Not much use in physical combat

name: Enhancement: Widen
description: This is a support. It does nothing until attached to another power. When attached it multiplies the size of the power's sphere of influence (the area the power affects) by 2 and a half. Ex: 100-meter radius becomes 250-meter radius. This power can only be attached to one power at a time. If this power is stolen, the power it is attached to is permanently enhanced.
summary: The ability to widen the sphere of influence of another power.
strengths: Sphere of influence is really important for some powers.
weaknesses: Useless without another power.
Has no effect on powers that affect only the user as a 0 meter/inch radius times anything is still 0

name: One Last Time
description: You can pair this with another power, the power paired with this one will active one moment before your death.
summary: The ability to automatically use a power at the last moment before death.
strengths: It's automatic.
You pick the power.
weaknesses: If your about to die, why would you need to use a power.

name: Panontic Arch: Nameless
description: Nameless dimension. Prison of beings and things that should not be named. The first power is to let one out into this world for just a second. Everyone within 500 feet of you not possessing a supernatural power or the Living Memory power will be gone. Not a single atom will remain. You can also imprison someone in this dimension by touch. Anyone possessing a supernatural power can't be affected.
summary: The ability to gain powers from the nameless dimension.
strengths: Entire SWAT team surrounding you. No problem.
Some resurrection powers require at least a single atom to work.
The panontic is supernatural. You are immune to these powers.
weaknesses: Supernatural would also include: myth power, demonic, infernal, holy.
Magical, cthulhu mythos, angelic, unholy, undead beings and werebeings (e.g. werewolf)
Any other power described as supernatural in nature not mentioned here.

name: External Superpower Activation
description: This is the counterpart of Forced Superpower Activation. Instead of activating someone else's power by fulfilling the conditions to use it, you can activate one of your own powers while someone else fulfils the required conditions. This can be tricky to use if there's a very short time frame when the conditions are reunited. For example, if the condition is saying "Adeat", you must already be using this power on them before they say it, not while they say it, not after.
summary: The ability to activate your own power by having someone else fulfil all the conditions needed to use it.
strengths: If you are put in a position where you can't activate your power, someone can activate it for you.
If you'll never be able to fulfil the conditions yourself, like being pregnant as a man.
If the effects normally manifest on your body, they will still manifest on your body, not theirs.
weaknesses: In some cases, this person can use your power as they want, possibly against you, like telekinesis.
If the conditions must be maintained to keep your power active, you will be depending on them.
Tricky if there's a very short period of time when all the conditions are reunited.

name: Old One Power: Yog Sothoth
description: Yog-Sothoth is immensely powerful, as he is the master of time and space (and some magic). He can open gates from and to any place (including other realms) and any time. The opening of the gates is so great a task that he keeps an eye on your use, refusing to open gates for reasons he disagrees with. He also uses you to further his goals often, usually allowing him direct access to the universe so he can feast. As you are useful, you gain eternal youth and immortality, at least to aging.
summary: The ability to channel the power of the Outer God Yog-Sothoth
strengths: Mastery of time, space, and dimension! The benefits of these powers can't begin to be listed here!
As he needs people on the inside to gain access to this universe, he is much more willing to talk.
If he sees fit, he might teach you some of the powerful mythos magic. You're immortal, too.
weaknesses: Unless it's necessary for survival, gathering power, or useful for him, no time travel for you.
The Mythos magic he might teach you drains the stability of the mind of the user and local reality.
His goals are usually "curry favor with the other Old Ones" and "enter reality to cause horror. "

name: Yes Man
description: Every time you say the word yes you get good luck.  Talking to your boss,in a important event,just keep saying yes and you will surely have good luck.
summary: The ability to have good luck when saying yes.
strengths: Always have good luck.
weaknesses: Saying another word will give you bad-luck.
Passive ability.

name: Interdimensional Arrow Monster
description: You need to read the power "Interdimensional Hand Monster" to understand this power. This is a similar power, but instead, it involves the sport archery. When you activate this ability, a bow will materialise in your hands. You start by pulling the string back and aiming as if you were launching an arrow. You will be shooting nothing, but when you release, a red spherical monster slips into our dimension. It will take the target into another dimension, with the same rules as the Hand Monster.

strengths: Fire a small monster at a target by firing nothing.
The monster will pull the target into the dimesion it came from.
Get awesome archery skills. "How are you so good with archery? ", and you say "Ah, it's nothing! "
weaknesses: Unlike an arrow, this monster will bounce if it hits a wall. What if it bounces back at you?
Monster is small, so gigantic targets may not be an option.
Bad if you dislike the colour (color) red

name: Gravitational Stabilization
description: When you are able to create and or destroy matter or energy, you have to be wary of disrupting the gravitational constant and thus killing the universe. This power bestows upon you a form of telekinesis as strong as the universe is large. Unfortunately, you cannot use it in any way other than subconsciously making the universe behave normally, as if nothing had changed. This power cannot be modified by other powers.
summary: The ability to make your current universe act normally despite creation/destruction of matter or energy.
strengths: Create or destroy matter or energy without destroying the universe.
Takes no effort; it even does the adjustments automatically. You may even forget about the power.
You also compensate for those who do not have this power.
weaknesses: Cannot use this telekinesis for anything else. You cannot even modify it with other powers.
Does not help if you change the gravitational pull of the body you stand on.
If you die or lose this power without reversing your work, the universe will suffer.

name: Jump 1: The Superpower List
description: With this power, you can enter a reality where every power on The Superpower List exists in reality. At first, this is useless, as you start off in that reality anyway. However, if you are forced into another reality, you can return at will, as long as this power works.

strengths: Powers can be acquired if found.

You can bring whatever/whoever you want with you.
weaknesses: Useless unless moved to another reality.
Trapping people there would just empower them over time.
You are not the only superhuman in existence.

name: Last Obtained
description: This power increases the power of the last power you obtained allowing you to do things that you could not normally do. The increase in power only lasts 24 hours at which point you need to obtain a new power. If this is your last power or your last power is lost or stolen then the last power that is usable to you is amplified for the remaining time.

strengths: Have increased power with new abilities.
Will not have to worry about training as much when first obtaining powers.

Will only last 24 hours per power

name: Panontic Arch:Thend
description: Thend, the home of the sharke. You have no 24-hour limit on the use of panontic arch powers. Anything you can touch you can choose to age 100 billion years in a second -- just like sharke do when one bites something or someone.

strengths: A deadly time power.

name: Hollywoodoo
description: You always have the superpowers of the hero who is starred in the latest Hollywood blockbuster. If they release another Spiderman-sequel, you get Spiderman's abilities, if they release Wolverine 2, you will be immortal and unbreakable, and so on.

strengths: New combination of powers about every month!
weaknesses: Pray that they won't release Hancock 2.

description: Also called the Cypher Effect, or the Nonentity Effect, one with this power can reduce nearly anything in all of existence to zero. When matter is reduced to 0, it is shifted into a metaphysical plane of existence in which matter is only imagination. It can have no effect on the real world, other than being seen by those with this ability, and those with ESP. Matter affected by this power cannot be otherwise affected at all (even by the user) until shifted back into existence.

Injury, age, hunger, thirst and other bodily process only cyphered when the SUBJECT is cyphered

Too fun

name: Myth Power: Meet The Menae
description: The Menae (Menai), in Greek myth, were goddesses of the fifty lunar months (cycles of time from the new moon to the full moon). As such, channeling them allows one to psychically perceive the passage of time, at will. In addition, one can withstand temporal effects. Furthermore, one can psychically propel oneself in flight, at will. One can also psychically propel oneself into outer space, at will (and survive its conditions). One can even psychically generate forty-nine replicates, at will.

Fly, propel oneself into outer space and survive its conditions

name: Earth Mover
description: With this power you can move the Earth wherever you want while making it as if the Earth has remained in it's rightful position weather/climate wise.  The seasons will remain the same as well as day and night patterns while allowing you to move the entire planet throughout the galaxy. You can bring the Earth to visit other planets or other outer regions of the galaxy unseen by mankind.

Go out and you'll find any valid coupon for the store or restaurant you want to go to. These coupons can be torn out as many times as you like, with the number never decreasing.

Furthermore, one can psychically regenerate, and gain physical power, when one prays or meditates. One can also psychically access a calming extradimensional 'Meditation Space', at will. name: Myth Power: Horae (Hours11)

In addition, one can withstand temporal effects. Furthermore, one can psychically regenerate, and gain physical power, when the sun sets. One can also psychically generate a solar aura around targets to negate flight and/or soften falls, at will. One can even psychically age subjects to old age, by touch, at will.

name: Life Bank
description: You can skip up to five seconds of your life at a time and save them for later. While skipping, you'll act dead for that long, but it will only seem like one nanosecond to you. Anything that you skip will go into your "life bank", which will extend your life past the point where you're supposed to die. However, there is a 24 hour recharge time between moments that you skip, and the power only works if you die of natural causes. The maximum capacity of your life bank is ten minutes.

name: Detachable Thumb Bombs

Once your thumbs are detached they your nail instantly turns into a screen that starts counting down from ten once the countdown reaches zero the thumb will explode and a new thumb will regrow on your hand. You gain your power from the moon and the fuller the moon is, the more wolf you become ... the darker the moon is, the more human you become. Every full moon you turn full wolf, every new moon you don't morph. Your fangs and teeth are sharp and lethal, you are also fast and posses incredible strength.

strengths: Transform into a beast or incredible strength each night
Own the forest while hunting for prey
weaknesses: Your screwed if your in the middle of a battle and the moon go's down
There is only one night in a lunar cycle that you get to stay human

name: Groundhog's Day
description: You must live the same day for one week. You have no control over this power. Example: "1" July 1st equals "7" July 1st's You do not age more than the typical day. You cannot die until the 7th day. The 7th day carries over to the next actual day (Example: July 1st 7th day carries over to July 2nd 1st day)

Correct mistakes

description: He who has this power can store anything in his pockets forevermore, regardless of size or shape. First, he must chant, "Picky picky pockets," and then name the object he wishes to store. There is only one catch: absolutely NOTHING that enters the pockets can ever come back out.

They will then have to play a game of chess, acting and moving only as the pieces they represent can, until either "king" is taken. The pattern then vanishes, setting them free to move however they please.

When you use this power, the selected space is cleared, and you then need to visualize the playground you want to create. The playgrounds DO NOT need to be realistic, but must still obey the laws of the universe, such as gravity.
summary: The ability to create any sort of playground.
strengths: Playgrounds are a great contribution to society.
Playgrounds can be removed at will, making for great temporary shelter.
weaknesses: Playgrounds can be removed against your will

name: 1000 Eyes
description: You are able to place your "eyeballs" anywhere in the world. They can then see anywhere or anything you wish. Perfect for gathering information, or just keeping an eye on things in general.
summary: The ability to place eyeballs anywhere you go, so you can see any location at any time.
strengths: Practically omnipresent
Can gather information about anyone anywhere
weaknesses: Eyeballs can be stolen
Have to physically place them places yourself

name: Finger Head Squisher
description: You know that thing where you close one eye and hold up two fingers in front of your face so it looks (to you) like you're holding someone's head, and then you pretend to crush their head between your fingers? Well, with this power, when you do that, the person's head will actually get squished. You're essentially breaking the laws of 3 dimensional reality with this, but at least your fingers won't get all gooey from it.
summary: The ability to crush people's heads from afar with your fingers
strengths: Pretty simple concept, and easy to do
Requires little concentration
Who's gonna know it was you?
weaknesses: You have to use your fingers
It may be difficult to squish moving head targets
You may accidentally kill people with this power if you forget you have it

name: Photo Op
description: Ever forgotten your camera at the worst time? Like when your new child has just been born? Anniversary? Birthday? Just need a picture to remember the moment? With this power all you have to do is make a rectangle with your fore-fingers and thumbs and say 'click! ' The picture will be stored in your subconsciousness until you decide to print it by slowly sliding one hand over the other, developing and printing it perfectly just as it should be.
summary: The ability to take a picture anywhere without a camera.
strengths: Portable camera with no extra weight on your person.
Can be set to color or black and white with a thought.
Infinite space and battery
weaknesses: No flash or zoom.
Must have still hands.
Only standard photo size.

name: Enhancement: Reflecting
description: This is a support. It does nothing until attached to another power. When attached, it makes the other power reflect alterations done to it back to the alterer to affect their powers. This power can only be attached to one power at a time. If this power is stolen, the power it is attached to is permanently enhanced. This power CANNOT affect other enhancements.
summary: The ability to make a power unalterable by reflecting alterations sent by others
strengths: Karma will annoy your enemies.
The power this is attached to is 'unalterable'.
Ran out of room in cons: this power affects all alterations, good and bad.
weaknesses: Useless without another power.
Can only be attached to one power at a time.
Cannot be used on other enhancements. This cannot be negated by Con Negation.

name: Say Photograph
description: The user, once he or she snaps her fingers will be able to turn the targeted person into a still life size picture cut out of the target. The user will be able to turn the targeted person back by snapping his or her fingers two times.
summary: The ability to turn someone into a life size picture cut out of themselves
strengths: Able to immobilize the bad guys
Non-lethal power
weaknesses: Not really effective against large crowds

name: 2nd Law Of Kyst: Life
description: "Living things won't heal or die. " This power starts 20 feet from your body, extends into a 500-foot radius around your body. Living things won't heal (normally or with the use of any power). This includes powers that control blood. Resurrection powers won't work because nothing living can suffer death, even if reduced to 1000 tiny pieces. This power is a hybrid dimensional/reality power.
summary: The ability to manifest the kyst law of life/death around yourself.
strengths: Deal with all those regeneration powers.
Deal with those who dare you to kill them.
You don't need an attack power to damage foes-just a machine gun.
weaknesses: Foes with invulnerability still can't be damaged with this power.
Someone who can teleport 480 feet.

name: Enhancement: Radiant
description: This is a support. It does nothing until attached to another power. When attached, it makes anything the other power creates or transforms give off enough light to blind anyone. The only one immune to the blinding light is the one using this power ('Blinded by the light'). This power can only be attached to one power at a time. If this power is stolen, the power it is attached to is permanently enhanced.
summary: The ability to make a power's creation(s) give off light
strengths: Blindness is temporary-similar to effects of flash grenade.
You're unaffected by the light.
weaknesses: Allies are also affected.
Useless without another power.
Can only be attached to one power at a time.

name: Delete This Hm
description: too powerful
summary: The ability to be a duplicate
strengths: no weaknesses
weaknesses: None.

name: Enhancement: Halved
description: This is a support. It does nothing until attached to another power. When attached, it reduces the power's potency/number of/size by half. Ex: Reducing potency to stun instead of kill. This power can only be attached to one power at a time. If this power is stolen, the power it is attached to is permanently enhanced. If you want to detach this power and attach it to another power it takes one hour to do so.
summary: The ability to halve a power's power
strengths: Your auto-kill powers can now stun.
Easier to capture instead of kill with your strongest power.
Used on an enemy's power with Enhancement Sharing.
weaknesses: Useless without another power.
Can only be attached to one power at a time and has an insane reattach time of one hour.
Unaffected by Con Negation or similar powers.

name: Condition Change: Unneeded
description: By touching a superpowered being you automatically make all the powers they have at that time useless. This is because the powers can now only work when there is no call to use them. This in turn means that they are unable to use any of their powers unless they can't control them in the first place.
summary: The ability to make another being's powers require being unneeded in order to be used
strengths: Have a laugh while watching your opponent trying to use their powers.
Automatically affects all their powers.
weaknesses: Have to touch the other person. Also if the target has Ability Reflection.
Con Negation and altering powers have no effect on this power.
Automatically affects friends' powers too.

name: Dimensional Power Block
description: On the planet h7r43 in the center of the universe stands an ancient device of unknown origin.  You know how to give it a list of max 7 words.  When the device is activated it will then alter the very rules of existence in your dimension.  All powers that have any of these words in the name or description will stop working and can't be activated anymore. This effect will last for 7 days on planet h7r43. The effect can't be removed, altered or avoided by any power. There's no immunity against it.
summary: The ability to use a device that can disable powers in your dimension, based on keywords.
strengths: You now have a way to disable a series of powers from your multipowered foes.
Example keywords : mythpower, kystian, kinesis, mind, time, mimicry, pudding
After the 7 days the powers can be used again as if nothing happened.
weaknesses: The device is on the very distant planet h7r43. How will you get there and return?
A time traveler could avoid the 7 days. If one doesn't add the word "time" to the list.
It affects every power user without fail. Including you.

name: Immunity Sharing
description: With this ability, you are able to share immunity to something with someone else. Any amount of people can be in this group and they all make each other immune to something once one of them becomes immune. However, should a member leave the group, all members lose that person's immunities. Power like Con Negation cannot fix the cons of this power. You can remove a person from the group at any time.
summary: The ability to share immunities.
strengths: Great if you have someone who has immunity-based superpowers; you all do.
Once one of you recovers from a disease, you are all immune.
Useful with other team-based abilities.
weaknesses: Someone in your group must have that immunity for you to attain it.
Can only give immunities resulting from powers; not the powers themselves.
People must agree to enter the group and can leave at any time.

name: Transformers: Wheelie
description: With this power you automatically have perfect aim whenever you are using any kind of slingshot. An unfortunate side effect of this power is that if you use it for prolonged periods of time (use a slingshot several times in a row) you will start to rhyme whenever you speak.
summary: The ability to have perfect aim when using a sling shot
strengths: You have perfect aim whenever you use a slingshot
weaknesses: You may start rhyming

name: Myth Power: Neaera's Need
description: Neaera (Neaira, Perseis, Perse), in Greek myth, was the goddess of the sun and moon's risings. As such, channeling her allows one to psychically manipulate sunlight when the sun is out, and moonlight when the moon is out, at will. In addition, one can psychically absorb sunlight and moonlight to gain physical power and sustenance, at will. One can also psychically propel oneself in flight, at will. One can even psychically propel oneself into outer space, at will (and survive its conditions).
summary: The ability to channel Neaera's command over the essence of the rising of the sun and the moon
strengths: Psychically manipulate sunlight when sun is out, moonlight when moon is out, at will
Psychically absorb sunlight and moonlight to gain physical power, as well as sustenance, at will
Fly, propel oneself into outer space and survive its conditions
weaknesses: Cannot psychically teleport to any location the sun/moon is rising, at will, until developed (NCN)
Cannot psychically time-travel to past/future sunrises/moonrises, at will, until developed (NCN)
MythPower: Helios' Help and Selene's Salute provide immunity and negation (NCN)

name: Self Absorption
description: Ever need a quick escape from the universe? With this power, you can absorb your own body, in the same way that a matter absorber would absorb other things, until there is nothing left. The effect would be similar to travelling into a black hole and you may come out in the other side of the universe, a completely different universe, or even a non-universe, like limbo. You could end up being 2 dimensional, 12 dimensional, 0 dimensional, or even -3 dimensional! Infinity's the limit.
summary: The ability to absorb yourself.
strengths: Escape from the universe quickly.
Can make it look like you are eating yourself.
weaknesses: Completely unpredictable.
Not necessarily voluntary.
Absolutely mind-boggling. Will probably end up going insane.

name: Power Bait And Switch
description: With this power, you become aware when someone is going to steal, copy or duplicate one of your powers. You then have the ability to pick what power they get. If your only choice was this power or gravity manipulation, you could choose this power. Or if you had one of the worst top ten powers, you could choose that power. The power duplicator or power thief has no idea what you've done until they try to use their newly acquired power.
summary: The ability to choose what power is copied or stolen from you.
strengths: The worst superpowers are actually useful to you.
Save your best powers from theft or duplication.
weaknesses: If you don't have enough powers.
If you don't have the ability to copy powers yourself.

name: Snap....There Goes Your Career
description: If you want to end a celebrity's career, and stop their fame and fortune, snap your fingers and it will all go to hell for that person. If they have any ounce of fame or star power, they can be affected by this power; doesn't work if that person is already a washed up has-been.
summary: The ability to snap your fingers and end the career of any celebrity you want
strengths: You can end the career's of horrible celebrities
The better celebrities could get a chance a fame
You could get a chance at fame
weaknesses: You might end the career of an influential person
That person might commit suicide without fame
Doesn't work if their career already sucks...

name: Real World
description: Whoever has this power basically creates a field around the planet that they are currently inhabiting which makes all of those inside of it lose the ability to use super powers, and forget that super powers were ever anything more than fiction.
summary: The ability to negate all super powers
strengths: No evil super powered idiots running amuck
If you become aware of your powers you can shorten the field to only affect a certain area
weaknesses: No super powers.... For anyone........ Ever.
You have no idea that you have this power unless someone far enough away from you sends a message.

name: Enhancement: Unbreakable
description: This is a support. It does nothing until attached to another power. When attached, it makes the connections the power it is attached to unbreakable. This will only work for a power if the connection being made does NOT harm either side of the connection. This power can only be attached to one power at a time. If this power is stolen, the power it is attached to is permanently enhanced.
summary: The ability to make a power's connection(s) unbreakable
strengths: No one can break the telepathic communication connections you make anymore!
weaknesses: Useless without another power.
Does not help connections that drain, leech, or otherwise hurt one/both side(s) of the connection.

name: Forbidden Power:Limbo Teleport
description: Gives the user the ability to send an enemy to the limbo, the empty space between dimensions. If used too many times, there may be consequences.
summary: The ability to send an opponent to the limbo (not the game).
strengths: Instantly get rid of enemies.
They'll never come back.
weaknesses: If used over 5 times, the user will be teleported to the limbo as well.
A painful ritual will be performed to get this ability.

name: X D Trapping Pit
description: You can create a volume expanding outside the boundaries of the three spatial dimensions and in the core of which dimensional travellers will fall if they travel through it. For example, if the volume is in the way of a wormhole traveller's or teleporter's "path", they will be pulled off and reappear in the core of the trap. If someone time travels while inside the volume, not only will they appear at its core, but they won't be able to travel outside the volume's period of existence.
summary: The ability to create an extradimensional pit trap, in which dimensional travellers can "fall".
strengths: If you place the core inside a prison cell, you can easily trap unwanted dimensional travellers.
It becomes tricky to use teleportation against the user.
You can trap time travellers inside a time period.
weaknesses: Don't fall into your own traps.
You can only trap someone if they venture outside the three spatial dimensions.

name: Darthon!
description: By saying the words "Your party..." you are able to alter reality in an adventure, like if you said "Your party has just approched a fire", a fire will appear in front of you. To continue an adventure you can say something like, "My skin repels fire."
summary: The ability to start, continue, or end an adventure.
strengths: Start,continue, and end adventures.
weaknesses: You have to begin every sentence with, "Your party....... "
Can only be used in an adventure.

name: Jli Summon
description: With this power you can summon any member of the Justice League International. You can summon them at any time, but they are not under your control. So if you're a villain, they probably won't want to help you. When you're done with them, you can send them back to their home universe.
summary: The ability to summon any member of Justice League International
strengths: You can summon any member of the JLI
You can send them back to their home universe when you're done with them
weaknesses: If you're a villain they won't want to help you

name: Epic Stare
description: With this ability you can stare epicly at anyone. Enhances your popularity and your bad @$$ness.
summary: The ability to epicly stare.
strengths: Epic Stare!
weaknesses: None what so ever. It's the Epic Stare.

name: Enhancement: Untouchable
description: This is a support. It does nothing until attached to another power. When attached, it makes the other power "untouchable". This, in effect, makes the other power unstealable, unmimicable, and unalterable. This power can only be attached to one power at a time. If this power is stolen, the power it is attached to is permanently enhanced. Unlike the other enhancements, you can only have one Enhancement: Untouchable at a time.
summary: The ability to have a superpower be untouchable.
strengths: One of your powers is unstealable.
One of your powers is unalterable.
One of your powers is unmimicable.
weaknesses: If attached to a power, will take a while before you are able to change the power it's attached to.
Can only be attached to one power at a time.
Can only have one at a time.

name: Moon Creation/Destruction
description: This power lets you make extra moons for a planet. These moons have a stable orbit and won't crash into a planet being orbited. These moons will add extra hours to the day of a planet. These extra moons can be any type of moon(e. G. The ice-covered one around Jupiter). You can destroy these extra moons any time you choose. Extra moons won't be bigger than existing ones.
summary: The ability to make extra moons for a planet and destroy the new ones if need be.
strengths: Extra days to the calendar could mean extra holidays.
Extra resources in earth's orbit.
weaknesses: Extra days means extra work days.
The tides will be altered in unknown ways.

name: Regain Power
description: With this power you can regain 10 powers that you lost one way or another. The powers are regained with the same number of uses as when you lost them and minimal power as well as skill. Minimal power and skill meaning you're as weak and horrible at using the power. The uses part means that if the power had 10 uses and you used it 7 times before you lost it, then you regain it with 3 uses.
summary: The ability to regain up to ten lost powers
strengths: Regain 10 lost powers!
weaknesses: Same number of uses as when the power was lost.
Limit of 10 powers.
Con Negation and similar powers/effects do NOT affect this power.

name: Pros Negation
description: Negate the pros of other powers, within a radius of 6 miles. This power is able to take away the usefulness of any power; it starts with your own, but eventually after you master it, you can take away the pros of other people's abilities if you know which person and ability to target.
summary: The ability to negate pros of powers.
strengths: Take away the usefulness of powers.
With enough practice you can negate the pros of abilities.
weaknesses: Still stupid, because without practice you can take away the pros of your own powers.
Like normal Negation, people can defend themselves against this.

name: Enhancement: Sos
description: This is a support. It does nothing until attached to another power. When attached, it makes a defensive power automatically activate when the user is losing. The defense power is activated slightly better than normal but drains the same amount of power as normal. This power can only be attached to one power at a time. If this power is stolen, the power it is attached to is permanently enhanced.
summary: The ability to have a defensive power automatically activate at slightly beyond full power when one is losing
strengths: Have some extra defense when you're losing.
Might give you the time needed to think of a strategy.
If the power normally requires concentration, now it doesn't.
weaknesses: Useless without another power.
Only helps when you're losing...
Barrier Defiers and Barrier Melters.

name: Enhancement: Quintuple
description: This is a support. This power does nothing until attached to another power and quintuples that powers effects. This power is gained by using Enhancement: Quadruple multiple times after which it changes into this power. Anything that goes for Enhancement: Quadruple goes for this power. This power can only be attached to one power at a time.
summary: The ability to quintuple the effects of a power by attaching this power to it
strengths: Quintuple the effects of a power. Quintiple Fireballs!!!!!
What goes for Enhancement: Quadruple goes for this power. May be a con for some parts.
This is the highest of the multiplicative enhancements. (I'm lazy).
weaknesses: Useless without another power.
What was useful quadrupled may not be useful quintupled.
Must have Enhancement: Quadruple and use it.

name: Claymore : Gold
description: (This claymore can torn things into gold ) the blade is made from Crown gold. The hilt is made from Damascus steel. This claymore can turn almost anything to gold except planets.
summary: The ability to possess a claymore that can torn things to gold
strengths: You are Midas without the physical contact part ( pro + con )
Turn your enemys ito gold
weaknesses: You can only have one claymore ( no con negation )
This claymore makes you hungry for gold
Any power that controls metal

name: Sacrifice!
description: An evil twist to reality warping; to warp reality, you have to kill an animal. Different animals give you different amounts of power, with humans giving the most. The more drastic the change, the more valuable the animal has to be. Only one change at a time, but if you kill a human, you could do anything. However, if you hurt yourself, you can also bend reality, as it gives you a huge boost.
summary: The ability to warp reality with a sacrifice.
strengths: Warp reality to your will.
Serial killers will love this power.
Could sacrifice your enemy.
weaknesses: Need to kill.
Only one reality warp at a time.
Doesn't come with an offensive power.

name: Hyperventilation
description: The ability to make others breathe really quickly on demand. They don't have to be anxious, nervous or coming from long durations of exercise. You just think it, or say it, and they'll start hyperventilating like it's nobody's business.
summary: The ability to make others breathe really quickly on demand
strengths: You can now make people hyperventilate whenever you want
weaknesses: People with asthma
People with bronchitis
People who don't need to breathe

name: Myth Power: Astraeus' Ascension
description: Astraeus (Astraios), in Greek myth, was the god of the stars, starlight, planets and astrology. As such, channeling him allows one to psychically cast an illusion of stars in the night sky to mesmerize foes at will. In addition, one can also use this effect to psychically communicate with the stars, to divine past, present or future. Furthermore, one can psychically perceive subjects' zodiac signs and horoscopes. One can even gain physical power when one's sign is present in the night sky.
summary: The ability to channel Astraeus' command over the essence of stars, starlight, planets and astrology
strengths: Cast an illusion of stars, twinkling in the night sky, to psychically mesmerize foes
Pro #1 used on self allows one to speak to/listen to/observe the stars to divine past/present/future
Perceive subjects' zodiac signs and horoscopes; gain physical power when your sign is present
weaknesses: Cannot mimic a star (space-adapted flight, stellar energy generation, etc) until developed (NCN)
Cannot gain sustenance from stellar energy, or generate levitating 'stardust' until developed (NCN)
Sun/moon/sky/celestial-based MythPowers provide immunity

name: Transformation: Ace Of Spades
description: The user is able to transform his or herself into the hero named the Ace of Spades. With this transformation, the user is able to gain the abilities of previous Ace of Spades as well as their memories during the time as a reincarnate of the Ace of Spade. To transform the user needs a special ace of spades card, that is more than meets the eye. The Ace of Spades uses throwing stars that resembles the ace of spades and has olympic level acrobatic skills and combat skills
summary: The ability to transform into a hero who uses Ace of Spades Motifs
strengths: Good at playing all form of card games that has an ace involved
Olympic level acrobat
Olympic level fighter
weaknesses: Cannot go head to head with powerhouses
No enhanced strength

name: Qwop Inducing
description: With this power you can cause people to move like the QWOP guy. They will start to have weird awkward movements and it will take them a lot of practice before they can begin to move like a normal person again. You can reverse the affects of this power.
summary: The ability to make people move like the QWOP guy
strengths: You can make people move like the QWOP guy
You can reverse the affects of this power
weaknesses: Nothing really

name: Panontic Arch: Ghestia
description: Ghestia, dimension of cosmic heroes. This dimension gives you two versions of one power. Both only work if you're facing a villain. The first version gives you a 99% chance to defeat a single villain if you're the definition of a hero. The weaker version gives you a 75% chance if you can't be defined as a hero. Both versions give you some sort of victory over a single villain. Any chaos or probability powers can reduce the chances. Probability powers could increase the 75% to 99%, the maximum.
summary: The ability to gain powers from the Ghestia dimension.
strengths: Heroically defeat a single villainous foe. A 99% chance.
You're a villain facing a fellow villain, you still get a 75% chance.
You will get some sort of victory over a villain.
weaknesses: The unpredictability power, any chaos power, any probability power.
There is a 1% chance of failure (if you are a hero), a 25% chance( if you are not a hero).
This power only works against villains.

name: Laugh At This!
description: With this ability, you can make anyone laughing at you have extreme nausea and vomit. Making them vomit will have them get laughed at for a change. It's payback time! This power can only be used on people who make fun of you. Typed words do not count.
summary: The ability to give people who are laughing at you have intense nausea and vomit.
strengths: Make anyone who is making fun of you have intense nausea and vomit.
They will be laughed at and you'll get the last laugh.
It's payback time!
weaknesses: Only works on those who are laughing at you.
Some people think the first con is a bad thing.
Typed words do not count.

name: Planetation
description: The power to rearrange the planets so that maybe Jupiter is the closest ot the Sun.
summary: The ability to control the planets to rearrange them.
strengths: The atmosphere changes and it could make planets livable.
May create new life on planets.
You teleport to the planet you are moving.
weaknesses: Could destroy solar life.
Make the black hole expand.
When you teleport, that planet might not become livable ever.

name: Forced Counting
description: You could throw a handful or a whole box of jelly beans on the ground and tell someone to count them. Their mind will then be set to figure out how many there are, so they will undoubtedly start counting them. It works with any set of objects as long as they are in the surrounding area of your target and can be seen and counted. If they don't have the decency of mind to remove or mark what they already counted, they may end up taking more time than necessary or even loop forever.
summary: The ability to force someone to count the number of objects in a given set.
strengths: Great diversion. They will only think about counting what you asked them to count.
Put very similar objects in a circle and watch them loop while they count.
weaknesses: If they are prevented to see what they have to count, their mind will be released from counting.
Instant Counting

name: Old One Power: Hastur
description: Aldebaran(a star)-bound Hastur. You can summon his servants, the "Byakhee", flying insects that can travel through space. You can twist and break someone's sanity in short order (not the laughing mad, either, but the growing seclusion and hatred followed by self-mutilation). You have some power over names and memes (shared thoughts). And, you can bridge reality between here and his city, Carcosa, causing doors to open onto the twisted place, letting people get lost where they can never return.
summary: The ability to channel the power of the Great Old One Hastur
strengths: Your huge variety of offensive powers makes you quite the formidable opponent.
The name power acts defensively, allowing you to know about any hostile plans against you.
If the most horrifying possible armageddon comes to pass (the Old Ones waking), Hastur protects you.
weaknesses: You become hateful of this reality much more quickly than the other Old One Power users.
Your power has no real peaceful uses. You also gain an obsession with the color yellow, and royalty.
Any attempts at finding your alignment via unnatural means always turns up "Ultimate Evil. "

name: Transformers: Starscream
description: With this power you will always be second in command of your group or team. No matter how good or bad at the job you are, no matter how many times you try to kill or betray your leader you will never be demoted or promoted. An unfortunate side effect of this power is that your voice becomes more shrill.
summary: The ability to always be second in command
strengths: You are always second in command of your team
You can never be demoted
weaknesses: You can never be promoted
Your voice becomes more shrill
Not useful if you are not part of a team

name: Multidimensional Snack Machine
description: This power allows the user to turn any snack machine into a multidimensional snack machine. Despite no change to its outward appearance, the machine will not vend the correct item. Instead the machine will vend a random snack. Any snack. One from another country, or the distant past, or the far future, or another planet, or an alternate timeline where the dinosaurs were never wiped out and Troodon's became the Earths dominant species, or another dimension that is fundamentally unlike our own.
summary: The ability to make it so that snack machines are not bound by space, time, or dimentional walls.
strengths: Random, possible exotic snacks from any snack machine.
Go into bussiness multidimensional snack machines.
weaknesses: You still have to pay.
There is a chance you'll get something you find unpalpable, or that's dangerous.

name: Gold Transmuting Past Travel
description: As long as you have gold in your hands, you can travel through time. You extract the gold molecules and alter them into tachyons. Those are particles that travel at a speed that exceeds the speed of light and are therefore able travel back in time. You latch on to these particles and are taken with them into anywhere in the past. At first you will be taken to random times but as you master this technique you become a powerful time traveler. This power is not Paradox or Butterfly-Effect Proof.
summary: The ability to travel to anywhere in the past by altering the properties of gold
strengths: Go anywhere in the past.
Undo your mistakes or crimes, or relive them all.
Go and stop Kurt Cobain from commiting suicide
weaknesses: The butterfly effect.
No future for you.
If you meet yourself in the past a paradox might rip open the universe as we know it.

name: 1 Year Of True Life
description: At any point in your life you may activate this power. If you do then exactly one year later, to the second, you will die. But in that time-frame you will live more than most people do in their entire lives. Everything you try will succeed, everything you do will be exemplary, and every word you speak will be remembered. During that year no other will be your equal, and when you die it will be gloriously.
summary: The ability to live fully for one year.
strengths: Live one perfect year.
Enact change that will outlive you.
Make your life one to be remembered.
weaknesses: You will die.
How much can you really do in just one year?
Enough to give up the rest of your life for?

name: Myth Power: Selene's Salute
description: Selene (Mene), in Greek myth, was the goddess of the moon and moonlight. As such, channeling her allows one to psychically generate and manipulate moonlight, at will. In addition, one can absorb natural moonlight to gain physical power (and sustenance), at will. Furthermore, one can psychically propel oneself in flight, at will. One can also psychically propel oneself into outer space, at will (and survive its conditions). One can even psychically turn into an entity of moonlight, at will.
summary: The ability to channel Selene's command over the essence of the moon and moonlight
strengths: Psychically generate and manipulate moonlight; gain physical power, sustenance from moonlight
Fly, propel oneself into outer space and survive its conditions
Transform into an entity of pure moonlight, at will; psychically induce madness, by touch, at will
weaknesses: Cannot cast illusions of moon's course (rising/setting, phases, eclipse, etc) until developed (NCN)
Cannot banish foes to the moon, by touch, or open portals to the moon, until developed (NCN)
Cannot psychically project vision anywhere moon shines, by touch, until developed (NCN)

name: Gate: Eight Gates
description: With this power you can create eight gates that are nearly indestructible. The gates are 5 metres by 2 metres and can only be destroyed by dropping ten gallons of arsenic on them. You cannot change the size of the gates. You cannot have more than eight gates out at a time and have to destroy all of them before creating more. This power is unaffected by Con Negation.
summary: The ability to create eight near-indestructible gates
strengths: "The best offense is a good defense. "
weaknesses: Can only have a maximum of eight gates at any time.
Gates can still be destroyed.

name: Hurt Locker
description: Damage done to you, including total destruction, is transferred to the nearest locker in a one-mile radius when you activate this power. As soon as this locker is destroyed, the next nearest locker is affected. This power won't transfer the effects of reality alteration that simulate damage or total destruction. You still feel pain. Any damage that actually wouldn't damage or destroy a locker like stinging insects won't be transferred.
summary: The ability to transfer any damage done to you to the nearest locker.
strengths: Survive anything that would destroy a locker.
weaknesses: Hurt by anything that wouldn't hurt a locker.
If you're a hero, you have to pay for any destroyed lockers and what was in them.
You're not close enough to any lockers or you run out of lockers to transfer damage to.

name: "Speak Humans!" V3
description: With this power you can give humans the ability to speak alien languages by pointing at a person and saying "Speak Humans" Then saying the name of the planet/alien species that you want them to know the language of. The person will then know how to speak that language for the rest of their life.
summary: The ability to give humans the ability to speak any alien language
strengths: You can give humans the ability to speak to aliens
weaknesses: Not much use in physical combat
You can't use this power on yourself

name: Self Turning Pages
description: How nice would it be to read a book in your bed while keeping your arms warm under your blanket. This power allows just that. You still have to open the book yourself when you want to start reading it. But then, you don't need to touch the book anymore, except to hold it of course. Just read normally. As soon as you want to turn a page, it will turn automatically. When you take a short break before resuming your reading, the book will stay open.
summary: The ability to have the book you're reading stay open and have its pages automatically turn.
strengths: You don't need to move at all to read a book.
The pages can be turned in both directions.
It even works on flip books!
weaknesses: It doesn't work on electronic books.
You still need to hold the book if you don't have a stable surface to put it on.
You can't operate pull tabs or any special mechanisms that are found in pop-up books.
tags: was edited as it was too similar to another power

name: Exodus Gem
description: It's been described as the most devastating gem. As such, it has the ability to annihilate timelines, eliminate any target you choose at will, and it's powerful enough to destroy entire universes if the bearer is of sufficient intellect and power.
summary: The ability to use it to completely and utterly destroy entire timelines from beginning to end.
strengths: None.
weaknesses: Once you use it, there won't be any chance of bring back what you destroyed.

name: Red Shift
description: What if America had collapsed instead of the Soviet Union? With this power you can shift to and from a timeline where this is a reality, along with anyone you care to bring with you. Different
summary: The ability to jump to and from a timeline where the Soviet Union won the Cold War.
strengths: Escape danger by shifting to another reality.
Shift your enemies to another reality.
Make money by smuggling items across dimensional lines.
weaknesses: The world could be very different.
You may exist on the red side of the timeline.

name: Human Thesaurus
description: With this power you are like a human thesaurus you know up to three synonyms and three antonyms of every word in every language on your home planet.
summary: The ability to know the synonyms and antonyms of each word
strengths: You're like a human thesaurus
weaknesses: No use in physical combat

name: 1st Law Of Kyst: Existence
description: "No changes can be made to the metaphysical state of anything. " A sphere half a mile in diameter surrounds you. Within this sphere, no power works if it changes non-living to living, animate to inanimate, alive to dead(zombie), alive to undead(vampire), dead to undead, undead to dead, dead to alive, undead to alive, mortal to immortal, immortal to mortal or non-divine to divine. This a hybrid dimensional/reality power. This power will stop you or anyone else from using life unmaking power.
summary: The ability to manifest the kyst law of existence around yourself.
strengths: Stops most powers that could take your immortality.
Stops most powers that could make a shambling zombie
weaknesses: Powers that make reality stronger.
You can't use the life unmaking power.

name: Spatial Occupation Generation
description: The user has the ability to create objects and materials to fill in space. The user has the power to manipulate space by limiting it. The object/materials that the user creates cannot be physically moved unless someone has powerful telekinesis, space manipulation, or reality warping abilities. The user on the other hand, can move them. These objects/materials can be quite durable as well
summary: The ability to create objects or materials for the sole purpose of occupying space.
strengths: Create durable objects/materials that occupy space
They cannot be physically moved
Manipulate space by limiting it
weaknesses: They can be moved by powerful telekinesis, space manipulation, or reality warping abilities.

name: I'm Rubber And Your Glue
description: With this ability, anything that someone says about you immediately becomes true about them. Like, if someone were to say to you "You're dead meat", they would immediately die and be reduced to meat. Or, if someone were to call you an idiot, they would immediately be reduced to the lowest forms of mental retardation. Also, if your enemy is speaking sarcastically and says that you are a weakling who is fighting the greatest force in the universe, then you instantly become a super powerful entity.
summary: The ability to send your enemies' insults back at them.
strengths: You can win any fight if you get your enemy to insult you.
weaknesses: People who compliment you.
Sarcastic remarks.
Your enemy holds up a mirror which makes you talk to your own reflection when you're insulting them.

name: Panontic Arch: Ithuari
description: Ithuari -- dimension of gates, portals, otherworld doors. First, this power (PA: Ithuari) doesn't count against the three dimension limit when using the panontic arch. And second, it links you to the panontic arch across the universe, other timelines or dimensions. You simply think of the arch to use it.
summary: The ability to gain powers from the Ithuari dimension.
strengths: It's a bonus dimension.
A link to the panontic arch anywhere you go.
weaknesses: It doesn't work between past and present. No time travel.

name: Member's Only Duplication
description: When activated, this power allows you to duplicate the powers, skills, and abilities of anyone in the universe who is, at that time, wearing a Member's Only jacket.  You are also able to know the locatation and identity of any person currently wearing a member's only jacket, or sense if a person near you ever owned one.  The power only works if you are wearing your Member's Only Jacket
summary: The ability to have the abilities of anyone wearing a Member's Only jacket
strengths: You belong to an exclusive club
You look sharp
Lot's of people have purchased them indicating a wide skill set to borrow from
weaknesses: Most Member's Only jackets are now hidden in the back of the closet, long forgotten.
Do you really want the abilities of someone who still wears one?
Use of power gives an involuntary feeling of arrogance and superiority

name: Power Banning
description: When thirteen people with this ability work together, they can ban an ability from existence. There is no defense against this, but at least it cannot target one person. Unfortunately, this only applies to the current universe/realm it is performed in. The group selects a leader to channel it through, but he does not do the banning. The leader must have it legitimately and nobody in the group can have acquired this pwoer from the leader. However, the group is not exempt from the change.
summary: The ability to erase a superpower from existence as a group of 13.
strengths: Eliminate overpowered powers.
Universal, no defense.
This power is immune to itself.
weaknesses: If anyone in the group dies, all effects are reversed instantly until rebanned.
This power cannot have it's cons removed by any power.
The leader must have this legitimately (i. E. No mimicry).

name: Enhancement: Range
description: This is a support. It does nothing until attached to another power. When attached, it increases the effective range of the other power by 2. 5 times. This power can only be attached to one power at a time. If this power is stolen, the power it is attached to is permanently enhanced.
summary: The ability to increase the effective range of a power
strengths: A power with a range of 100 metres ends up with a range of 250 metres.
weaknesses: Useless without another power.

name: Myth Power: Astra Planeta4
description: The Astra Planeta (Astra, Asteres) in Greek myth, were the gods of the five Wandering Stars (Planets). As such, channeling Phaethon (Phaithon, Phaiton, Dios, Dion- Planet Jupiter) allows one to fly, as well as gain adaptation to survive in space, and on Jupiter. In addition, one can psychically generate an aura mimicking Jovian weather and air conditions, at will. One even gains favor with Jupiter's patron, Zeus, to resist and benefit from his domains (sky and weather, fate, royal power, etc).
summary: The ability to channel the Astra Planeta and their command over the essence of the planets
strengths: Gain flight; gain adaptation to survive in space, and on Jupiter (physical change voluntary)
Psychically generate an aura mimicking Jovian gravity, weather and air conditions, at will
Gain favor with Jupiter's patron god, Zeus; resist and benefit from his domains
weaknesses: Cannot teleport self to Jupiter at will (others by touch) until developed (NCN)
Cannot generate Jupiter-patterned forcefield (or project Pro #2 onto others) until developed (NCN)
MythPower: Zeus' Zenith and sun/moon/sky/celestial-based MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)

name: Planet Eater
description: With this power you become a giant, big enough to eat planets and every time you eat a planet you get a new power this is more of a Super Villain power than a Super Hero power
summary: The ability to gain powers by eating planets
strengths: Gain new powers by just eating (planets)
weaknesses: Kills billions of people unless it's an uninhabited planet
Dwarf planets (like Pluto) don't work
Eventually you'll run out of planets and have to travel to a different galaxy

name: The Kyst Dimension
description: The Kyst dimension is where the norr, slitskins and other half-alive things like them come from. This power manifests as a 100-foot-radius ring of green-black primordial ooze that surrounds you and moves with you as if it were your shadow. If you're pushed to the ground, the ooze will flow around you. Anyone making contact with the ooze will instantly become enveloped and banished to the Kyst dimension. If they can't escape, they face hordes of half-alives that won't stop until they're dead.
summary: The ability to banish someone to the Kyst dimension.
strengths: Banishment to an ultra-nightmarish world.
Your own ooze can't affect you.
weaknesses: Anyone who flies.
Dimensional travelers.
Someone with a phasing power.

name: Enhancement: Duration
description: This is a support. It does nothing until attached to another power. When attached, it makes the power's duration 50% longer than normal. This includes ALL durations: usage and cooldown times. This power can only be attached to one power at a time. If this power is stolen, the power it is attached to is permanently enhanced.
summary: The ability to increase the duration of time that a power works
strengths: Can surprise opponent by using a power longer than they thought you could.
Con: some powers are just plain useless even with longer durations
Con: Powers you don't want to have longer durations, such as a power used to curse, used on oneself.
weaknesses: Useless without another power.
Will not affect powers in which the duration it works is important to how it works (May be a pro).
Only helps on powers with limits on how long they can be used.

name: Word Power
description: This ability is passive. If an ability is a phrase, it will depend on the letter count of the longest word in the power's name (but only ones that count in Scrabble) multiplied by the number of letters in the power name. The power's scrabble value times the number of letters in the power's name divided by the number of words in the power is equal to the boost given. Try it.
summary: The ability to enhance another power you possess depending on its value in Scrabble.
strengths: You don't need to be good at math to have this.
If you have a powerful move that has a long name, it's better.
weaknesses: You can't use this on others.
The boost will last for a day and have a cooldown of another.

name: Enhancement: Extra Loud
description: This is a support. It does nothing until attached to another power. When attached, it increases the volume of sound for the power. Maximum increase is 400%.
