This enhancement only works for powers that control or use sound. If this power is stolen, the power it is attached to is permanently enhanced. This can only be attached to one power at a time.
summary: The ability to make a sound-based power louder by attaching this power to it
strengths: Deafen your enemies.
Make yourself heard all the time with the right powers.
weaknesses: Useless witout another power.
Might not want a power to be really loud.
Sound-based powers only.

name: Enhancement:  Light
description: This is a support. It does nothing until attached to another power. When attached, it makes the power's creations feel lightier. This is accomplished by decreasing the general effects of gravity. This power can only be attached to one power at a time. If this power is stolen, the power it is attached to is enhanced permanently.
summary: The ability to make a super power's creations feel lighter
strengths: Less effort to move something your power creates.
weaknesses: Useless without another power.
Can only be attached to one power at a time.
Weaker hits if you throw the creation.

name: Alien Control V2
description: With this power you can have complete control over aliens no matter how far away they are from Earth. You can cause them to come to you but if they are very far away from you it will take them a very long time to get to you so you're better off taking control of aliens that are close to you.
summary: The ability to control aliens no matter where they are in the universe
strengths: You can take control over all aliens
weaknesses: If they're far away it will take them a long time to get to you

name: Myth Power: Astra Planeta2
description: The Astra Planeta (Astra, Asteres) in Greek myth, were the gods of the five Wandering Stars (Planets). As such, channeling Phosphoros (Eosphoros, Hesperos, Aphrodition - Planet Venus) allows one to fly, as well as gain adaptation to survive in space, and on Venus. In addition, one can psychically generate an aura mimicking Venusian gravity, weather and air conditions, at will. One even gains favor with Venus' patron, Aphrodite, to resist and benefit from her domains (love, charm, beauty, etc).
summary: The ability to channel the Astra Planeta and their command over the essence of the planets
strengths: Gain flight; gain adaptation to survive in space, and on Venus (physical change voluntary)
Psychically generate an aura mimicking Venusian gravity, weather and air conditions, at will
Gain favor with Venus' patron goddess, Aphrodite; resist and benefit from her domains
weaknesses: Cannot teleport self to Venus at will (others by touch) until developed (NCN)
Cannot generate Venus-patterned forcefield (or project Pro #2 onto others) until developed (NCN)
MythPower: Aphrodisia and sun/moon/sky/celestial-based MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)

name: Moon Teleportation
description: With this power you can teleport to any planet's moon. The moon doesn't have to be in solar system but it has to be in your universe. This power does not allow you to breathe in space so getting a power that allows you to might be helpful.
summary: The ability to teleport to any planet's moon
strengths: You can teleport to any planet's moon
The moon can be in a different solar system
weaknesses: The moon has to be in your universe
This power does not allow you breathe in space

name: Night Time
description: With this power you control when the sun sets making the day longer or shorter
summary: The ability to make the sun set whenever you want it to
strengths: Make the sun set whenever you want
Make the sun STAY down as long as you want
When the sun sets, the moon automatically rises
weaknesses: Can only be used to make the sun go down or stay down (can't make it rise)
If you make the sun stay down on ONE side of the earth, it scorches ANOTHER side of the earth
Doesn't control time

name: Simultaneous Speech
description: You have to activate your power while concentrating on a precise person. As long as you keep your concentration, every time that person says something, you will say the exact same thing with your own voice. You will also copy that person's volume, speech rate, pitch, accent and verbal tics as long as they are within your limits of competence. You can use your power wherever that person might be.
summary: The ability to simultaneously say what someone else says.
strengths: If you're a bad singer, you can gain experience by copying a good singer.
Discover what anyone is talking about behind your back.
Get private or confidential information by choosing the right person.
weaknesses: You can only copy one person at a time.
If that person is having a conversation, what you say will hardly make sense.
You will look funny talking nonsense to yourself.

name: Countdown Clock
description: With this power you can have a clock that only you can see follow you around. The clock is counting down until the second you die so when you use this power you can figure out when you're going to die and how much time you have left.
summary: The ability to have a large clock follow you that counts down to the second you die
strengths: You have a clock that pretty much tells you when you're going to die
weaknesses: Sometimes knowing when you're going to die is not a good thing
You can't unsummon the clock

name: Panontic Arch:Ergi
description: Ergi,the universe of raw energies where matter can't exist. You're immune to temperatures high as 11 billion degrees. Energy attacks can't hurt you. You can disrupt the strong nuclear force in a object by touch. Cold/ice attacks will do extra damage to you. Freezing temperatures for you will start at 60 degrees.
summary: The ability to gain powers the Ergi dimension.
strengths: Immune to extremely high temperatures.
Immune to energy attacks.
You can disrupt the strong nuclear force by touch.
weaknesses: Cold and ice attacks hurt you more.
You freeze at 60 degrees or less.

name: Enhancement: Anti Immunity
description: This is a support. It does nothing until attached to another power. When attached, it gives immunity to the defenses provided by that power to another being. Ex: Indirect Total Immunity, Impact Shield, Author's Immunity, etc. You can only have one copy of this power at a time. The other power cannot have other Enhancements attached. This power can only be attached to one power at a time. If this power is stolen, the power it is attached to is permanently enhanced.
summary: The ability to be immune to the defenses provided by a power
strengths: Don't have to deal with annoying immunity or shield powers.
Con: Cannot be shared with other people not even with Enhancement Sharing.
Con: Have to have the defensive power yourself.
weaknesses: Useless without another power.
Cannot be used on a power that was acquired using another power. Ex: Acquired using Ability Theft.
Con Negation and other alteration powers have no effect on this power.

name: Enhancement: Anti Enhancing
description: This is a support. It does nothing until attached to another power. When attached, it makes the power neutralize or dampen enhancements for 5 hours on what it affects in addition to other effects. Enhancements are defined as anything that makes something better in some way for this power. This power can only be attached to one power at a time and takes 3 hours to reattach. If this power is stolen, it permanently enhances the power it is attached to.
summary: The ability to make a power neutralize enhancements
strengths: Enemies who love to enhance themselves.
Neutralizes enhancements longer than a battle lasts.
weaknesses: Useless without another power.
Can only be attached to one power at a time. Has an insane reattach time.
Unaffected by Con Negation and similar powers. Also unaffected by time-based powers.

name: Enhancement: Corrupting
description: This is a support. It does nothing until attached to another power. When attached, the other makes those whom it affects evil. This power can only be attached to one power at a time. If this power is stolen, the power it is attached to is permanently enhanced.
summary: The ability to make a power corrupt what it hits in addition to its other effects
strengths: Gain evil 'allies'.
weaknesses: Useless without another power.
Really only useful for the evil.
'Allies' may turn on you.

name: Zodiac: Lunar: Cat
description: You draw upon the power of the Cat. You can transform into a cat, talk with cats, and move around without anyone visually seeing you. You have to keep moving for this to keep working.
summary: The ability to use the powers of the lunar calender's Cat
strengths: Full moon gives full power.
Can avoid being seen in an enemy's hideout.
The cat is in the Vietnamese Lunar Zodiac but the rabbit is in its spot in the Chinese Lunar Zodiac.
weaknesses: New moon gives no power.
Can only use if born in a year of the Cat. 1927, 1939, 1951, 1963, 1975, 1987, 1999, 2011, etc.
Not really combat-oriented.

name: "Tap Dance!" V2
description: With this power whenever you start tap dancing you are surrounded by an unbreakable forcefield. So now whenever you're about to be attacked or are being attacked just start tap dancing and you're good. This power does not give you the knowledge of how to tap dance.
summary: The ability to be surrounded by an unbreakable force field when your tap dance
strengths: Whenever you tap dance you're surrounded by an unbreakable forcefield
weaknesses: You don't necessarily know how to tap dance with this power

name: Comic Awareness
description: You realise that you're a character of a comic book.  This allows you to break the 4th wall.
summary: The ability to know you're a character from a comic book
strengths: You can break the 4th wall
You can have cool inside jokes that no one else in that comic understands
You can speak directly to the readers or even your creators
weaknesses: Even after breaking the 4th wall you're still stuck in a comic book

name: Zodiac: Lunar: Monkey
description: You draw upon the power of the Monkey. You can transform into a monkey, talk with monkeys, and use any limb as though it was your good arm or hand. In other words, you are ambidextrous with your arms, hands, legs, and feet.
summary: The ability to use the power of the lunar calender's Monkey
strengths: Full moon gives full power.
All your limbs are useful for holding items.
weaknesses: New moon gives no power.
Can only use if born in a year of the Monkey. 1920, 1932, 1944, 1956, 1968, 1980, 1992, 2004, etc.

name: Execution Of The Immortals
description: Using this power is a gamble. Activating this power upon an immortal will kill him or her, but somewhere else in the world, 5 other mortals will die along with the immortal. Not only that, using this power will give you nightmares starring those who the power killed.
summary: The ability to kill an immortal
strengths: Kill immortals
The power backfiring on you is only 10%
weaknesses: May give you nightmares
Kills 5 other innocents

name: Fandom Manipulation
description: The obsession of the fanboy or fangirl can be anything. A singer,a book series,a movie series,tv series or anything else that incites rabid fandom. The new obsession doesn't give new knowledge so a twilight fangirl suddenly a star trek fangirl will spend as much time possible learning everything about star trek. A new fandom obsession is permanent.
summary: The ability to change the obsession of a fanboy or fangirl.
strengths: End careers of annoying teen singers.
Make authors of stupid book series lose money.
No more chuck norris fanboys.
weaknesses: This power is naturally permanent but can be reversed by other powers.

name: Myth Power: Astra Planeta3
description: The Astra Planeta (Astra, Asteres) in Greek myth, were the gods of the five Wandering Stars (Planets). As such, channeling Pyroeis (Mesonyx, Areios, Areius- Planet Mars) allows one to fly, as well as gain adaptation to survive in space, and on Mars. In addition, one can psychically generate an aura mimicking Martian gravity, weather and air conditions, at will. One even gains favor with Mars' patron, Ares, to resist and benefit from his domains (war, combat, rage, violence, bloodshed, etc).
summary: The ability to channel the Astra Planeta and their command over the essence of the planets
strengths: Gain flight; gain adaptation to survive in space, and on Mars (physical change voluntary)
Psychically generate an aura mimicking Martian gravity, weather and air conditions, at will
Gain favor with Mars' patron god, Ares; resist and benefit from his domains
weaknesses: Cannot teleport self to Mars at will (others by touch) until developed (NCN)
Cannot generate Mars-patterned forcefield (or project Pro #2 onto others) until developed (NCN)
MythPower: Ares' Wrath and sun/moon/sky/celestial-based MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)

name: Myth Power: Horae (Hours10)
description: These Horae (Horai, Hours), in Greek myth, were the goddesses of the hours of the day. As such, channeling Hesperis (Evening Hour), one can psychically perceive the passage of time, at will. In addition, one can withstand temporal effects. Furthermore, one can psychically regenerate, and gain physical power, when evening hits. One can also psychically compel subjects to stop working/laboring, at will. One can even psychically teleport foes to the Evening Star (Venus), by striking them, at will.
summary: The ability to channel the Horae and their command over the essence of the hours of the day
strengths: Psychically perceive the passage of time, at will; withstand temporal effects
Psychically regenerate and gain physical power when evening hits
Psychically compel subjects to stop working, teleport foes to Venus by striking them, at will
weaknesses: Cannot psychically reduce light to 1/6 brightness, until developed (NCN)
Cannot psychically teleport to any location where it is evening, until developed (NCN)
Cannot psychically time travel to past/future evenings, until developed (NCN)

name: Aeternus
description:
Aeternus is the ability to move back and forth between ages that have already been lived. This enables users to have incredibly long lifespans, seemingly immortal lifespans. 
However, moving back to a previous age is considerably painful and the user should stay in that form for quite some time.
summary: The ability to move back and forth between ages that have already been lived.
strengths: You get an incredibly long, almost immortal, lifespan.
You can take on different forms of yourself, allowing "shapeshifting", to an extent.
You can do what you want, when you want and then just change forms.
weaknesses: It's painful to transform into a previous age.
New users who aren't experienced, may become "stuck" in a form.
Users personality may change to whatever it was like at the chosen age.

name: Enhancement: Others
description: This is a support. It does nothing until attached to another power. When attached, it allows a power that under normal conditions affects only oneself to also be able to affect other beings. This power can only be attached to one power at a time. If this power is stolen, the power it is attached to is permanently enhanced.
summary: The ability to allow a power that normally affects only oneself to affect others
strengths: Shapeshifters will love this.
weaknesses: Useless without another power. Enhancement Sharing will not affect this power.
Will not affect reality bending or existence changing powers.
Cannot be affected by Con Negation or other Enhancements.

name: Interdimensional Hand Monster
description: You begin by throwing nothing. You get in the stance you'd use to throw something, and you "throw nothing" at a target. But that's not the whole story. When you throw nothing, a second later a small blue spherical monster slips into our dimension and follows the path of your throw, as if you threw it. It'll latch onto the target with its teeth, and, using its momentum, will pull them into the dimension it came from. You can also pull the target out of that dimension any time. Practice throwing!
summary: The ability to summon a small monster from another dimension.
strengths: Throw a small monster at a target by throwing nothing at it.
The monster will pull that target into another dimension.
Pull the target out at any time, and the monster will not hurt them or you.
weaknesses: It will bounce if it hits something like a wall, and if it comes back at you... Yeah. Buy a shield.
Monster is small, so gigantic targets may not be an option.
Throwing nothing sometimes affects your throw of the monster (You don't add the weight of monster).

name: Enhancement: Stable
description: This is a support. It does nothing until attached to another power. When attached, it restricts the power to a level at which the user can safely utilize the power. The restriction will be lowered as the user gets better at using their power. This power can only be attached to one power at a time. If this power is stolen, the power it is attached to is permanently enhanced.
summary: The ability to restrict a power to a level that is safely controllable by the user
strengths: You power can always be safely used.
No more mishaps. Ex. Accidentally setting your house on fire.
The restriction is based on the user's control of the power
weaknesses: Useless without another power.
Only helps one power at a time.
If you only have powers that don't need this.

name: Guitar Hero On Expert
description: You can play any song on any Guitar Hero video game on Expert and get 100% every time.
summary: The ability to play any song on Guitar Hero on Expert and get 100%
strengths: Who hasn't wanted to get 100% on Through the Fire and Flames on Expert?!
weaknesses: The lower the level of difficulty you play at, the worse you are
On Beginner, you can't even play a single note

name: Random Dimension Travel
description: Dimension travelers afflicted by this power 'think' they're going to a dimension(timeline,plane,alternate universe) of their choice but it's totally random chance where they end up. Dimension travelers that use portals(doors,etc) get a preview of this other random place. With practice you can affect someone with the Personal Realm power if he has a dimension travel power that uses portals(doors,etc). The effects of this power are temporary.
summary: The ability to make dimension travelers go to random dimensions rather than ones of their choice.
strengths: With practice keep someone out of his or her Personal Realm.
You might get lucky and a enemy dies in the random world he goes to.
weaknesses: Dimension travelers using portals can avoid deadly random worlds.
The effects of this power wear off and need renewing.

name: Unicron Summon
description: With this power you can summon Unicron from the Transformers Universe into your own. Once he is here however you cannot send him back unless he wants to go back. He is also not under your control but he is susceptible to mind control or robot controlling powers. If you do somehow get him to be under your control you can have him eat enemy planets or cause him to make his various minions and worshipers to fight your battles for you.
summary: The ability to summon Unicron
strengths: You can summon Unicron.
He is susceptible to mind controlling and robot controlling powers.
weaknesses: He is not under your control.
You cannot send him back unless he wants to be sent back.

name: Summon Kystian Guns Trader
description: The Kyst dimension keeps all the weapons of any fallen foes who dared try and invade it. The corpse-like weapon merchant you summon with this power will trade you one in exchange for a thinking non-kystian being. As for the weapons, think of the Men in Black movies or the Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy books, but Star Wars or Star Trek will work too. A weapon will be explained and if it needs ammo of some kind you will be given enough. Your trade could be a thinking clone of someone.
summary: The ability to summon a half-alive weapon dealer.
strengths: High-speed nucleoannihilator pistol. It annihilates-good enough.
The assault ultraeliminator. It eliminates-do you need to know more?
A variable gravitic exploder. It explodes using gravity. Enough said.
weaknesses: A one for one trade.

name: Summon Yuru
description: Yuru look like badly out of focus humanoids. They seem to warp and distort space wherever they stand. Yuru can send someone to Kyst by sight or touch. This can affect someone visible in this universe but partly existing in another universe, e.g. the astral plane. Yuru are summoned with weapons. Two pistols, a melee weapon and a rifle. If the weapons are lost somehow, yuru are still strong enough to lift 20 tons. Yuru see perfectly well despite what they look like.
summary: The ability to summon a dimension-warping kystian.
strengths: Dimensional banishment, energy weapons and inhuman strength.
Foes that have never encountered them will think gaze-based powers are useless.
Give a yuru the power to see the invisible.
weaknesses: Reality anchoring or some other power that someone will think of.

name: Mutant Frog Summon
description: With this power you can summon mutant frogs that are seven feet tall, have horns and can shoot lasers from their eyes. The mutant frogs also have very powerful legs and they can jump long distances. They are under your complete control and when you're done with them you can send them to a pocket dimension where they will wait until you need them again. You can only summon three mutant frogs at a time but if one dies you can promptly summon another one to take its place.
summary: The ability to summon mutant frogs
strengths: You can summon mutant frogs
You have complete control over the frogs
The frogs are seven feet tall and can shoot lasers
weaknesses: The frogs are not invincible
You can only summon three of them at a time

name: Enhancement:  Heavy
description: This is a support. It does nothing until attached to another power. When attached, it makes the power's creations feel heavier. This is accomplished by increasing the general effects of gravity. This power can only be attached to one power at a time. If this power is stolen, the power it is attached to is enhanced permanently.
summary: The ability to make a super power's creations feel heavier
strengths: When used in conjunction with Enhancement Sharing.
Harder hits since you need to use more power to lift the creation.
weaknesses: Useless without another power.
Can only be attached to one power at a time.
Everything the power creates is heavier than normal.

name: Muppet Power Kermit's Speech
description: With this power you will be able to give an inspirational speech whenever you want on any topic. Your friend just got dumped by his girlfriend inspire him to get her back, your friend fail a test inspire him to study harder next time. You can use this power as many times as you like and it works for anything. You might even end up inspiring yourself. A side effect of this power is that you are able to play the banjo with great skill.
summary: The ability to give inspirational speeches whenever you want on any subject
strengths: You can give an inspiring speech whenever you want
You can play the banjo
weaknesses: Not much use in physical combat
They might not be inspired by your speech

name: Doomsday Panontic Arch
description: No one knows why the maker of the panontic archs made this doomsday device. She only made one. When used it will according all legends and myths about it release all the inmates of the Nameless dimension. You have to manually operate the arch. The freed inmates will appear at the arch's location. You will likely to go insane,die,be tortured or something worse could happen. There are a thousand rumored locations of this panontic arch.
summary: The ability to use an panontic arch that can free the inmates of the Nameless dimension.
strengths: No knows how many cosmic inmates are trapped in Nameless.
If the ex-prisoners thank you for freeing them. Impossible but not improbable.
If you love destruction,death,chaos or watching others go insane.
weaknesses: No one knows how many cosmic inmates are trapped in Nameless.
Insanity,death,being tortured or worse could happen to you.
You have to search out a 1000 possible locations across the multiverse.

name: Snap You Have A Nosebleed
description: With this power you can make people have nosebleeds just by snapping and touching your nose while pointing at the desired victim. The person will then start bleeding from their nose until you either use the power on a different person or snap, touch your nose and point at the person a second time.
summary: The ability to make people have nose bleeds by snapping
strengths: You can give people nosebleeds
weaknesses: You can only use this power on one person at a time

name: Powerful Puff Girls
description: Not only are you able to turn into a power puff girl, but you are also able to turn into them in any part of their time line, so you are able to turn into them when they were kindergarteners, or when they were like, 20.
summary: The ability to become a Power Puff Girl.
strengths: You posses many powers.
weaknesses: Might be girly.
People who are against power puff girls.

name: Myth Power: Course Of Chronoi 3
description: The Chronoi (Khronoi, Times), in Greek myth, were the gods of past, present and future. As such, channeling Mellon (Future), one can psychically perceive the passage of time, at will. In addition, one can withstand temporal effects. Furthermore, one can psychically receive insights from the future, at will. One can also psychically become imperceptible (except to those who can sense the future), at will. One can also psychically launch subjects into the near/distant future, by touch, at will.
summary: The ability to channel the Chronoi and their command over the essence of past, present and future
strengths: Psychically perceive the passage of time, at will; withstand temporal effects
Psychically perceive the future (and become imperceptible, except in future-tense) at will
Psychically project subjects into the future, by touch, at will
weaknesses: Precognitive Imperceptibility is useless against those who can perceive the future (NCN)
Cannot psychically time-travel to the future, until developed (NCN)
Cannot psychically summon a future version of yourself to the present, until developed (NCN)

name: Flicker
description: With this power you can cause any light bulb to start flickering. This is useful if you want to bother someone or distract the teacher during class or just for fun.
summary: The ability to make lights flicker
strengths: You can make lights flicker
weaknesses: Not much use in physical combat

name: Summon Hira
description: The Kyst dimension can slow down or speed up its flow of time. It links with hira that you summon to this dimension. Hira can speed up so fast that the effect is like the Supertime power. Hira are immune to any damage, except that done by someone possessing a time-based power. A hira looks like a sexless translucent human. Hira are as strong as four normal humans. You have to watch what you command them to do.
summary: The ability to summon a half-alive thing linked to the Kyst flow of time.
strengths: A kystian that can strike at any foes before they have a chance to blink.
The first con below could be eliminated with the right powers.
weaknesses: A man of normal strength with a time-based power could easily destroy one.
They will find ways to act against you, unless you have the right powers.

name: Kyst: Emergency Power #2
description: Kyst may feel your teammates or/and henchmen, the normal number of kystians you can summon, plus the forty extra ones It can summon aren't doing the job. Kyst can call up on a squad, platoon, company or battalion of kystians armed to the teeth. A squad is 16, a platoon is 60, a company is 250 and a battalion is 1000. What Kyst summons depends on the space available and the situation you're in. If a platoon or more is summoned, you get control of one squad. Any summoned help vanishes if unneeded.
summary: The ability to have Kyst call for armed backup.
strengths: A battalion of ultra tech armed soldiers (if needed).
At least 16 of them.
weaknesses: A battalion could level a building or city block.
Only stay as long as a battle is in progress.

name: Kangaroo Pouch
description: With this power, you have a huge pocket on your stomach. Just tear it open to have access to it. And when you're done, just close it and the opening will disappear. You can open the pouch from anywhere on your stomach area. The pouch is very elastic, so you can stretch it to be as big as you want. It is also very solid so it can't be opened if you don't want to. However, the things you put inside don't disappear into another dimension or anything.
summary: The ability to have a very elastic pouch on the stomach where you can store things.
strengths: You can store many many things in your body as long as you can stretch the pouch over them.
You can put your baby inside, just like kangaroos. Just don't forget to leave an opening for air.
Your stomach area is invulnerable to lacerations.
weaknesses: If you carry too much, you'll have trouble walking.
Your stomach will look suspiciously misshapen.
Good luck finding clothes to cover your stomach when it's huge.

name: Condition Change: Money
description: By touching another superpowered being, you force to have to spend money to use one of their powers. It works at a rate of 1 US dollar per 1% of power for the power. They don't pay you to use the power, they go to a store or restaurant to spend the money. 1 random power is affected each time you touch them.
summary: The ability to make a person spend money to use their power
strengths: Watching an opponent try to acquire as much money as possible to use their power.
They have to spend the money each time they want to use a part of their power's power, not per use.
They can't spend the money at a business they own.
weaknesses: A rich opponent.
This power is tactile and affects one power.
Enemies with multiple powers need to be touched multiple times.

name: The Power Of Tardiness
description: With this power, no matter how well you plan you'll always be late. Work, a date, making it to an appointment on time. Trivial or important, you'll be late. There is a benefit. If an attack has less than a 100% chance of hitting you, the attack will miss you. You'll never be near a bomb with a timer when it goes off. Your actual reflexes don't matter. You could be a klutz. You could be standing still. You might survive even if you're unconscious. Attacks need to have a 100% certainty to hit you.
summary: The ability to never be on time.
strengths: 99% chance to avoid attacks.
Bombs with timers aren't threats.
You probably picked a lot skills from all the jobs you held. See con #2
weaknesses: Nuclear bombs will still affect you with fallout.
You can't hold a steady job.
Other superheroes will think you're lazy and unreliable and won't want to work with you.

name: Moon Eater
description: With this power you gain a new superpower whenever you eat a moon. The power is always random but you get to keep the power forever unless it is stolen from you. You'd need to be able to breathe in space and probably be a extremely large in order to use this power effectively as you do not get a power unless you eat an entire moon.
summary: The ability to gain new powers whenever you eat a moon
strengths: You gain a new power whenever you eat a moon
weaknesses: You have to be able to breathe in space
You only get a new power if you eat the entire moon

name: Open Pet Tank
description: When you acquire this power, a special glass tank appears in front of you. This tank has the ability to inter-dimensionally share an object with two places: The outside world and inside the tank. Say you have a lizard that is really hard to look after. When you put the lizard in this tank, it will be both inside the tank and in the wild. The lizard will eat, drink and be in the wild while you can watch over it. You can pick it up, and the glass will serve as a shield against predators.
summary: The ability to keep a pet while it's in the wild
strengths: Follow the pet in the wild in 3rd person perspective.
It can get whatever it needs.
You can interact with the pet, and the glass appears to momentarily protect it in the wild
weaknesses: If you pick it up, it may think "WHAT JUST HAPPENED?!!! Where am I? "
Not much owner-pet bonding can happen unless you pick it up and interact with it a lot.
Bad if something disrupts the inter-dimensional displacement.

name: Myth Power: Eunostos' Know How
description: Eunostos (Eunostus, Promylaea), in Greek myth, was the goddess of flour mills, and grain silos. As such, channeling her allows one to cause any container one holds to produce any desired amount of flour at will (as long as physical contact is maintained). In addition, with a touch, one can establish an empty building as a 'silo space', which may be used for infinite storage, or imprisoning foes. One can even cause foes to sink into the ground, which will grind them painfully into useable flour.
summary: The ability to channel Eunostos' command over the essence of flour mills and grain silos
strengths: Cause any container to pour forth as much flour as one desires, at will (with  maintained contact)
Turn any empty building into infinite-storage 'silo spaces' by touch; teleport between them at will
Cause foes to sink into the ground; the ground will grind them up into cooking flour
weaknesses: Pro #1 and 3 do not apply to living things until the higher levels (NCN)
Cannot use one's silo space to access a dimension of infinite grain until the higher levels (NCN)
Plant/animal/nature-based MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)

name: "Tap Dance!"
description: With this power you can make anybody tap dance just by thinking of the person and saying: "Tap dance!" After that, the selected person will start tap dancing uncontrollably, until you say "Stop!"
summary: The ability to make people tap dance
strengths: You can make people tap dance
You can make enemies start tap dancing during a fight
weaknesses: They can still attack you while tap dancing

name: 503   Over Quota
description: Somewhere out there is a universe without superheroes! This is where all the inspiration for powers comes from. Every now and then they use their inter dimensional technology to view the superpower list universe. With this power you can prevent them from viewing the universe for a random amount of time.
summary: The ability to temporarily disable the superpower list from another universe
strengths: Absolutley stops everything, temporarily
No seriously nothing can happen
I mean it. NOTHING
weaknesses: You have to be outside the superpowerlistuniverse to use it
Kind of pointless since nothing inside the universe changes once deactivated
There's an organization of moderators in the other universe who can stop the power's effects

name: Transformers: Impactor
description: you can turn your hand into a harpoon, which you can then use to cut/stab people/things or shoot out of your wrist in order to damage people/things. An unfortunate side effect of this power is that you start to become a bit of a jerk/anti-hero.
summary: The ability to turn your hand into a harpoon
strengths: You can turn your hand into a harpoon
You can launch said harpoon from your arm
weaknesses: You become a jerk/anti-hero

name: Enhancement: Last
description: This is a support. It does nothing until attached to another power. When attached it makes the power the last one in line to be stolen. Can only be attached to one power at a time.
summary: The ability to make the power this power is attached to the last one to be stolen
strengths: Protect your most valuable power from being stolen.
If the attached power is the only power left other than this one, this power detaches and is stolen.
weaknesses: Useless without another power.
If all your other powers are equally valuable.

name: Crodo: Vacuum Ball
description: Vacuum balls suck up any kind of dirt near them.  Anything it sucks up comes out on another universe.
summary: The ability to wield a vacuum ball.
strengths: Cleaning will be a breeze.
weaknesses: You don't control what it sucks up.

name: Useless
description: This power does absolutely nothing. It is not affected by any other power, and cannot be copied, or negated by any other individual other than the one who possesses it. It basically doesn't exist other than being a power. Although it can be affected by upgrade type powers, or powers that increase your power depending on how many powers you have.
summary: The ability to have the most useless power in existence.
strengths: No Power Mimicry (mimics who try copying this power will receive a power "blank space"
No Power Absorption (absorbers who try copying this power will receive a power "blank space")
No power alteration (negation does nothing, because technically, it does nothing anyway)
weaknesses: It does absolutely nothing, besides giving you the indication of being superhuman to power sensors

name: Jump 2: Powerless.
description: Annoyed with super powers? With this ability, you can move to a reality where all powers cease to function. This includes object-based powers. However, you leave an "anchor" in your last universe, which will enable you to return at will to the place, age and reality you left.
summary: The ability to jump to a reality where powers are impossible.
strengths: Upon return, you are the same age, power level, etc as when you left.
If you aren't the one entering this world, you will still be able to return.
Good prison for enemies.
weaknesses: You lose your powers too.
Lasting effects from powers are erased (could be a pro).
If you were too dependent on your powers, you would be a sitting duck.

name: Myth Power: Horae (Hours03)
description: These Horae (Horai, Hours), in Greek myth, were the goddesses of the hours of the day. As such, channeling Musica (Musia, Mousika- Music, Study Hour), one can psychically perceive the passage of time, at will. In addition, one can withstand temporal effects. Furthermore, one can psychically regenerate, and gain physical power, when one hears music. One can also psychically convert subjects' voices into music, at will. One can even psychically access an extradimensional 'Study Space', at will.
summary: The ability to channel the Horae and their command over the essence of the hours of the day
strengths: Psychically perceive the passage of time, at will; withstand temporal effects
Psychically regenerate and gain physical power when one hears music
Psychically convert subjects' voices into music, access an extradimensional 'Study Space', at will
weaknesses: Cannot psychically access Speedreading and Superhuman Memory, until developed (NCN)
Cannot psychically generate music lyrics to compel subjects, until developed (NCN)
Cannot psychically generate music to cast lyric-based illusions, until developed (NCN)

name: Tomatosis
description:
With this ability, you can summon up small handfuls of tomatoes with a wish and a flick of the wrist. 

Inexperienced users often create tomatoes at inconvenient times, or make too many tomatoes, but as their skill grows they can grow perfectly ripe fields of pre-ketchup. 

Of course, pushing the limits may cause the user to run out of tomatoes until they can be restocked in the tomato dimension. 

Oh, and it doesn't work if you're wet.
summary: The ability to grow tomatoes out of thin air.
strengths: Free food.
Feed the hungry.
Entertain guests in your parlor.
weaknesses: Difficult to control.
Somewhat limited supply.
Won't work in water.

name: "Breakdance!" V2
description: With this power whenever you start breakdancing you will be surrounded by an unbreakable forcefield. If you're about to be attacked or being attacked you just start breakdancing and you're safe. This power does not teach you how to break dance.
summary: The ability to be surrounded by an unbreakable force field when your breakdance
strengths: You can be surrounded by a forcefield whenever you start to breakdance
weaknesses: You have to know how to breakdance

name: Door In A Jar
description: With this power, you have a Muppet Lab, "Door in a Jar". You have a small jar with a green jello-like liquid in it. The jar is unbreakable no matter what you do to it. To get the door out, you open the lid and throw the jello against any wall. The door is about the size of a rat, so you have to be able to shrink to walk through it. The door leads out of the building you were in or, if you use the door while on the outside of a building, you will get inside it.
summary: The ability to have a small door in a jar.
strengths: The jar is unbreakable, so you can throw it at people or hit people with it and it will hurt.
You can get in or out of anywhere.
weaknesses: The door is very small.
The jar can be stolen from you.

name: Delete This Splendid Overdrive
description: You start off by grabbing your enemy by the torso and you both quickly roll forward together. Then, you place their head between their knees or under their arm and stand up, holding onto their legs, so that the opponent is facing your back. You then simply bring both hands down, throwing the opponent back first to the ground.
summary: The ability to grab your foe, roll together, then finish it off with a double-leg slam.
strengths: Your foe will have a major case of having both backaches and headaches.
weaknesses: a fight combo is not a power

name: Enhancement: First
description: This is a support. It does nothing until attached to another power. When attached it makes the power first in line to be stolen. If that power is stolen, this power attaches itself to another power of your choice. This power can only be attached to one power at a time.
summary: The ability to make a power first to be stolen attaching this power to it
strengths: Protect your more valuable powers with a horrible power.
Detaches automatically when power is stolen.

If all your other powers are valuable.

name: Zodiac: Lunar: Rabbit
description: You draw upon the power of the Rabbit. You can transform into a rabbit, talk with rabbits, and jump from any hole in the ground to another hole in the ground. You cannot jump through time.
summary: The ability to use the powers of the lunar calender's Rabbit
strengths: Full moon gives full power.
Can jump from a hole in China to a hole in Italy.

name: 3rd Law Of Kyst: Kystian Bonds
description: "In their home dimension of Kyst, kystians may not be banished to another dimensions or erased from reality. " This power stops any kystians you have from being banished to another dimension or being erased from reality, even by you. The range if you can't see your kystian is 250 feet, or, if you can see your kystian, the range is as far as you could see it with unaided vision. A dimensional/reality power.
summary: The ability to manifest the Kyst Law of Kystian Bonds around yourself.
strengths: Now your half-alive creatures can only be trapped or teleported.
weaknesses: There are great powers that can hold your creatures in place.
Power negation or reality anchoring.

name: Delete This The Wild Wild West
description: You can start by pummelling your victim all over their torso at an incredible speed, and lift the enemy even higher by holding on to the opponent just moments before slamming them down to the ground.
summary: The ability to pummel your opponent multiple times, then finish them with an Elevated powerbomb.
strengths: a fight combo is not a power
weaknesses: a fight combo is not a power

name: Zodiac: Lunar: Mouse
description: You draw upon the power of the Mouse. You can transform into a mouse, talk with mice, and chew threw anything with your teeth. That doesn't mean you can eat or digest any of what you chew though.
summary: The ability to use the powers of the lunar calender's Mouse
strengths: Full moon gives full power.
Always have little friends.
weaknesses: New moon gives no power.
Can only use this power if born in a year of the Mouse. 1948, 1960, 1972, 1984, 1996, 2008, etc.
Can still be electrocuted by chewing wires.

name: Move Objects A Little Bit
description: If you can think about it, you can move it one inch to the left. You can only move the object one inch to the left once, so you can' t move it one inch to the left five times and call it, "Moving something five inches to the left". And you can't move it back.
summary: The ability to move anything one inch to the left.
strengths: You can move anything in existence, no limits.
You could move the planet one inch to the left, sending it out of orbit!
ANYTHING can be moved! What more do you want?
weaknesses: Movement is only one inch.
Once moved, the object can't be moved again with this power.
This power is for the most part, useless.

name: Claymore : Darkness
description: (This claymore is made from the aether ) this claymore looks like xenos sword but its a claymore. This claymore is useless during the day. This claymore is strongest during night time
summary: The ability to have a claymore that can cover the planet in darknes
strengths: Cover the planet in darkness
Block the ray of the sun by covering the the planet in darkness
You are Dr evil on staretouds
weaknesses: Any power that uses light
You can only have one clamore ( no con negation )
This claymore uses feeds on your soul

name: Myth Power: Horae (Hours02)
description: These Horae (Horai, Hours), in Greek myth, were the goddesses of the hours of the day. name: Power Backup Copy Sacrifice
description: You can sacrifice copies of a power to boost the efficiency of the active version. The maximum boost is a factor of ten(no con negation). You can't sacrifice this power (NCN). There is no limit on how many powers you can boost at one time. There is no minimum amount of time you have to wait before power boosting again. Two sacrificed copies gives you a 12 minute power boost,three gives you 18 minutes,and so on.
summary: The ability to sacrifice copies of a power to gain a power boost.
strengths: An extra way to more your powers work better.
If you have hundreds of copies of a power.
Ten sacrificed copies gives you a hour of boosted power efficiency.
weaknesses: You don't have the power backup ability.
A maximum power boost of times ten (NCN).
You can't sacrifice this power (NCN).

name: Clean Slate
description: With this ability you can start over again by removing any and all powers that you have. If you've become something you don't want to be because of your powers you can just erase the power from yourself.
summary: The ability to remove all pre-existing powers from yourself
strengths: Start over again
weaknesses: Does not work on other people. Just you.

name: "Breakdance!"
description: With this power you can cause people to start breakdancing uncontrollably by saying "Breakdance! " The victim when then start to breakdance uncontrollably until you say "Stop! "
